te.19:85: On the Day We gather the righteous as an honoured company before the Lord of Mercy
te.19:86: and drive the sinful like a thirsty herd into Hell,
te.19:87: no one will have power to intercede except for those who have permission from the Lord of Mercy.
te.19:88: The disbelievers say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has offspring.’
te.19:89: How terrible is this thing you assert:
te.19:90: it almost causes the heavens to be torn apart, the earth to split asunder, the mountains to crumble to pieces,
te.19:91: that they attribute offspring to the Lord of Mercy.
te.19:92: It does not befit the Lord of Mercy [to have offspring]:
te.19:93: there is no one in the heavens or earth who will not come to the Lord of Mercy as a servant-
te.19:94: He has counted them all: He has numbered them exactly-
te.19:95: and they will each return to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.
te.19:96: But the Lord of Mercy will give love to those who believe and do righteous deeds:
te.19:97: We have made it easy, in your own language [Prophet], so that you may bring glad news to the righteous and warnings to a stubborn people.
te.19:98: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you perceive a single one of them now, or hear as much as a whisper?
te.20:2: It was not to distress you [Prophet] that We sent down the Quran to you,
te.20:3: but as a reminder for those who hold God in awe,
te.20:4: a revelation from the One who created the earth and the high heaven,
te.20:5: the Lord of Mercy, established on the throne.
te.20:6: Everything in the heavens and on earth, everything between them, everything beneath the soil, belongs to Him.
te.20:7: Whatever you may say aloud, He knows what you keep secret and what is even more hidden.
te.20:8: God––there is no god but Him––the most excellent names belong to Him.
te.20:9: Has the story of Moses come to you [Prophet]?
te.20:10: He saw a fire and said to his people, ‘Stay here––I can see a fire. Maybe I can bring you a flaming brand from it or find some guidance there.’
te.20:11: When he came to the fire, he was summoned, ‘Moses!
te.20:12: I am your Lord. Take off your shoes: you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
te.20:13: I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.
te.20:14: I am God; there is no god but Me. So worship Me and keep up the prayer so that you remember Me.
te.20:15: The Hour is coming––though I choose to keep it hidden––for each soul to be rewarded for its labour.
te.20:16: Do not let anyone who does not believe in it and follows his own desires distract you from it, and so bring you to ruin.’
te.20:17: ‘Moses, what is that in your right hand?’
te.20:18: ‘It is my staff,’ he said, ‘I lean on it; restrain my sheep with it; I also have other uses for it.’
te.20:20: He threw it down and- lo and behold!- it became a fast-moving snake.
te.20:21: He said, ‘Pick it up without fear: We shall turn it back into its former state.
te.20:22: Now place your hand under your armpit and it will come out white, though unharmed: that is another sign.
te.20:23: We do this to show you some of Our greatest signs.
te.20:24: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly become a tyrant.’
te.20:25: Moses said, ‘Lord, lift up my heart
te.20:26: and ease my task for me.
te.20:28: so that they may understand my words,
te.20:29: and give me a helper from my family,
te.20:33: so that we can glorify You much
te.20:35: You are always watching over us.’
te.20:36: God said, ‘Moses, your request is granted.
te.20:37: Indeed We showed you favour before.
te.20:39: “Put your child into the chest, then place him in the river. Let the river wash him on to its bank, and he will be taken in by an enemy of Mine and his.” I showered you with My love and planned that you should be reared under My watchful eye.
te.20:40: Your sister went out, saying, “I will tell you someone who will nurse him,” then We returned you to your mother so that she could rejoice and not grieve. Later you killed a man, but We saved you from distress and tried you with other tests. You stayed among the people of Midian for years, then you came here as I ordained.
te.20:41: I have chosen you for Myself.
te.20:42: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and make sure that you remember Me.
te.20:43: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds.
te.20:44: Speak to him gently so that he may take heed, or show respect.’
te.20:45: They said, ‘Lord, we fear he will do us great harm or exceed all bounds.’
te.20:46: He said, ‘Do not be afraid, I am with you both, hearing and seeing everything.
te.20:47: Go and tell him, “We are your Lord’s mes-sengers, so send the Children of Israel with us and do not oppress them. We have brought you a sign from your Lord. Peace be upon whoever follows the right guidance;
te.20:48: it has been revealed to us that punishment falls on whoever rejects the truth and turns his back on it.”’
te.20:49: [Pharaoh] said, ‘Moses, who is this Lord of yours?’
te.20:50: Moses said, ‘Our Lord is He who gave everything its form, then gave it guidance.’
te.20:52: Moses said, ‘My Lord alone has knowledge of them, all in a record; my Lord does not err or forget.’
te.20:53: It was He who spread out the earth for you and traced routes in it. He sent down water from the sky. With that water We bring forth every kind of plant,
te.20:54: so eat, and graze your cattle. There are truly signs in all this for people of understand-ing.
te.20:55: From the earth We created you, into it We shall return you, and from it We shall raise you a second time.
te.20:56: We showed Pharaoh all Our signs, but he denied them and refused [to change].
te.20:57: He said, ‘Have you come to drive us from our land with your sorcery, Moses?
te.20:58: We will confront you with sorcery to match your own: make an appointment between us which neither of us will fail to keep, in a mutually agreeable place.’
te.20:59: He said, ‘Your meeting will be on the day of the feast, so let the people be assembled when the sun has risen high.’
te.20:60: Pharaoh withdrew and gathered his resources, then he returned.
te.20:61: Moses said to them, ‘Beware, do not invent lies against God or He will destroy you with His punishment. Whoever invents lies will fail.’
te.20:62: So they discussed their plan among themselves, talking secretly,
te.20:63: saying, ‘These two men are sorcerers. Their purpose is to drive you out of your land with their sorcery and put an end to your time-honoured way of life.
te.20:64: So gather your resources and line up for the contest. Whoever wins today is sure to prosper.’
te.20:65: They said, ‘Moses, will you throw first or shall we?’
te.20:66: ‘You throw,’ said Moses, and––lo and behold!––through their sorcery, their ropes and staffs seemed to him to be moving.
te.20:68: but We said, ‘Do not be afraid, you have the upper hand.
te.20:69: Throw down what is in your right hand: it will swallow up what they have produced. They have only produced the tricks of a sorcerer, and a sorcerer will not prosper, wherever he goes.’
te.20:70: [So it was, and] the sorcerers threw themselves down in submission. ‘We believe,’ they said, ‘in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.’
te.20:71: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? This must be your master, the man who taught you witchcraft. I shall certainly cut off your alternate hands and feet, then crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. You will know for certain which of us has the fiercer and more lasting punishment.’
te.20:72: They said, ‘We shall never prefer you to the clear sign that has come to us, nor to Him who created us. So decide whatever you will: you can only decide matters of this present life-
te.20:73: we believe in our Lord, [hoping] He may forgive us our sins and the sorcery that you forced us to practise- God is better and more lasting.’
te.20:74: Hell will be the reward of those who return to their Lord as evildoers: there they will stay, neither living nor dying.
te.20:75: But those who return to their Lord as believers with righteous deeds will be rewarded with the highest of ranks,
te.20:76: Gardens of lasting bliss graced with flowing streams, and there they will stay. Such is the reward of those who purify themselves.
te.20:77: We revealed to Moses, ‘Go out at night with My servants and strike a dry path for them across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken and do not be dismayed.’
te.20:78: Pharaoh pursued them with his armies and was overwhelmed by the sea.
te.20:79: Pharaoh truly led his people astray; he did not guide them.
te.20:80: Children of Israel, We rescued you from your enemies. We made a pledge with you on the right-hand side of the mountain. We sent down manna and quails for you,
te.20:81: ‘Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not overstep the bounds, or My wrath will descend on you. Anyone on whom My wrath descends has truly fallen.
te.20:82: Yet I am most forgiving towards those who repent, believe, do righteous deeds, and stay on the right path.’
te.20:83: [God said], ‘Moses, what has made you come ahead of your people in such haste?’
te.20:84: and he said, ‘They are following in my footsteps. I rushed to You, Lord, to please You,’
te.20:85: but God said, ‘We have tested your people in your absence: the Samiri has led them astray.’
te.20:86: Moses returned to his people, angry and aggrieved. He said, ‘My people, did your Lord not make you a gracious promise? Was my absence too long for you? Did you want anger to fall on you from your Lord and so broke your word to me?’
te.20:87: They said, ‘We did not break our word to you deliberately. We were burdened with the weight of people’s jewellery, so we threw it [into the fire], and the Samiri did the same,’
te.20:88: but he [used the molten jewellery to] produce an image of a calf which made a lowing sound, and they said, ‘This is your god and Moses’ god, but he has forgotten.’
te.20:89: Did they not see that [the calf] gave them no answer, that it had no power to harm or benefit them?
te.20:90: Aaron did say to them, ‘My people, this calf is a test for you. Your true Lord is the Lord of Mercy, so follow me and obey my orders,’
te.20:91: but they replied, ‘We shall not give up our devotion to it until Moses returns to us.’
te.20:92: Moses said, ‘When you realized they had gone astray, what prevented you, Aaron,
te.20:93: from coming after me? How could you disobey my orders?’
te.20:94: He said, ‘Son of my mother- let go of my beard and my hair!- I was afraid you would say, “You have caused division among the children of Israel and have not heeded what I said.”’
te.20:95: Moses said, ‘And what was the matter with you, Samiri?’
te.20:96: He replied, ‘I saw something they did not; I took in some of the teachings of the Messenger but tossed them aside: my soul prompted me to do what I did.’
te.20:97: Moses said, ‘Get away from here! Your lot in this life is to say, “Do not touch me,” but you have an appointment from which there is no escape. Look at your god which you have kept on worshipping- we shall grind it down and scatter it into the sea.
te.20:98: [People], your true god is the One God- there is no god but Him- whose knowledge embraces everything.’
te.20:99: In this way We relate to you [Prophet] stories of what happened before. We have given you a Quran from Us.
te.20:100: Whoever turns away from it will bear on the Day of Resurrection a heavy burden
te.20:101: and will remain under it. What a terrible burden to carry on that Day!
te.20:102: When the trumpet is sounded and We gather the sinful, sightless,
te.20:103: they will murmur to one another, ‘You stayed only ten days [on earth]’-
te.20:104: We know best what they say- but the more perceptive of them will say, ‘Your stay [on earth] was only a single day.’
te.20:105: They ask you [Prophet] about the mountains: say, ‘[On that Day] my Lord will blast them into dust
te.20:107: with no peak or trough to be seen.
te.20:108: On that Day, people will follow the summoner from whom there is no escape; every voice will be hushed for the Lord of Mercy; only whispers will be heard.
te.20:109: On that Day, intercession will be useless except from those to whom the Lord of Mercy has granted permission and whose words He approves-
te.20:110: He knows what is before and behind them, though they do not comprehend Him-
te.20:111: and [all] faces will be humbled before the Living, Ever Watchful One. Those burdened with evil deeds will despair,
te.20:112: but whoever has done righteous deeds and believed need have no fear of injustice or deprivation.’
te.20:113: We have sent the Quran down in the Arabic tongue and given all kinds of warnings in it, so that they may beware or take heed-
te.20:114: exalted be God, the one who is truly in control. [Prophet], do not rush to recite before the revelation is fully complete but say, ‘Lord, increase me in knowledge!’
te.20:115: We also commanded Adam before you, but he forgot and We found him lacking in constancy.
te.20:116: When We said to the angels, ‘Bow down before Adam,’ they did. But Iblis refused,
te.20:117: so We said, ‘Adam, this is your enemy, yours and your wife’s: do not let him drive you out of the garden and make you miserable.
te.20:118: In the garden you will never go hungry, feel naked,
te.20:119: be thirsty, or suffer the heat of the sun.’
te.20:120: But Satan whispered to Adam, saying, ‘Adam, shall I show you the tree of immortality and power that never decays?’
te.20:121: and they both ate from it. They became conscious of their nakedness and began to cover themselves with leaves from the garden. Adam disobeyed his Lord and was led astray-
te.20:122: later his Lord brought him close, accepted his repentance, and guided him-
te.20:123: God said, ‘Get out of the garden as each other’s enemy.’ Whoever follows My guidance, when it comes to you [people], will not go astray nor fall into misery,
te.20:124: but whoever turns away from it will have a life of great hardship. We shall bring him blind to the Assembly on the Day of Resurrection
te.20:125: and he will say, ‘Lord, why did You bring me here blind? I was sighted before!’
te.20:126: God will say, ‘This is how it is: You ignored Our revelations when they came to you, so today you will be ignored.’
te.20:127: This is how We reward those who go too far, and who do not believe in their Lord’s revelations. The greatest and most enduring punishment is in the Hereafter.
te.20:128: Do they not draw a lesson from the many generations We destroyed before them, through whose dwelling places they now walk? There truly are signs in this for anyone with understanding!
te.20:129: If it were not for a preordained Word from your Lord [Prophet], they would already have been destroyed. Their time has been set,
te.20:130: so [Prophet] be patient with what they say- celebrate the praise of your Lord, before the rising and setting of the sun, celebrate His praise during the night, and at the beginning and end of the day, so that you may find contentment-
te.20:131: and do not gaze longingly at what We have given some of them to enjoy, the finery of this present life: We test them through this, but the provision of your Lord is better and more lasting.
te.20:132: Order your people to pray, and pray steadfastly yourself. We are not asking you to give Us provision;We provide for you, and the rewards of the Hereafter belong to the devout.
te.20:133: The disbelievers say, ‘Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?’ Have they not been given clear proof confirming what was in the earlier scriptures?
te.20:134: If We had destroyed them through punishment before this Messenger came, they would have said, ‘Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we could have followed Your revelations before we suffered humiliation and disgrace!’
te.20:135: [Prophet], say, ‘We are all waiting, so you carry on waiting: you will come to learn who has followed the even path, and been rightly guided.’
te.21:1: Ever closer to people draws their reckoning, while they turn away, heedless.
te.21:2: Whenever any fresh revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it playfully
te.21:3: with frivolous hearts. The evildoers conferred in secret: ‘Is this man anything but a mortal like yourselves? Are you going to fall under his spell with your eyes wide open?’
te.21:4: He said, ‘My Lord knows everything that is said in the heavens and the earth: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.’
te.21:5: Some say, ‘Muddled dreams’; others, ‘He made it up’; yet others, ‘He is just a poet, let him show us a sign as previous messengers did.’
te.21:6: But of the communities We destroyed before them not a single one believed. Will these now believe?
te.21:7: And even before your time [Prophet], all the messengers We sent were only men We inspired–– if you [disbelievers] do not know, ask people who know the Scripture––
te.21:8: We did not give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal.
te.21:9: We fulfilled Our promise to them in the end: We saved them and those We wished to save, and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
te.21:10: And now We have sent down to you [people] a Scripture to remind you. Will you not use your reason?
te.21:11: How many communities of evildoers We have destroyed! How many others We have raised up in their places!
te.21:12: When they felt Our might coming upon them, see how they tried to escape it!
te.21:13: ‘Do not try to escape. Go back to your homes and the pleasure you revelled in: you may be questioned.’
te.21:14: They said, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
te.21:15: and that cry of theirs did not cease until We made them burnt-offstubble.
te.21:16: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them playfully.
te.21:17: If We had wished for a pastime, We could have found it within Us- if We had wished for any such thing.
te.21:18: No! We hurl the truth against falsehood, and truth obliterates it- see how falsehood vanishes away! Woe to you [people] for the way you describe God!
te.21:19: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and those that are with Him are never too proud to worship Him, nor do they grow weary;
te.21:20: they glorify Him tirelessly night and day.
te.21:21: Have they chosen any gods from the earth who can give life to the dead?
te.21:22: If there had been in the heavens or earth any gods but Him, both heavens and earth would be in ruins: God, Lord of the Throne, is far above the things they say:
te.21:23: He cannot be called to account for anything He does, whereas they will be called to account.
te.21:24: Have they chosen to worship other gods instead of Him? Say, ‘Bring your proof. This is the Scripture for those who are with me and the Scripture for those who went before me.’ But most of them do not recognize the truth, so they pay no heed.
te.21:25: We never sent any messenger before you [Muhammad] without revealing to him: ‘There is no god but Me, so serve Me.’
te.21:26: And they say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has taken offspring for Himself.’ May He be exalted! No! They are only His honoured servants:
te.21:27: they do not speak before He speaks and they act by His command.
te.21:28: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede without His permission––indeed they themselves stand in awe of Him.
te.21:29: If any of them were to claim, ‘I am a god beside Him,’ We would reward them with Hell: this is how We reward evildoers.
te.21:30: Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and the earth used to be joined together and that We ripped them apart, that We made every living thing from water? Will they not believe?
te.21:31: And We put firm mountains on the earth, lest it should sway under them, and set broad paths on it, so that they might follow the right direction,
te.21:32: and We made the sky a well-secured canopy- yet from its wonders they turn away.
te.21:33: It is He who created night and day, the sun and the moon, each floating in its orbit.
te.21:34: We have not granted everlasting life to any other human being before you either [Muhammad]- if you die, will [the disbelievers] live for ever?
te.21:35: Every soul is certain to taste death: We test you all through the bad and the good, and to Us you will all return.
te.21:36: When the disbelievers see you, they laugh at you: ‘Is this the one who talks about your gods?’ They reject any talk of the Lord of Mercy.
te.21:37: Man was created hasty: I will show you My signs soon, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
te.21:38: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
te.21:39: If the disbelievers only knew, the time will arrive when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces or their backs, and they will get no help.
te.21:40: It will come upon them suddenly and stupefy them; they will be powerless to push it away; they will not be reprieved.
te.21:41: Messengers before you [Muhammad] were also ridiculed, but those who mocked them were overwhelmed in the end by the very thing they had mocked.
te.21:42: Say, ‘Who could protect you night and day from the Lord of Mercy?’ Yet they turn away when their Lord is mentioned.
te.21:43: Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? Their gods have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
te.21:44: We have allowed these sinners and their forefathers to enjoy life for a long time. But do they not see how We are shrinking their borders? Is it they who will prevail?
te.21:45: Say, ‘I warn you only through the Revelation.’ The deaf will not hear the warning call,
te.21:46: yet if a mere breath of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they will be sure to cry, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
te.21:47: We will set up scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection so that no one can be wronged in the least, and if there should be even the weight of a mustard seed, We shall bring it out- We take excellent account.
te.21:48: We gave Moses and Aaron [the Scripture] that distinguishes right from wrong, a light and a reminder for those who are mindful of God,
te.21:49: those who stand in awe of their Lord, though He is unseen, and who fear the Hour.
te.21:50: This [Quran] too is a blessed message We have sent down- are you [people] going to deny it?
te.21:51: Long ago We bestowed right judgement on Abraham and We knew him well.
te.21:52: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are these images to which you are so devoted?’
te.21:53: They replied, ‘We found our fathers worshipping them.’
te.21:54: He said, ‘You and your fathers have clearly gone astray.’
te.21:55: They asked, ‘Have you brought us the truth or are you just playing about?’
te.21:56: He said, ‘Listen! Your true Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He who created them, and I am a witness to this.
te.21:57: By God I shall certainly plot against your idols as soon as you have turned your backs!’
te.21:58: He broke them all into pieces, but left the biggest one for them to return to.
te.21:59: They said, ‘Who has done this to our gods? How wicked he must be!’
te.21:60: Some said, ‘We heard a youth called Abraham talking about them.’
te.21:61: They said, ‘Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial].’
te.21:62: They asked, ‘Was it you, Abraham, who did this to our gods?’
te.21:63: He said, ‘No, it was done by the biggest of them- this one. Ask them, if they can talk.’
te.21:64: They turned to one another, saying, ‘It is you who are in the wrong,’
te.21:65: but then they lapsed again and said, ‘You know very well these gods cannot speak.’
te.21:66: Abraham said, ‘How can you worship what can neither benefit nor harm you, instead of God?
te.21:67: Shame on you and on the things you worship instead of God. Have you no sense?’
te.21:68: They said, ‘Burn him and avenge your gods, if you are going to do the right thing.’
te.21:69: But We said, ‘Fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.’
te.21:70: They planned to harm him, but We made them suffer the greatest loss.
te.21:71: We saved him and Lot [and sent them] to the land We blessed for all people,
te.21:72: and We gave him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, and made each of them righteous.
te.21:73: We made all of them leaders, guiding others by Our command, and We inspired them to do good works, to keep up the prayer, and to give alms: they were Our true worshippers.
te.21:74: We gave Lot sound judgement and knowledge and saved him from the community who practised obscenities- they were shameless people who broke God’s law!
te.21:75: We admitted him to Our mercy; he was a righteous man.
te.21:76: Long before that, We answered Noah when he cried out to Us: We saved him and his family from the great calamity
te.21:77: and We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs- they were evil people, so We drowned them all.
te.21:78: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgement regarding the field into which sheep strayed by night and grazed. We witnessed their judgement
te.21:79: and made Solomon understand the case [better], though We gave sound judgement and knowledge to both of them. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate Our praises with David- We did all these things-
te.21:80: We taught him how to make coats of mail for the benefit of you [people], to protect you in your wars, but are you grateful for this?
te.21:81: We harnessed the stormy wind for Solomon, so that it sped by his command to the land We had blessed- We have knowledge of all things-
te.21:82: and We made some of the jinn subservient to him, to dive for him and do other works besides. We were watching over them.
te.21:83: Remember Job, when he cried to his Lord, ‘Suffering has truly afflicted me, but you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.’
te.21:84: We answered him, removed his suffering, and restored his family to him, along with more like them, as an act of grace from Us and a reminder for all who serve Us.
te.21:85: And remember Ishmael, Idris, and Dhu’l-Kifl: they were all steadfast.
te.21:86: We admitted them to Our mercy; they were truly righteous.
te.21:87: And remember the man with the whale,when he went off angrily, thinking We could not restrict him, but then he cried out in the deep darkness, ‘There is no God but You, glory be to You, I was wrong.’
te.21:88: We answered him and saved him from distress: this is how We save the faithful.
te.21:89: Remember Zachariah, when he cried to his Lord, ‘My Lord, do not leave me childless, though You are the best of heirs.’
te.21:90: We answered him––We gave him John, and cured his wife of barrenness- they were always keen to do good deeds. They called upon Us out of longing and awe, and humbled themselves before Us.
te.21:91: Remember the one who guarded her chastity. We breathed into her from Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign for all people.
te.21:92: [Messengers], this community of yours is one single community and I am your Lord, so serve Me.
te.21:93: They have torn their unity apart, but they will all return to Us.
te.21:94: If anyone does good deeds and is a believer, his efforts will not be ignored: We record them for him.
te.21:95: No community destroyed by Us can escape its return,
te.21:96: and when the peoples of Gog and Magog are let loose and swarm swiftly from every highland,
te.21:97: when the True Promise draws near, the disbelievers’ eyes will stare in terror, and they will say, ‘Woe to us! We were not aware of this at all. We were wrong.’
te.21:98: You [disbelievers] and what you worship instead of God will be fuel for Hell: that is where you will go-
te.21:99: if these [idols] had been real gods they would not have gone there- you will all stay there.
te.21:100: There the disbelievers will be groaning piteously, but the [idols] will hear nothing.
te.21:101: But those for whom We have decreed Paradise will be kept far from Hell-
te.21:102: they will not hear a murmur from it- and endlessly they will enjoy everything their souls desire.
te.21:103: They will have no fear of the great Terror: the angels will receive them with the words, ‘This is the Day you were promised!’
te.21:104: On that Day, We shall roll up the skies as a writer rolls up [his] scrolls. We shall reproduce creation just as We produced it the first time: this is Our binding promise. We shall certainly do all these things.
te.21:105: We wrote in the Psalms, as We did in [earlier] Scripture: ‘My righteous servants will inherit the earth.’
te.21:106: There truly is a message in this for the servants of God!
te.21:107: It was only as a mercy that We sent you [Prophet] to all people.
te.21:108: Say, ‘What is revealed to me is that your God is one God- will you submit to Him?’
te.21:109: But if they turn away, say, ‘I have proclaimed the message fairly to you all. I do not know whether the judgement you are promised is near or far,
te.21:110: but He knows what you reveal and conceal.
te.21:111: I do not know: this [time] may well be a test for you, and enjoyment for a while.’
te.21:112: He said,‘My Lord, pass the true judgement.’ And, ‘Our Lord is the Lord of Mercy. We seek His assistance against what you [disbelievers] say.’
te.22:1: People, be mindful of your Lord, for the earthquake of the Last Hour will be a mighty thing:
te.22:2: on the Day you see it, every nursing mother will think no more of her baby, every pregnant female will miscarry, you will think people are drunk when they are not, so severe will be God’s torment.
te.22:3: Yet still there are some who, with no knowledge, argue about God, who follow every devilish rebel
te.22:4: fated to lead astray those who take his side, and guide them to the suffering of the blazing flame.
te.22:5: People, [remember,] if you doubt the Resurrection, that We created you from dust, then a drop of fluid, then a clinging form, then a lump of flesh, both shaped and unshaped: We mean to make Our power clear to you. Whatever We choose We cause to remain in the womb for an appointed time, then We bring you forth as infants and then you grow and reach maturity. Some die young and some are left to live on to such an age that they forget all they once knew. You sometimes see the earth lifeless, yet when We send down water it stirs and swells and produces every kind of joyous growth:
te.22:6: this is because God is the Truth; He brings the dead back to life; He has power over everything.
te.22:7: There is no doubt that the Last Hour is bound to come, nor that God will raise the dead from their graves,
te.22:8: yet still there are some who, with no knowledge or guidance or any book of enlightenment, argue about God,
te.22:9: turning scornfully aside to lead others away from God’s path. Disgrace in this world awaits such a person and, on the Day of Resurrection, We shall make him taste the suffering of the Fire.
te.22:10: [It will be said], ‘This is for what you have stored up with your own hands: God is never unjust to His creatures.’
te.22:11: There are also some who serve God with unsteady faith: if something good comes their way, they are satisfied, but if they are tested, they revert to their old ways, losing both this world and the next- that is the clearest loss.
te.22:12: Instead of God, they call upon what can neither harm nor help them- that is straying far away-
te.22:13: or invoke one whose harm is closer than his help: an evil master and an evil companion.
te.22:14: But God will admit those who believe and do good deeds to Gardens graced with flowing streams. God does whatever He wishes.
te.22:15: Anyone who thinks that God will not support him in this world and the next should stretch a rope up to the sky, climb all the way up it, and see whether this strategy removes the cause of his anger.
te.22:16: In this way, We send the Quran down as clear messages, and God guides whoever He will.
te.22:17: As for the believers, those who follow the Jewish faith, the Sabians, the Christians, the Magians, and the idolaters, God will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection; God witnesses all things.
te.22:18: Do you not realize [Prophet] that everything in the heavens and earth submits to God: the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, and the animals? So do many human beings, though for many others punishment is well deserved. Anyone disgraced by God will have no one to honour him: God does whatever He will.
te.22:19: These two kinds of people disagree about their Lord. Garments of fire will be tailored for those who disbelieve; scalding water will be poured over their heads,
te.22:20: melting their insides as well as their skins;
te.22:21: there will be iron crooks to restrain them;
te.22:22: whenever, in their anguish, they try to escape, they will be pushed back in and told, ‘Taste the suffering of the Fire.’
te.22:23: But God will admit those who believe and do good deeds to Gardens graced with flowing streams; there they will be adorned with golden bracelets and pearls; there they will have silken garments.
te.22:24: They were guided to good speech and to the path of the One Worthy of all Praise.
te.22:25: As for the disbelievers, who bar others from God’s path and from the Sacred Mosque- which We made for all people, residents and visitors alike- and who try to violate it with wrongdoing, We shall make them taste a painful punishment.
te.22:26: We showed Abraham the site of the House, saying, ‘Do not assign partners to Me. Purify My House for those who circle around it, those who stand to pray, and those who bow and prostrate themselves.
te.22:27: Proclaim the Pilgrimage to all people. They will come to you on foot and on every kind of swift mount, emerging from every deep mountain pass
te.22:28: to attain benefits and celebrate God’s name, on specified days, over the livestock He has provided for them- feed yourselves and the poor and unfortunate-
te.22:29: so let the pilgrims perform their acts of cleansing, fulfil their vows, and circle around the Ancient House.’
te.22:30: All this [is ordained by God]: anyone who honours the sacred ordinances of God will have good rewards from his Lord. Livestock have been made lawful to you, except for what has been explicitly forbidden. Shun the filth of idolatrous beliefs and practices and shun false utterances.
te.22:31: Devote yourselves to God and assign Him no partners, for the person who does so is like someone who has been hurled down from the skies and snatched up by the birds or flung to a distant place by the wind.
te.22:32: All this [is ordained by God]: those who honour God’s rites show the piety of their hearts.
te.22:33: Live-stock are useful to you until the set time. Then their place of sacrifice is near the Ancient House:
te.22:34: We appointed acts of devotion for every community, for them to celebrate God’s name over the livestock He provided for them: your God is One, so devote yourselves to Him. [Prophet], give good news to the humble
te.22:35: whose hearts fill with awe whenever God is mentioned, who endure whatever happens to them with patience, who keep up the prayer, who give to others out of Our provision to them.
te.22:36: We have made camels part of God’s sacred rites for you. There is much good in them for you, so invoke God’s name over them as they are lined up for sacrifice, then, when they have fallen down dead, feed yourselves and those who do not ask, as well as those who do. We have subjected them to you in this way so that you may be thankful.
te.22:37: It is neither their meat nor their blood that reaches God but your piety. He has subjected them to you in this way so that you may glorify God for having guided you. Give good news to those who do good:
te.22:38: God will defend the believers; God does not love the unfaithful or the ungrateful.
te.22:39: Those who have been attacked are permitted to take up arms because they have been wronged- God has the power to help them-
te.22:40: those who have been driven unjustly from their homes only for saying, ‘Our Lord is God.’ If God did not repel some people by means of others, many monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques, where God’s name is much invoked, would have been destroyed. God is sure to help those who help His cause- God is strong and mighty-
te.22:41: those who, when We establish them in the land, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, command what is right, and forbid what is wrong: God controls the outcome of all events.
te.22:42: If they reject you [Prophet], so did the people of Noah before them, and those of Ad, Thamud,
te.22:44: Midian. Moses too was called a liar. I gave the disbelievers time, but in the end I punished them. How I condemned them!
te.22:45: How many towns steeped in wrongdoing We have destroyed and left in total ruin; how many deserted wells; how many lofty palaces!
te.22:46: Have these people [of Mecca] not travelled through the land with hearts to understand and ears to hear? It is not people’s eyes that are blind, but their hearts within their breasts.
te.22:47: They will challenge you [Prophet] to hasten the punishment. God will not fail in His promise- a Day with your Lord is like a thousand years by your reckoning.
te.22:48: To many a town steeped in wrongdoing I gave more time and then struck them down: they all return to Me in the end.
te.22:49: Say [Prophet], ‘People, I am sent only to give you clear warning.’
te.22:50: Those who believe and do good deeds will be forgiven and have a generous reward,
te.22:51: but those who strive to oppose Our messages and try in vain to defeat Us are destined for the Blaze.
te.22:52: We have never sent any messenger or prophet before you [Muhammad] into whose wishes Satan did not insinuate something, but God removes what Satan insinuates and then God affirms His message. God is all knowing and wise:
te.22:53: He makes Satan’s insinuations a temptation only for the sick at heart and those whose hearts are hardened- the evildoers are profoundly opposed [to the Truth]-
te.22:54: and He causes those given knowledge to realize that this Revelation is your Lord’s Truth, so that they may believe in it and humble their hearts to Him: God guides the faithful to the straight path.
te.22:55: The disbelievers will remain in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly overpowers them or until torment descends on them on a Day devoid of all hope.
te.22:56: On that Day control will belong to God: He will judge between them. Those who believe and do good deeds will be admitted to Gardens of Delight,
te.22:57: while those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations will receive a humiliating torment.
te.22:58: He will give a generous provision to those who migrated in God’s way and were killed or died. He is the Best Provider.
te.22:59: He will admit them to a place that will please them: God is all knowing and most forbearing.
te.22:60: So it will be. God will help those who retaliate against an aggressive act merely with its like and are then wronged again: God is pardoning and most forgiving.
te.22:61: So it will be, because God makes night pass into day, and day into night, and He is all hearing and all seeing.
te.22:62: So it will be, because it is God alone who is the Truth, and whatever else they invoke is sheer falsehood: it is God who is the Most High, the Most Great.
te.22:63: Have you [Prophet] not considered how God sends water down from the sky and the next morning the earth becomes green? God is truly most subtle, all aware;
te.22:64: everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Him; God alone is self-sufficient, worthy of all praise.
te.22:65: Have you not considered how God has made everything on the earth of service to you? That ships sail the sea at His command? That He keeps the heavens from falling down on the earth without His permission? God is most compassionate and most merciful to mankind-
te.22:66: it is He who gave you [people] life, will cause you to die, then will give you life again- but man is ungrateful.
te.22:67: We have appointed acts of devotion for every community to observe, so do not let them argue with you [Prophet] about this matter. Call them to your Lord- you are on the right path-
te.22:68: and if they argue with you, say, ‘God is well aware of what you are doing.’
te.22:69: On the Day of Resurrection, God will judge between you regarding your differences.
te.22:70: Are you [Prophet] not aware that God knows all that is in the heavens and earth? All this is written in a Record; this is easy for God.
te.22:71: Yet beside God they serve that for which He has sent no authority and of which they have no knowledge: the evildoers will have no one to help them.
te.22:72: [Prophet], you can see the hostility on the faces of the disbelievers when Our messages are recited clearly to them: it is almost as if they are going to attack those who recite Our messages to them. Say, ‘Shall I tell you what is far worse than what you feel now? The Fire that God has promised the disbelievers! What a dismal end!’
te.22:73: People, here is an illustration, so listen carefully: those you call on beside God could not, even if they combined all their forces, create a fly, and if a fly took something away from them, they would not be able to retrieve it. How feeble are the petitioners and how feeble are those they petition!
te.22:74: They have no grasp of God’s true measure: God is truly most strong and mighty.
te.22:75: God chooses messengers from among the angels and from among men. God is all hearing, all seeing:
te.22:76: He knows what lies before and behind them. All matters return to Him.
te.22:77: Believers, bow down, prostrate yourselves, worship your Lord, and do good so that you may succeed.
te.22:78: Strive hard for God as is His due: He has chosen you and placed no hardship in your religion, the faith of your forefather Abraham. God has called you Muslims––both in the past and in this [message]––so that the Messenger can bear witness about you and so that you can bear witness about other people. So keep up the prayer, give the prescribed alms, and seek refuge in God: He is your protector––an excellent protector and an excellent helper.
te.23:6: except with their spouses or their slaves––with these they are not to blame,
te.23:7: but anyone who seeks more than this is exceeding the limits––
te.23:8: who are faithful to their trusts and pledges
te.23:9: and who keep up their prayers,
te.23:11: Paradise as their own, there to remain.
te.23:12: We created man from an essence of clay,
te.23:13: then We placed him as a drop of fluid in a safe place,
te.23:14: then We made that drop into a clinging form, and We made that form into a lump of flesh, and We made that lump into bones, and We clothed those bones with flesh, and later We made him into other forms––glory be to God, the best of creators!––
te.23:16: and then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be raised up again.
te.23:17: We created seven levels above you: We are never unmindful of Our creation.
te.23:18: We sent water down from the sky in due measure and lodged it in the earth––We have the power to take it all away if We so wish––
te.23:19: with it We produced for you gardens of date palms and vines, with many fruits there for you to eat,
te.23:20: and a tree, growing out of Mount Sinai, that produces oil and seasoning for your food.
te.23:21: There is a lesson for you in livestock: We produce milk for you to drink from their bellies. And they have many other benefits: you eat them
te.23:22: and you ride on them, as you do in ships.
te.23:23: We sent Noah to his people. He said, ‘My people, serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
te.23:24: But the leading disbelievers among his people said, ‘He is merely a mortal like you, trying to gain some superiority over you. God would have sent down angels if He had wished; besides, we never heard of anything like this from our forefathers.
te.23:25: He is just a madman, so let’s wait and see what happens to him.’
te.23:26: Noah said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
te.23:27: and so We revealed to him: ‘Build the Ark under Our watchful eye and according to Our revelation. When Our command comes and water gushes up out of the earth,take pairs of every species on board, and your family, except for those on whom the sentence has already been passed- do not plead with me for the evildoers: they will be drowned-
te.23:28: and when you and your companions are settled on the Ark, say, “Praise be to God, who delivered us from the wicked people,”
te.23:29: and say, “My Lord, let me land with Your blessing: it is You who provide the best landings”.’
te.23:30: There are signs in all this: We have always put [people] to the test.
te.23:31: Then We raised another generation after them,
te.23:32: and sent one of their own as a messenger: ‘Serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
te.23:33: But the leading disbelievers among his people, who denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, to whom We had granted ease and plenty in this life, said, ‘He is just a mortal like you- he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink-
te.23:34: and you will really be losers if you obey a mortal like yourselves.
te.23:35: How can he promise you that after you die and become dust and bones you will be brought out alive?
te.23:36: What you are promised is very farfetched.
te.23:37: There is only the life of this world: we die, we live, but we will never be resurrected.
te.23:38: He is just a man making lies up about God. We will never believe in him.’
te.23:39: The prophet said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
te.23:40: and so God said, ‘Soon they will be filled with regret.’
te.23:41: The blast justly struck them and We swept them away like scum. Away with the evildoers!
te.23:42: We raised other generations after them-
te.23:43: no community can advance or delay its time-
te.23:44: and We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to a community they invariably called him a liar, so We destroyed them one after the other and made them into cautionary tales. Away with the disbelievers!
te.23:45: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our signs and clear authority,
te.23:46: to Pharaoh and his prominent leaders, but they responded with arrogance: they were a haughty people.
te.23:47: They said, ‘Are we to believe in two mortals like us? And their people are our servants?’
te.23:48: and so they called them both liars: they became another ruined people.
te.23:49: We gave Moses the Scripture, so that they might be rightly guided.
te.23:50: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign; We gave them shelter on a peaceful hillside with flowing water.
te.23:51: Messengers, eat good things and do good deeds: I am well aware of what you do.
te.23:52: This community of yours is one- and I am your Lord: be mindful of Me-
te.23:53: but they have split their community into sects, each rejoicing in their own.
te.23:54: So [Muhammad] leave them for a while steeped [in their ignorance].
te.23:55: Do they reckon that, by giving them wealth and sons,
te.23:56: We race to give them good things? They really have no idea!
te.23:57: Those who stand in awe of their Lord,
te.23:59: who do not ascribe partners to Him,
te.23:60: who always give with hearts that tremble at the thought that they must return to Him,
te.23:61: are the ones who race toward good things, and they will be the first to get them.
te.23:62: We do not burden any soul with more than it can bear- We have a Record that tells the truth- they will not be wronged.
te.23:63: But the disbelievers’ hearts are steeped [in ignorance of ] all this; and there are other things besides this that they do.
te.23:64: When We bring Our punishment on those corrupted with wealth, they will cry for help:
te.23:65: ‘Do not cry out today: you will get no help from Us.
te.23:66: Time and time again My messages were recited to you, but you turned arrogantly on your heels,
te.23:67: and spent the evening making fun of [the Quran].’
te.23:68: Have they not contemplated the Word of God? Has something come to them that did not come to their forefathers?
te.23:69: Do they not recognize their Messenger? So why do they reject him?
te.23:70: Why do they say he is possessed? He has brought them the truth and most of them hate it,
te.23:71: but if the truth were in accordance with their desires, the heavens, the earth, and everyone in them would disintegrate. We have brought them their Reminder and they turn away from it.
te.23:72: Do you [Prophet] ask them for any payment? Your Lord’s is the best payment: He is the Best of Providers.
te.23:73: You call them to a straight path
te.23:74: and those who do not believe in the Hereafter turn away from that path.
te.23:75: Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve them of distress, they would blindly persist in their transgression.
te.23:76: We have already afflicted them, yet they did not submit to their Lord: they will not humble themselves
te.23:77: until We open a gate to severe torment for them- then they will be plunged into utter despair.
te.23:78: It is God who endowed you with hearing, sight, and hearts- how seldom you are grateful!
te.23:79: It is He who made you multiply on earth. It is to Him that you will be gathered:
te.23:80: it is He who gives life and death; the alternation of night and day depends on Him; will you not use your minds?
te.23:82: they say, ‘What? When we die and turn to dust and bones, shall we really be resurrected?
te.23:83: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
te.23:84: Say [Prophet], ‘Who owns the earth and all who live in it, if you know [so much]?’
te.23:85: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not take heed?’
te.23:86: Say, ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens? Who is the Lord of the Mighty Throne?’
te.23:87: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not be mindful?’
te.23:88: Say, ‘Who holds control of everything in His hand? Who protects, while there is no protection against Him, if you know [so much]?’
te.23:89: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Then how can you be so deluded?’
te.23:90: The fact is, We brought them the truth and they are lying.
te.23:91: God has never had a child. Nor is there any god beside Him- if there were, each god would have taken his creation aside and tried to overcome the others. May God be exalted above what they describe!
te.23:92: He knows what is not seen as well as what is seen; He is far above any partner they claim for Him.
te.23:93: Say, ‘Lord, if You are going to show me the punishment You have promised them,
te.23:94: then Lord, do not include me among the evildoers!’
te.23:95: We certainly are able to show you the punishment We have promised them.
te.23:96: Repel evil with good- We are well aware of what they attribute to Us-
te.23:97: and say, ‘Lord, I take refuge with You from the goadings of the evil ones;
te.23:98: I seek refuge with you, Lord, so that they may not come near me.’
te.23:99: When death comes to one of them, he cries, ‘My Lord, let me return
te.23:100: so as to make amends for the things I neglected.’ Never! This will not go beyond his words: a barrier stands behind such people until the very Day they are resurrected.
te.23:101: On that Day when the Trumpet is blown, the ties between them will be as nothing and they will not ask about each other:
te.23:102: those whose good deeds weigh heavy will be successful,
te.23:103: but those whose balance is light will have lost their souls for ever and will stay in Hell-
te.23:104: the Fire will scorch their faces and their lips will be twisted in pain.
te.23:105: ‘Were My messages not recited over and over to you and still you rejected them?’
te.23:106: They will say, ‘Lord, our waywardness overcame us and we went astray.
te.23:107: Lord, take us away from this and if we go back to our old ways, then we shall really be evildoers.’
te.23:108: He will say, ‘Away with you! In you go! Do not speak to Me!
te.23:109: Among My servants there were those who said, “Lord, We believe. Forgive us and have mercy on us: You are the most merciful of all.”
te.23:110: But you kept on laughing at them: so intent were you on laughing at them that it made you forget My warning.
te.23:111: Today I have rewarded them for their patience: it is they who will succeed.’
te.23:112: He will say, ‘How many years were you on earth?’
te.23:113: and they will reply, ‘We stayed a day or a part of a day, but ask those who keep count.’
te.23:114: He will say, ‘You stayed but a little, if you had only known.
te.23:115: Did you think We had created you in vain, and that you would not be brought back to Us?’
te.23:116: Exalted be God, the true King, there is no god but Him, the Lord of the Glorious Throne!
te.23:117: Whoever prays to another god alongside Him- a god for whose existence he has no evidence- will face his reckoning with his Lord. Those who reject the truth will not prosper.
te.23:118: Say [Prophet], ‘Lord, forgive and have mercy: You are the most merciful of all.’
te.24:1: This is a sura We have sent down and made obligatory: We have sent down clear revelations in it, so that you may take heed.
te.24:2: Strike the adulteress and the adulterer one hundred times. Do not let compassion for them keep you from carrying out God’s law––if you believe in God and the Last Day––and ensure that a group of believers witnesses the punishment.
te.24:3: The adulterer is only [fit] to marry an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress is only [fit] to marry an adulterer or an idolater: such behaviour is forbidden to believers.
te.24:4: As for those who accuse chaste women of fornication, and then fail to provide four witnesses, strike them eighty times, and reject their testimony ever afterwards: they are the lawbreakers,
te.24:5: except for those who repent later and make amends––God is most forgiving and merciful.
te.24:6: As for those who accuse their own wives of adultery, but have no other witnesses, let each one four times call God to witness that he is telling the truth,
te.24:7: and, the fifth time, call God to reject him if he is lying;
te.24:8: punishment shall be averted from his wife if she in turn four times calls God to witness that her husband is lying
te.24:9: and, the fifth time, calls God to reject her if he is telling the truth.
te.24:10: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you, if it were not that God accepts repentance and is wise . . .!
te.24:11: It was a group from among you that concocted the lie––do not consider it a bad thing for you [people]; it was a good thing––and every one of them will be charged with the sin he has earned. He who took the greatest part in it will have a painful punishment.
te.24:12: When you heard the lie, why did believing men and women not think well of their own people and declare, ‘This is obviously a lie’?
te.24:13: And why did the accusers not bring four witnesses to it? If they cannot produce such witnesses, they are the liars in God’s eyes.
te.24:14: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you in this world and the next, you would already have been afflicted by terrible suffering for indulging in such talk.
te.24:15: When you took it up with your tongues, and spoke with your mouths things you did not know [to be true], you thought it was trivial but to God it was very serious.
te.24:16: When you heard the lie, why did you not say, ‘We should not repeat this- God forbid!- It is a monstrous slander’?
te.24:17: God warns you never to do anything like this again, if you are true believers.
te.24:18: God makes His messages clear to you: God is all knowing, all wise.
te.24:19: A painful punishment waits in this world and the next for those who like indecency to spread among the believers: God knows and you do not.
te.24:20: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy and the fact that He is compassionate and merciful . . .!
te.24:21: Believers, do not follow in Satan’s footsteps- if you do so, he will urge you to indecency and evil. If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you, not one of you would ever have attained purity. God purifies whoever He will: God is all hearing, all seeing.
te.24:22: Those who have been graced with bounty and plenty should not swear that they will [no longer] give to kinsmen, the poor, those who emigrated in God’s way: let them pardon and forgive. Do you not wish that God should forgive you? God is most forgiving and merciful.
te.24:23: Those who accuse honourable but unwary believing women are rejected by God, in this life and the next. A painful punishment awaits them
te.24:24: on the Day when their own tongues, hands, and feet will testify against them about what they have done-
te.24:25: on that Day, God will pay them their just due in full- and they will realize that God is the Truth that makes everything clear.
te.24:26: Corrupt women are for corrupt men, and corrupt men are for corrupt women; good women are for good men and good men are for good women. The good are innocent of what has been said against them; they will have forgiveness and a generous provision.
te.24:27: Believers, do not enter other people’s houses until you have asked permission to do so and greeted those inside- that is best for you: perhaps you will bear this in mind.
te.24:28: If you find no one in, do not enter unless you have been given permission to do so. If you are told, ‘Go away’, then do so- that is more proper for you. God knows well what you do.
te.24:29: You will not be blamed for entering houses where no one lives, and which could provide you with some useful service. God knows everything you do openly and everything you conceal.
te.24:30: [Prophet], tell believing men to lower their glances and guard their private parts: that is purer for them. God is well aware of everything they do.
te.24:31: And tell believing women that they should lower their glances, guard their private parts, and not display their charms beyond what [it is acceptable] to reveal; they should let their headscarves fall to cover their necklines and not reveal their charms except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands’ fathers, their sons, their husbands’ sons, their brothers, their brothers’ sons, their sisters’ sons, their womenfolk, their slaves, such men as attend them who have no sexual desire, or children who are not yet aware of women’s nakedness; they should not stamp their feet so as to draw attention to any hidden charms. Believers, all of you, turn to God so that you may prosper.
te.24:32: Marry off the single among you and those of your male and female slaves who are fit [for marriage]. If they are poor, God will provide for them from His bounty: God’s bounty is infinite and He is all knowing.
te.24:33: Those who are unable to marry should keep chaste until God gives them enough out of His bounty. If any of your slaves wish to pay for their freedom, make a contract with them accordingly, if you know they have good in them, and give them some of the wealth God has given you. Do not force your slave-girls into prostitution, when they themselves wish to remain honourable, in your quest for the short-term gains of this world, although, if they are forced, God will be forgiving and merciful to them.
te.24:34: We have sent verses down to you [people] clarifying the right path, examples of those who passed away before you, and advice for those who are mindful of God.
te.24:35: God is the Light of the heavens and earth. His Light is like this: there is a niche, and in it a lamp, the lamp inside a glass, a glass like a glittering star, fuelled from a blessed olive tree from neither east nor west, whose oil almost gives light even when no fire touches it- light upon light- God guides whoever He will to his Light; God draws such comparisons for people; God has full knowledge of everything-
te.24:36: shining out in houses of worship. God has ordained that they be raised high and that His name be remembered in them, with men in them celebrating His glory morning and evening:
te.24:37: men who are not distracted, either by commerce or profit, from remembering God, keeping up the prayer, and paying the prescribed alms, fearing a day when hearts and eyes will turn over.
te.24:38: God will reward such people according to the best of their actions, and He will give them more of His bounty: God provides limitlessly for anyone He will.
te.24:39: But the deeds of those who disbelieve are like a mirage in a desert: the thirsty person thinks there will be water but, when he gets there, he finds only God, who pays him his account in full- God is swift in reckoning.
te.24:40: Or like shadows in a deep sea covered by wave upon wave, with clouds above- layer upon layer of darkness- if he holds out his hand, he is scarcely able to see it. The one to whom God gives no light has no light at all.
te.24:41: [Prophet], do you not see that all those who are in the heavens and earth praise God, as do the birds with wings outstretched? Each knows its [own way] of prayer and glorification: God has full knowledge of what they do.
te.24:42: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to God: and to God is the final return.
te.24:43: Do you not see that God drives the clouds, then gathers them together and piles them up until you see rain pour from their midst? He sends hail down from [such] mountains in the sky, pouring it on whoever He wishes and diverting it from whoever He wishes- the flash of its lightning almost snatches sight away.
te.24:44: God alternates night and day- there truly is a lesson in [all] this for those who have eyes to see-
te.24:45: and God created each animal out of [its own] fluid: some of them crawl on their bellies, some walk on two legs, and some on four. God creates whatever He will; God has power over everything.
te.24:46: We have sent verses that clarify the right path: God guides whoever He will to a straight path.
te.24:47: They say, ‘We believe in God and the Messenger; we obey,’ but then some of them turn away: these people are not true believers
te.24:48: and when they are summoned to God and His Messenger in order for him to judge between them, some of them turn away.
te.24:49: If they were claiming their right, they would come willingly [to the Prophet].
te.24:50: Do they have sickness in their hearts? Are they full of doubts? Do they fear that God and His Messenger might deal with them unjustly? No, it is they who are the unjust ones.
te.24:51: When the true believers are summoned to God and His Messenger in order for him to judge between them, they say, ‘We hear and we obey.’ These are the ones who will prosper:
te.24:52: whoever obeys God and His Messenger, stands in awe of God, and keeps his duty to Him will be triumphant.
te.24:53: [The others] solemnly swear by God that if you [Prophet] commanded them, they would march out. Tell them, ‘Do not swear: it is reasonable obedience that is required, and God is aware of everything you do.’
te.24:54: Say, ‘Obey God; obey the Messenger. If you turn away, [know that] he is responsible for the duty placed upon him, and you are responsible for the duty placed upon you. If you obey him, you will be rightly guided, but the Messenger’s duty is only to deliver the message clearly.’
te.24:55: God has made a promise to those among you who believe and do good deeds: He will make them successors to the land, as He did those who came before them; He will empower the religion He has chosen for them; He will grant them security to replace their fear. ‘They will worship Me and not join anything with Me.’ Those who are defiant after that will be the rebels.-
te.24:56: [People], keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and obey the Messenger, so that you may be given mercy.
te.24:57: Do not think [Prophet] that the disbelievers can escape God on earth; the Fire will be their final home, an evil end.
te.24:58: Believers, your slaves and any who have not yet reached puberty should ask your permission to come in at three times of day: before the dawn prayer; when you lay your garments aside in the midday heat; and after the evening prayer. These are your three times for privacy; at other times, there is no blame on you or them if you move around each other freely. In this way God makes messages clear: God is all knowing, all wise.
te.24:59: When your children reach puberty, they should [always] ask your permission to enter, like their elders do. This is how God makes His messages clear to you: God is all knowing, all wise.
te.24:60: No blame will be attached to elderly women who are not hoping for sex, if they take off their outer garments without flaunting their charms, but it is preferable for them not to do this: God is all hearing, all seeing.
te.24:61: No blame will be attached to the blind, the lame, the sick.Whether you eat in your own houses, or those of your fathers, your mothers, your brothers, your sisters, your paternal uncles, your paternal aunts, your maternal uncles, your maternal aunts, houses you have the keys for, or any of your friends’ houses, you will not be blamed: you will not be blamed whether you eat in company or separately. When you enter any house, greet one another with a greeting of blessing and goodness as enjoined by God. This is how God makes His messages clear to you so that you may understand.
te.24:62: The true believers are those who believe in God and His Mes-senger, who, when they are gathered with him on a communal matter, do not depart until they have asked his permission- those who ask your permission [Prophet] are the ones who truly believe in God and His Messenger. When they ask your permission to attend to their private affairs, allow whoever you see fit and ask God to forgive them. God is most forgiving and merciful.
te.24:63: [People], do not regard the Messenger’s summons to you like one of you summoning another- God is well aware of those of you who steal away surreptitiously- and those who go against his order should beware lest a trial afflict them or they receive a painful punishment.
te.24:64: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God: He knows what state you are in- on the Day when all are returned to Him, He will tell them everything they have done- God has full knowledge of everything.
te.25:1: Exalted is He who has sent the Differentiator down to His servant so that it may be a warning to all people.
te.25:2: It is He who has control over the heavens and earth and has no offspring––no one shares control with Him––and who created all things and made them to an exact measure.
te.25:3: Yet the disbelievers take as their gods things beneath Him that create nothing, and are themselves created, that can neither harm nor help themselves, and have no control over death, life, or resurrection.
te.25:4: The disbelievers say, ‘This can only be a lie he has forged with the help of others’––they themselves have done great wrong and told lies––
te.25:5: and they say, ‘It is just ancient fables, which he has had written down: they are dictated to him morning and evening.’
te.25:6: Say, ‘It was sent down by Him who knows the secrets of the heavens and earth. He is all forgiving, all merciful.’
te.25:7: They also say, ‘What sort of messenger is this? He eats food and walks about in the marketplaces! Why has no angel been sent down to help him with his warnings?
te.25:8: Why has he not been given treasure or a garden to supply his food?’ and the evildoers say, ‘The man you follow is simply under a spell.’
te.25:9: See what they think you are like! They have gone astray and cannot find the right way.
te.25:10: Exalted is He who can, if He wishes, give you better things than these: Gardens graced with flowing streams, and palaces too.
te.25:11: It is actually the coming of the Hour that they reject: We have prepared a blazing fire for those who reject the Hour.
te.25:12: When it sees them from a distance, they will hear it raging and roaring,
te.25:13: and when they are hurled into a narrow part of it, chained together, they will cry out for death.
te.25:14: ‘Do not cry out this day for one death, but for many.’
te.25:15: Say, ‘Which is better, this or the lasting Garden that those who are mindful of God have been promised as their reward and journey’s end?’
te.25:16: There they will find everything they wish for, and there they will stay. [Prophet], this is a binding promise from your Lord.
te.25:17: On the Day He gathers them all together with those they worship beside Him, He will say, ‘Was it you [false gods] who led these creatures of Mine astray, or did they stray from the path by themselves?’
te.25:18: They will say, ‘May You be exalted! We ourselves would never take masters other than You! But You granted them and their forefathers pleasures in this life, until they forgot Your Reminder and were ruined.’
te.25:19: [God will say], ‘Now your gods have denounced what you say as lies: you cannot avoid the punishment; you will not get any help.’ If any of you commits such evil, We shall make him taste agonizing torment.
te.25:20: No messenger have We sent before you [Muhammad] who did not eat food and walk about in the marketplace. But We have made some of you a means of testing others- will you stand fast? Your Lord is always watching.
te.25:21: Those who do not fear to meet Us say, ‘Why are the angels not sent down to us?’ or ‘Why can we not see our Lord?’ They are too proud of themselves and too insolent.
te.25:22: There will be no good news for the guilty on the Day they see the angels. The angels will say, ‘You cannot cross the forbidden barrier,’
te.25:23: and We shall turn to the deeds they have done and scatter them like dust.
te.25:24: But the companions in the Garden will have a better home on that Day, and a fairer place to rest.
te.25:25: On the Day when the sky and its clouds are split apart and the angels sent down in streams,
te.25:26: on that Day, true authority belongs to the Lord of Mercy. It will be a grievous Day for the disbelievers.
te.25:27: On that Day the evildoer will bite his own hand and say, ‘If only I had taken the same path as the Messenger.
te.25:28: Woe is me! If only I had not taken so and so as a friend-
te.25:29: he led me away from the Revelation after it reached me. Satan has always betrayed mankind.’
te.25:30: The Messenger has said, ‘Lord, my people treat this Quran as something to be shunned,’
te.25:31: but We have always appointed adversaries from the wicked, for every prophet: Your Lord is sufficient guide and helper.
te.25:32: The disbelievers also say, ‘Why was the Quran not sent down to him all at once?’ We sent it in this way to strengthen your heart [Prophet]; We gave it to you in gradual revelation.
te.25:33: They cannot put any argument to you without Our bringing you the truth and the best explanation.
te.25:34: It is those driven [falling], on their faces,to Hell who will be in the worst place- they are the furthest from the right path.
te.25:35: We gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron to help him.
te.25:36: We said, ‘Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs.’ Later We destroyed those people utterly.
te.25:37: The people of Noah, too: when they rejected their messengers, We drowned them and made them an example to all people. We have prepared a painful torment for the evildoers,
te.25:38: as We did for the people of Ad, Thamud, and al-Rass, and many generations in between.
te.25:39: To each of them We gave warnings, and each of them We destroyed completely.
te.25:40: These disbelievers must have passed by the town that was destroyed by the terrible rain––did they not see it? Yet they do not expect to be raised from the dead.
te.25:41: Whenever they see you [Prophet] they ridicule you: ‘Is this the one God has sent as a messenger?
te.25:42: He might almost have led us astray from our gods if we had not stood so firmly by them.’ When they see the punishment, they will know who is furthest from the path.
te.25:43: Think [Prophet] of the man who has taken his own passion as a god: are you to be his guardian?
te.25:44: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are just like cattle- no, they are further from the path.
te.25:45: Do you not see how your Lord lengthens the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it stand still- We made the sun its indicator-
te.25:46: but We gradually draw it towards Us, little by little.
te.25:47: It is He who made the night a garment for you, and sleep a rest, and made the day like a resurrection.
te.25:48: It is He who sends the winds as heralds of good news before His Mercy. We send down pure water from the sky,
te.25:49: so that We can revive a dead land with it, and We give it as a drink to many animals and people We have created.
te.25:50: Many times We have repeated this to people so that they might take heed, but most persist in their ingratitude.
te.25:51: If it had been Our will, We would have sent a warner to every town,
te.25:52: so do not give in to the disbelievers: strive hard against them with this Quran.
te.25:53: It is He who released the two bodies of flowing water, one sweet and fresh and the other salty and bitter, and put an insurmountable barrier between them.
te.25:54: It is He who creates human beings from fluid, then makes them kin by blood and marriage: your Lord is all powerful!
te.25:55: Yet instead of God they worship things that can neither benefit nor harm them: the disbeliever has always turned his back on his Lord.
te.25:56: We sent you only to give good news and warning.
te.25:57: Say, ‘I am not asking for any reward for it, but anyone who wishes should take a path to his Lord.’
te.25:58: Put your trust in the Living [God] who never dies, and celebrate His praise. He knows the sins of His servants well enough:
te.25:59: it is He who created the heavens and earth and what is between them in six Days, and then established Himself on the throne- He is the Lord of Mercy; He is the Best Informed.
te.25:60: Yet when they are told, ‘Bow down before the Lord of Mercy,’ they say, ‘What is the Lord of Mercy? Should we bow down before anything you command?’ and they turn even further away.
te.25:61: Exalted is He who put constellations in the heavens, a radiant light, and an illuminating moon-
te.25:62: it is He who made the night and day follow each other- so anyone who wishes may be mindful or show gratitude.
te.25:63: The servants of the Lord of Mercy are those who walk humbly on the earth, and who, when the foolish address them, reply, ‘Peace’;
te.25:64: those who spend the night bowed down or standing, worshipping their Lord,
te.25:65: who plead, ‘Our Lord, turn away from us the suffering of Hell, for it is a dreadful torment to suffer!
te.25:66: It is an evil home, a foul resting place!’
te.25:67: They are those who are neither wasteful nor niggardly when they spend, but keep to a just balance;
te.25:68: those who never invoke any other deity beside God, nor take a life, which God has made sacred, except in the pursuit of justice, nor commit adultery. (Whoever does these things will face the penalties:
te.25:69: their torment will be doubled on the Day of Resurrection, and they will remain in torment, disgraced,
te.25:70: except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds: God will change the evil deeds of such people into good ones. He is most forgiving, most merciful.
te.25:71: People who repent and do good deeds truly return to God.)
te.25:72: [The servants of the Lord of Mercy are] those who do not give false testimony, and who, when they see some frivolity, pass by with dignity;
te.25:73: who, when reminded of their Lord’s signs, do not turn a deaf ear and a blind eye to them;
te.25:74: those who pray, ‘Our Lord, give us joy in our spouses and offspring. Make us good examples to those who are aware of You’.
te.25:75: These servants will be rewarded with the highest place in Paradise for their steadfastness. There they will be met with greetings and peace.
te.25:76: There they will stay- a happy home and resting place!
te.25:77: [Prophet, tell the disbelievers], ‘What are you to my Lord without your supplication? But since you have written offthe truth as lies, the inevitable will happen.’
te.26:2: These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear:
te.26:3: [Prophet], are you going to worry yourself to death because they will not believe?
te.26:4: If We had wished, We could have sent them down a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in utter humility.
te.26:5: Whenever they are brought a new revelation from the Lord of Mercy, they turn away:
te.26:6: they deny it, but the truth of what they scorned will soon hit them.
te.26:7: Do they not see the earth, and what noble kinds of thing We grow in it?
te.26:8: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
te.26:9: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
te.26:10: Your Lord called to Moses: ‘Go to those wrongdoers,
te.26:11: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not take heed?’
te.26:12: Moses said, ‘My Lord, I fear they will call me a liar,
te.26:13: and I will feel stressed and tongue-tied, so send Aaron too;
te.26:14: besides, they have a chargeagainst me, and I fear they may kill me.’
te.26:15: God said, ‘No [they will not]. Go, both of you, with Our signs––We shall be with you, listen-ing.
te.26:16: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, “We bring a message from the Lord of the Worlds:
te.26:17: let the Children of Israel leave with us.” ’
te.26:18: Pharaoh said, ‘Did we not bring you up as a child among us? Did you not stay with us for many years?
te.26:19: And then you committed that crime of yours: you were so ungrateful.’
te.26:20: Moses replied, ‘I was misguided when I did it
te.26:21: and I fled from you in fear; later my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of His messengers.
te.26:22: And is this- that you have enslaved the Children of Israel- the favour with which you reproach me?’
te.26:23: Pharaoh asked, ‘What is this “Lord of the Worlds”?’
te.26:24: Moses replied, ‘He is the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them. If you would only have faith!’
te.26:25: Pharaoh said to those present, ‘Do you hear what he says?’
te.26:26: Moses said, ‘He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.’
te.26:27: Pharaoh said, ‘This messenger who has been sent to you is truly possessed.’
te.26:28: Moses continued, ‘Lord of the East and West and everything between them. If you would only use your reason!’
te.26:29: But Pharaoh said [to him], ‘If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison,’
te.26:30: and Moses asked, ‘Even if I show you something convincing?’
te.26:31: ‘Show it then,’ said Pharaoh, ‘if you are telling the truth.’
te.26:32: So Moses threw down his staff and- lo and behold!- it became a snake for everyone to see.
te.26:33: Then he drew out his hand and- lo and behold!- it was white for the onlookers to see.
te.26:34: Pharaoh said to the counsellors around him, ‘This man is a learned sorcerer!
te.26:35: He means to use his sorcery to drive you out of your land! What do you suggest?’
te.26:36: They answered, ‘Delay him and his brother for a while, and send messengers to all the cities
te.26:37: to bring every accomplished sorcerer to you.’
te.26:38: The sorcerers were [to be] assembled at the appointed time on a certain day
te.26:39: and the people were asked, "Are you all coming?
te.26:40: We may follow the sorcerers if they win!"
te.26:41: When the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we be rewarded if we win?’
te.26:42: and he said, ‘Yes, and you will join my inner court.’
te.26:43: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you will.’
te.26:44: They threw their ropes and staffs, saying, ‘By Pharaoh’s might, we shall be victorious.’
te.26:45: But Moses threw his staff and- lo and behold!- it swallowed up their trickery
te.26:46: and the sorcerers fell down on their knees,
te.26:47: exclaiming, ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
