te.26:48: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’
te.26:49: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be the master who taught you sorcery! Soon you will see: I will cut off your alternate hands and feet and then crucify the lot of you!’
te.26:50: ‘That will do us no harm,’ they said, ‘for we are sure to return to our Lord.
te.26:51: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we were the first to believe.’
te.26:52: Then We revealed Our will to Moses, ‘Leave with My servants by night, for you will be pursued!’
te.26:53: Pharaoh sent messengers into the cities, proclaiming,
te.26:56: and we are a large army, on the alert.’
te.26:57: So it was that We made them leave their gardens and their springs,
te.26:58: their treasures and their noble dwellings-
te.26:59: We gave [such] things [later]to the Children of Israel.
te.26:60: Pharaoh and his people pursued them at sunrise,
te.26:61: and as soon as the two sides came within sight of one another, Moses’ followers said, ‘We shall definitely be caught.’
te.26:62: Moses said, ‘No, my Lord is with me: He will guide me,’
te.26:63: and We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff.’ It parted- each side like a mighty mountain-
te.26:64: and We brought the others to that place:
te.26:65: We saved Moses and all his companions,
te.26:67: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
te.26:68: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
te.26:69: Tell them the story of Abraham,
te.26:70: when he asked his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’
te.26:71: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constantly in attendance on them.’
te.26:72: He asked, ‘Do they hear you when you call?
te.26:73: Do they help or harm you?’
te.26:74: They replied, ‘No, but this is what we saw our fathers doing.’
te.26:75: Abraham said, ‘Those idols you have worshipped,
te.26:77: are my enemies; not so the Lord of the Worlds,
te.26:78: who created me. It is He who guides me;
te.26:79: He who gives me food and drink;
te.26:80: He who cures me when I am ill;
te.26:81: He who will make me die and then give me life again;
te.26:82: and He who will, I hope, forgive my faults on the Day of Judgement.
te.26:83: My Lord, grant me wisdom; join me with the righteous;
te.26:84: give me a good name among later generations;
te.26:85: make me one of those given the Garden of Bliss-
te.26:86: forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray-
te.26:87: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all people are resurrected:
te.26:88: the Day when neither wealth nor children can help,
te.26:89: when the only one who will be saved is the one who comes before God with a heart devoted to Him.’
te.26:90: When the Garden is brought near to the righteous
te.26:91: and the Fire is placed in full view of the misguided,
te.26:92: it will be said to them, ‘Where are those you worshipped
te.26:93: beside God? Can they help you now, or even help themselves?’
te.26:94: and then they will all be hurled into Hell, together with those that misled them,
te.26:96: There they will say to their gods, as they bicker among themselves,
te.26:98: when we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
te.26:99: It was the evildoers who led us astray,
te.26:100: and now we have no intercessor
te.26:102: If only we could live our lives again, we would be true believers!’
te.26:103: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
te.26:104: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
te.26:105: The people of Noah, too, called the messengers liars.
te.26:106: Their brother Noah said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
te.26:107: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
te.26:108: be mindful of God and obey me.
te.26:109: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds:
te.26:110: be mindful of God and obey me.’
te.26:111: They answered, ‘Why should we believe you when the worst sort of people follow you?’
te.26:112: He said, ‘What knowledge do I have of what they used to do?
te.26:113: It is for my Lord alone to bring them to account- if only you could see-
te.26:114: I will not drive believers away.
te.26:115: I am here only to give people a clear warning.’
te.26:116: So they said, ‘Noah, if you do not stop this, you will be stoned.’
te.26:117: He said, ‘My Lord, my people have rejected me,
te.26:118: so make a firm judgement between me and them, and save me and my believing followers.’
te.26:119: So We saved him and his followers in the fully laden ship,
te.26:121: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
te.26:122: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
te.26:123: The people of Ad, too, called the messengers liars.
te.26:124: Their brother Hud said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
te.26:125: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
te.26:126: be mindful of God and obey me.
te.26:127: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
te.26:128: How can you be so vain that you set up monuments on every high place?
te.26:129: Do you build fortresses because you hope to be immortal?
te.26:130: Why do you act like tyrants whenever you attack someone?
te.26:131: Be mindful of God and obey me;
te.26:132: be mindful of Him who has provided you with everything you know-
te.26:133: He has given you livestock, sons,
te.26:135: for I truly fear that the torment of a grievous day will overtake you.’
te.26:136: They replied, ‘It makes no difference to us whether you warn us or not,
te.26:137: for we only do what our forefathers used to do:
te.26:139: They denounced him as a liar, and so We destroyed them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
te.26:140: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
te.26:141: The people of Thamud, too, called the messengers liars.
te.26:142: Their brother Salih said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
te.26:143: I am a faithful messenger to you:
te.26:144: be mindful of God and obey me.
te.26:145: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
te.26:146: [Do you think] you will be left secure for ever in what you have here-
te.26:148: fields, palm trees laden with fruit-
te.26:149: carving your fine houses from the mountains?
te.26:150: Be mindful of God and obey me:
te.26:151: do not obey those who are given to excess
te.26:152: and who spread corruption in the land instead of doing what is right.’
te.26:154: You are nothing but a man like us. Show us a sign, if you are telling the truth.’
te.26:155: He said, ‘Here is a camel. She should have her turn to drink and so should you, each on a specified day,
te.26:156: so do not harm her, or the punishment of a terrible day will befall you.’
te.26:157: But they hamstrung her. In the morning they had cause to regret it:
te.26:158: the punishment fell upon them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
te.26:159: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
te.26:160: The people of Lot, too, called the messengers liars.
te.26:161: Their brother Lot said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
te.26:162: I am a faithful messenger to you:
te.26:163: be mindful of God and obey me.
te.26:164: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
te.26:165: Must you, unlike [other] people, lust after males
te.26:166: and abandon the wives that God has created for you? You are exceeding all bounds,’
te.26:167: but they replied, ‘Lot! If you do not stop this, you will be driven away.’
te.26:168: So he said, ‘I loathe what you do:
te.26:169: Lord, save me and my family from what they are doing.’
te.26:170: We saved him and all his family,
te.26:171: except for an old woman who stayed behind,
te.26:173: and poured a rain of destruction down upon them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been forewarned!
te.26:174: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
te.26:175: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
te.26:176: The forest-dwellers, too, called the messengers liars.
te.26:177: Shuayb said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
te.26:178: I am a faithful messenger to you:
te.26:179: be mindful of God and obey me.
te.26:180: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
te.26:181: Give full measure: do not sell others short.
te.26:183: do not deprive people of what is theirs. Do not spread corruption on earth.
te.26:184: Be mindful of God who created you and former generations,’
te.26:186: You are nothing but a man like us. In fact we think you are a liar.
te.26:187: Make bits of the heavens fall down on us, if you are telling the truth.’
te.26:188: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you do.’
te.26:189: They called him a liar, and so the torment of the Day of Shadow came upon them- it was the torment of a terrible day.
te.26:190: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
te.26:191: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
te.26:192: Truly, this Quran has been sent down by the Lord of the Worlds:
te.26:193: the Trustworthy Spirit brought it down
te.26:194: to your heart [Prophet], so that you could bring warning
te.26:196: This was foretold in the scriptures of earlier religions.
te.26:197: Is it not proof enough for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel have recognized it?
te.26:198: If We had sent it down to someone who was not an Arab,
te.26:199: and he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.
te.26:200: So We make it pass straight through the hearts of the guilty:
te.26:201: they will not believe in it until they see the grievous torment,
te.26:202: which will suddenly hit them when they are not expecting it,
te.26:203: and then they will say, ‘Can we have more time?’
te.26:204: How can they ask that Our punishment be brought to them sooner?
te.26:205: Think, if we let them enjoy this life for some years
te.26:206: and then the promised torment came upon them,
te.26:207: what good would their past enjoyment be to them?
te.26:208: Never have We destroyed a town without sending down messengers to warn it,
te.26:209: as a reminder from Us: We are never unjust.
te.26:210: It was not the jinn who brought down this Quran:
te.26:211: it is neither in their interests nor in their power,
te.26:212: indeed they are prevented from overhearing it.
te.26:213: So [Prophet] do not invoke any gods beside God, or you will incur punishment.
te.26:215: and lower your wing tenderly over the believers who follow you.
te.26:216: If they disobey you, say, ‘I bear no responsibility for your actions.’
te.26:217: Put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful,
te.26:218: who sees you when you stand up [for prayer]
te.26:219: and sees your movements among the worshippers:
te.26:220: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
te.26:221: Shall I tell you who the jinn come down to?
te.26:222: They come down to every lying sinner
te.26:223: who readily lends an ear to them, and most of them are liars:
te.26:224: only those who are lost in error follow the poets.
te.26:225: Do you not see how they rove aimlessly in every valley;
te.26:226: how they say what they do not do?
te.26:227: Not so those [poets] who believe, do good deeds, remember God often, and defend themselves after they have been wronged. The evildoers will find out what they will return to.
te.27:1: Ta Sin These are the verses of the Quran––a scripture that makes things clear;
te.27:2: a guide and joyful news for the believers
te.27:3: who keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and believe firmly in the life to come.
te.27:4: As for those who do not believe in the life to come, We have made their deeds seem alluring to them, so they wander blindly:
te.27:5: it is they who will have the worst suffering, and will be the ones to lose most in the life to come.
te.27:6: You [Prophet] receive the Quran from One who is all wise, all knowing.
te.27:7: Moses said to his family, ‘I have seen a fire. I will bring you news from there, or a burning stick for you to warm yourselves.’
te.27:8: When he reached the fire, a voice called: ‘Blessed is the person near this fireand those around it; may God be exalted, the Lord of the Worlds.
te.27:9: Moses, I am God, the Mighty, the Wise.
te.27:10: Throw down your staff,’ but when he saw it moving like a snake, he turned and fled. ‘Moses, do not be afraid! The messengers need have no fear in My presence,
te.27:11: I am truly most forgiving and merciful to those who do wrong,and then replace their evil with good.
te.27:12: Put your hand inside your cloak and it will come out white, but unharmed. These are among the nine signs that you will show Pharaoh and his people; they have really gone too far.’
te.27:13: But when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, ‘This is clearly [just] sorcery!’
te.27:14: They denied them, in their wickedness and their pride, even though their souls acknowledged them as true. See how those who spread corruption met their end!
te.27:15: We gave knowledge to David and Solomon, and they both said, ‘Praise be to God, who has favoured us over many of His believing servants.’
te.27:16: Solomon succeeded David. He said, ‘People, we have been taught the speech of birds, and we have been given a share of everything: this is a clearly a great favour.’
te.27:17: Solomon’s hosts of jinn, men, and birds were marshalled in ordered ranks before him,
te.27:18: and when they came to the Valley of the Ants, one ant said, ‘Ants! Go into your homes, in case Solomon and his hosts unwittingly crush you.’
te.27:19: Solomon smiled broadly at her words and said, ‘Lord, inspire me to be thankful for the blessings You have granted me and my parents, and to do good deeds that please You; admit me by Your grace into the ranks of Your righteous servants.’
te.27:20: Solomon inspected the birds and said, ‘Why do I not see the hoopoe? Is he absent?
te.27:21: I will punish him severely, or kill him, unless he brings me a convincing excuse for his absence.’
te.27:22: But the hoopoe did not stay away long: he came and said, ‘I have learned something you did not know: I come to you from Sheba with firm news.
te.27:23: I found a woman ruling over the people, who has been given a share of everything- she has a magnificent throne-
te.27:24: [but] I found that she and her people worshipped the sun instead of God. Satan has made their deeds seem alluring to them, and diverted them from the right path: they cannot find the right path.
te.27:25: Should they not worship God, who brings forth what is hidden in the heavens and earth and knows both what you people conceal and what you declare?
te.27:26: He is God, there is no god but Him, the Lord of the mighty throne.’
te.27:27: Solomon said, ‘We shall see whether you are telling the truth or lying.
te.27:28: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them, then withdraw and see what answer they send back.’
te.27:29: The Queen of Sheba said, ‘Counsellors, a gracious letter has been delivered to me.
te.27:30: It is from Solomon, and it says, “In the name of God, the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy,
te.27:31: do not put yourselves above me, and come to me in submission to God.”’
te.27:32: She said, ‘Counsellors, give me your counsel in the matter I now face: I only ever decide on matters in your presence.’
te.27:33: They replied, ‘We possess great force and power in war, but you are in command, so consider what orders to give us.’
te.27:34: She said, ‘Whenever kings go into a city, they ruin it and humiliate its leaders- that is what they do-
te.27:35: but I am going to send them a gift, then see what answer my envoys bring back.’
te.27:36: When her envoy came to Solomon, Solomon said, ‘What! Are you offering me wealth? What God has given me is better than what He has given you, though you rejoice in this gift of yours.
te.27:37: Go back to your people: we shall certainly come upon them with irresistible forces, and drive them, disgraced and humbled, from their land.’
te.27:38: Then he said, ‘Counsellors, which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?’
te.27:39: A powerful and crafty jinn replied, ‘I will bring it to you before you can even rise from your place. I am strong and trustworthy enough,’
te.27:40: but one of them who had some knowledge of the Scripture said, ‘I will bring it to you in the twinkling of an eye.’ When Solomon saw it set before him, he said, ‘This is a favour from my Lord, to test whether I am grateful or not: if anyone is grateful, it is for his own good, if anyone is ungrateful, then my Lord is self-sufficient and most generous.’
te.27:41: Then he said, ‘Disguise her throne, and we shall see whether or not she recognizes it.’
te.27:42: When she arrived, she was asked, ‘Is this your throne?’ She replied, ‘It looks like it.’ [Solomon said], ‘We were given knowledge before her, and we devoted ourselves to God;
te.27:43: she was prevented by what she worshipped instead of God, for she came from a disbelieving people.’
te.27:44: Then it was said to her, ‘Enter the hall,’ but when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pool of water, and bared her legs. Solomon explained, ‘It is just a hall paved with glass,’ and she said, ‘My Lord, I have wronged myself: I devote myself, with Solomon, to God, the Lord of the Worlds.’
te.27:45: To the people of Thamud We sent their brother, Salih, saying, ‘Worship God alone,’ but they split into two rival factions.
te.27:46: Salih said, ‘My people, why do you rush to bring [forward] what is bad rather than good? Why do you not ask forgiveness of God, so that you may be given mercy?’
te.27:47: They said, ‘We see you and your fol-lowers as an evil omen.’ He replied, ‘God will decide on any omen you may see: you people are being put to the test.’
te.27:48: There were nine men in the city who spread corruption in the land without making amends.
te.27:49: They said, ‘Swear by God: we shall attack this man and his household in the night, then say to his next of kin, “We did not witness the destruction of his household. We are telling the truth.”’
te.27:50: So they devised their evil plan, but We too made a plan of which they were unaware.
te.27:51: See how their scheming ended: We destroyed them utterly, along with all their people.
te.27:52: As a result of their evil deeds, their homes are desolate ruins- there truly is a sign in this for those who know-
te.27:53: but We saved those who believed and were mindful of God.
te.27:54: We also sent Lot to his people. He said to them, ‘How can you commit this outrage with your eyes wide open?
te.27:55: How can you lust after men instead of women? What fools you are!’
te.27:56: The only answer his people gave was to say, ‘Expel Lot’s followers from your town! These men mean to stay chaste!’
te.27:57: We saved him and his family- except for his wife: We made her stay behind-
te.27:58: and We brought rain down on them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been warned!
te.27:59: Say [Prophet], ‘Praise be to God and peace on the servants He has chosen. Who is better: God, or those they set up as partners with Him?
te.27:60: Who created the heavens and earth? Who sends down water from the sky for you- with which We cause gardens of delight to grow: you have no power to make the trees grow in them- is it another god beside God? No! But they are people who take others to be equal with God.
te.27:61: Who is it that made the earth a stable place to live? Who made rivers flow through it? Who set immovable mountains on it and created a barrier between the fresh and salt water? Is it another god beside God? No! But most of them do not know.
te.27:62: Who is it that answers the distressed when they call upon Him? Who removes their suffering? Who makes you successors in the earth? Is it another god beside God? Little notice you take!
te.27:63: Who is it that guides you through the darkness on land and sea? Who sends the winds as heralds of good news before His mercy? Is it another god beside God? God is far above the partners they put beside him!
te.27:64: Who is it that creates life and reproduces it? Who is it that gives you provision from the heavens and earth? Is it another god beside God?’ Say, ‘Show me your evidence then, if what you say is true.’
te.27:65: Say, ‘No one in the heavens or on earth knows the unseen except God.’ They do not know when they will be raised from the dead:
te.27:66: their knowledge cannot comprehend the Hereafter; they are in doubt about it; they are blind to it.
te.27:67: So the disbelievers say, ‘What! When we and our forefathers have become dust, shall we be brought back to life again?
te.27:68: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
te.27:69: [Prophet], say, ‘Travel through the earth and see how the evildoers ended up.’
te.27:70: [Prophet], do not grieve over them; do not be distressed by their schemes.
te.27:71: They also say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled if what you say is true?’
te.27:72: Say, ‘Maybe some of what you seek to hasten is near at hand.’
te.27:73: Your Lord is bountiful to people, though most of them are ungrateful.
te.27:74: He knows everything their hearts conceal and everything they reveal:
te.27:75: there is nothing hidden in the heavens or on earth that is not in a clear Record.
te.27:76: Truly, this Quran explains to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about,
te.27:77: and it is guidance and grace for those who believe.
te.27:78: Truly, your Lord will judge between them in His wisdom- He is the Almighty, the All Knowing-
te.27:79: so [Prophet], put your trust in God, you are on the path of clear truth.
te.27:80: You cannot make the dead hear, you cannot make the deaf listen to your call when they turn their backs and leave,
te.27:81: you cannot guide the blind out of their error: you cannot make anyone hear you except those who believe in Our signs and submit [to Us].
te.27:82: When the verdict is given against them, We shall bring a creature out of the earth, which will tell them that people had no faith in Our revelations.
te.27:83: The Day will come when We gather from every community a crowd of those who disbelieved in Our signs and they will be led in separate groups
te.27:84: until, when they come before Him, He will say, ‘Did you deny My messages without even taking them in? Or what were you doing?’
te.27:85: The verdict will be given against them because of their wrongdoing: they will not speak.
te.27:86: Did they not see that We gave them the night for rest, and the day for light? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
te.27:87: On the Day the Trumpet sounds, everyone in heaven and on earth will be terrified- except such as God wills- and all will come to Him in utter humility.
te.27:88: You will see the mountains and think they are firmly fixed, but they will float away like clouds: this is the handiwork of God who has perfected all things. He is fully aware of what you do:
te.27:89: whoever comes with a good deed will be rewarded with something better, and be secure from the terrors of that Day,
te.27:90: but whoever comes with evil deeds will be cast face downwards into the Fire. ‘Are you rewarded for anything except what you have done?’
te.27:91: [Say Prophet], ‘What I am commanded to do is to serve the Sustainer of this town, which He has made inviolable. Everything belongs to Him; I am commanded to be one of those devoted to Him;
te.27:92: I am commanded to recite the Quran.’ Whoever chooses to follow the right path does so for his own good. Say to whoever deviates from it, ‘I am only here to warn.’
te.27:93: Say, ‘Praise belongs to God: He will show you His signs so that you will recognize them.’ Your Lord is never unmindful of what you all do.
te.28:2: These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear:
te.28:3: We recount to you [Prophet] part of the story of Moses and Pharaoh, setting out the truth for people who believe.
te.28:4: Pharaoh made himself high and mighty in the land and divided the people into different groups: one group he oppressed, slaughtering their sons and sparing their women––he was one of those who spread corruption––
te.28:5: but We wished to favour those who were oppressed in that land, to make them leaders, the ones to survive,
te.28:6: to establish them in the land, and through them show Pharaoh, Haman, and their armies the very thing they feared.
te.28:7: We inspired Moses’ mother, saying, ‘Suckle him, and then, when you fear for his safety, put him in the river: do not be afraid, and do not grieve, for We shall return him to you and make him a messenger.’
te.28:8: Pharaoh’s household picked him up––later to become an enemy and a source of grief for them: Pharaoh, Haman, and their armies were wrongdoers––
te.28:9: and Pharaoh’s wife said, ‘Here is a joy to behold for me and for you! Do not kill him: he may be of use to us, or we may adopt him as a son.’ They did not realize what they were doing.
te.28:10: The next day, Moses’ mother felt a void in her heart––if We had not strengthened it to make her one of those who believe, she would have revealed everything about him––
te.28:11: and she said to his sister, ‘Follow him.’ So she watched him from a distance, without them knowing.
te.28:12: We had ordained that he would refuse to feed from wet nurses. His sister approached them and said, ‘Shall I tell you about a household which could bring him up for you and take good care of him?’
te.28:13: We restored him to his mother in this way, so that she might be comforted, not grieve, and know that God’s promise is true, though most of them do not know.
te.28:14: When Moses reached full maturity and manhood, We gave him wisdom and knowledge: this is how We reward those who do good.
te.28:15: He entered the city, unnoticed by its people, and found two men fighting: one from his own people, the other an enemy. The one from his own people cried out to him for help against the enemy. Moses struck him with his fist and killed him. He said, ‘This must be Satan’s work: clearly he is a misleading enemy.’
te.28:16: He said, ‘Lord, I have wronged myself. Forgive me,’ so He forgave him; He is truly the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
te.28:17: He said, ‘My Lord, because of the blessings You have bestowed upon me, I shall never support those who do evil.’
te.28:18: Next morning, he was walking in the city, fearful and vigilant, when suddenly the man he had helped the day before cried out to him for help. Moses said, ‘You are clearly a troublemaker.’
te.28:19: As he was about to attack the man who was an enemy to both of them, the man said, ‘Moses, are you going to kill me as you killed that person yesterday? You clearly want to be a tyrant in the land; you do not intend to put things right.’
te.28:20: Then a man came running from the furthest part of the city and said, ‘Moses, the authorities are talking about killing you, so leave- this is my sincere advice.’
te.28:21: So Moses left the city, fearful and wary, and prayed, ‘My Lord, save me from people who do wrong.’
te.28:22: As he made his way towards Midian, he was saying, ‘May my Lord guide me to the right way.’
te.28:23: When he arrived at Midian’s waters, he found a group of men watering [their flocks], and beside them two women keeping their flocks back, so he said, ‘What is the matter with you two?’ They said, ‘We cannot water [our flocks] until the shepherds take their sheep away: our father is a very old man.’
te.28:24: He watered their flocks for them, withdrew into the shade, and prayed, ‘My Lord, I am in dire need of whatever good thing You may send me,’
te.28:25: and then one of the two women approached him, walking shyly, and said, ‘My father is asking for you: he wants to reward you for watering our flocks for us.’ When Moses came to him and told him his story, the old man said, ‘Do not be afraid, you are safe now from people who do wrong.’
te.28:26: One of the women said, ‘Father, hire him: a strong, trustworthy man is the best to hire.’
te.28:27: The father said, ‘I would like to marry you to one of these daughters of mine, on condition that you serve me for eight years: if you complete ten, it will be of your own free will. I do not intend to make things difficult for you: God willing, you will find I am a fair man.’
te.28:28: Moses said, ‘Let that be the agreement between us- whichever of the two terms I fulfil, let there be no injustice to me- God is witness to what we say.’
te.28:29: Once Moses had fulfilled the term and was travelling with his family, he caught sight of a fire on the side of the mountain and said to his family, ‘Wait! I have seen a fire. I will bring you news from there, or a burning stick for you to warm yourselves.’
te.28:30: But when he reached it, a voice called out to him from the right-hand side of the valley, from a tree on the blessed ground: ‘Moses, I am God, the Lord of the Worlds.
te.28:31: Throw down your staff.’ When he saw his staff moving like a snake, he fled in fear and would not return. Again [he was called]: ‘Moses! Draw near! Do not be afraid, for you are one of those who are safe.
te.28:32: Put your hand inside your shirt and it will come out white but unharmed- hold your arm close to your side, free from all fear. These shall be two signs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his chiefs; they are truly wicked people.’
te.28:33: Moses said, ‘My Lord, I killed one of their men, and I fear that they may kill me.
te.28:34: My brother Aaron is more eloquent than I: send him with me to help me and confirm my words- I fear they may call me a liar.’
te.28:35: God said, ‘We shall strengthen you through your brother; We shall give you both power so that they cannot touch you. With Our signs you, and those who follow you, will triumph.’
te.28:36: But when Moses came to them with Our clear signs, they said, ‘These are mere conjuring tricks; we never heard this from our forefathers.’
te.28:37: Moses said, ‘My Lord knows best who comes with guidance from Him and who will have the final Home: wrongdoers will never succeed.’
te.28:38: Pharaoh said, ‘Counsellors, you have no other god that I know of except me. Haman, light me a fire to bake clay bricks, then build me a tall building so that I may climb up to Moses’ God: I am convinced that he is lying.’
te.28:39: Pharaoh and his armies behaved arrogantly in the land with no right- they thought they would not be brought back to Us-
te.28:40: so We seized him and his armies and threw them into the sea. See what became of the wrongdoers!
te.28:41: We made them leaders calling [others] only to the Fire: on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.
te.28:42: We made Our rejection pursue them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be among the despised.
te.28:43: After We had destroyed the earlier generations, We gave Moses the Scripture to provide insight, guidance, and mercy for people, so that they might take heed.
te.28:44: You [Muhammad] were not present on the western side of the mountain when We gave Our command to Moses: you were not there-
te.28:45: We have brought into being many generations who lived long lives- you did not live among the people of Midian or recite Our Revelation to them- We have always sent messengers to people-
te.28:46: nor were you present on the side of Mount Sinai when We called out to Moses. But you too have been sent as an act of grace from your Lord, to give warning to a people to whom no warner has come before, so that they may take heed,
te.28:47: and may not say, if a disaster should befall them as a result of what they have done with their own hands, ‘Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we might have followed Your message and become believers.’
te.28:48: Even now that Our truth has come to them, they say, ‘Why has he not been given signs like those given to Moses?’ Did they not also deny the truth that was given to Moses before? They say, ‘Two kinds of sor-cery, helping each other,’ and, ‘We refuse to accept either of them.’
te.28:49: Say [Muhammad], ‘Then produce a book from God that gives better guidance than these two and I will follow it, if you are telling the truth.’
te.28:50: If they do not respond to you, you will know that they follow only their own desires. Who is further astray than the one who follows his own desires with no guidance from God? Truly God does not guide those who do wrong.
te.28:51: We have caused Our Word to come to them so that they may be mindful.
te.28:52: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before believe in it,
te.28:53: and, when it is recited to them, say, ‘We believe in it, it is the truth from our Lord. Before it came we had already devoted ourselves to Him.’
te.28:54: They will be given their rewards twice over because they are steadfast, repel evil with good, give to others out of what We have provided for them,
te.28:55: and turn away whenever they hear frivolous talk, saying, ‘We have our deeds and you have yours. Peace be with you! We do not seek the company of ignorant people.’
te.28:56: You [Prophet] cannot guide everyone you love to the truth; it is God who guides whoever He will: He knows best those who will follow guidance.
te.28:57: They say, ‘If we were to follow guidance with you [Prophet], we would be swept from our land.’ Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary where every kind of produce is brought, as a provision from Us? But most of them do not comprehend.
te.28:58: We have destroyed many a community that once revelled in its wanton wealth and easy living: since then their dwelling places have barely been inhabited- We are the only heir.
te.28:59: Your Lord would never destroy towns without first raising a messenger in their midst to recite Our messages to them, nor would We destroy towns unless their inhabitants were evildoers.
te.28:60: Whatever things you have been given for the life of this world are merely [temporary] gratification and vanity: that which is with God is better and more lasting- will you not use your reason?
te.28:61: Can the person who will see the fulfilment of the good promise We gave him be compared to someone We have given some enjoyments for this worldly life but who, on the Day of Resurrection, will be summoned?
te.28:62: The Day will come when God will call them, saying, ‘Where now are those you allege are My partners?’
te.28:63: and those [ringleaders] against whom the verdict will be passed will say, ‘Our Lord, these are the ones we caused to deviate. We caused them to deviate as we ourselves deviated, but now we disown them before You: they did not really serve us.’
te.28:64: It will then be said to them, ‘Now call those you worshipped as partners,’ and they will call them but receive no answer. They will see the suffering and wish they had followed guidance.
te.28:65: On that Day He will call them, saying, ‘How did you respond to My messengers?’
te.28:66: All arguments will seem obscure to them on that Day; they will not be able to consult one another.
te.28:67: Yet anyone who has repented, believed, and done good deeds can hope to find himself among the successful.
te.28:68: Your Lord creates what He pleases and chooses those He will- they have no choice- so glory be to God, and may He be exalted above the partners they ascribe to Him!
te.28:69: Your Lord knows what their hearts conceal and what they reveal.
te.28:70: He is God; there is no god but Him; all praise belongs to Him in this world and the next; His is the Judgement; and to Him you shall be returned.
te.28:71: Say [Prophet], ‘Just think, if God were to cast perpetual night over you until the Day of Resurrection, what god other than He could bring you light? Do you not listen?’
te.28:72: Say, ‘Just think, if God were to cast perpetual day over you until the Day of Resurrection, what god other than He could give you night in which to rest? Do you not see?
te.28:73: In His mercy He has given you night and day, so that you may rest and seek His bounty and be grateful.’
te.28:74: The Day will come when He will call out to them, saying, ‘Where are the partners you claimed for Me?’
te.28:75: We shall call a witness from every community, and say, ‘Produce your evidence,’ and then they will know that truth belongs to God alone; the gods they invented will forsake them.
te.28:76: Qarun was one of Moses’ people, but he oppressed them. We had given him such treasures that even their keys would have weighed down a whole company of strong men. His people said to him, ‘Do not gloat, for God does not like people who gloat.
te.28:77: Seek the life to come by means of what God has granted you, but do not neglect your rightful share in this world. Do good to others as God has done good to you. Do not seek to spread corruption in the land, for God does not love those who do this,’
te.28:78: but he answered, ‘This wealth was given to me on account of the knowledge I possess.’ Did he not know that God had destroyed many generations before him, who had greater power than him and built up greater wealth? The guilty will not be questioned about their sins.
te.28:79: He went out among his people in all his pomp, and those whose aim was the life of this world said, ‘If only we had been given something like what Qarun has been given: he really is a very fortunate man,’
te.28:80: but those who were given knowledge said, ‘Alas for you! God’s reward is better for those who believe and do good deeds: only those who are steadfast will attain this.’
te.28:81: We caused the earth to swallow him and his home: he had no one to help him against God, nor could he defend himself.
te.28:82: The next day, those who had, the day before, wished to be in his place exclaimed, ‘Alas [for you, Qarun]! It is God alone who gives what He will, abundantly or sparingly, to whichever He will of His creatures: if God had not been gracious to us, He would have caused the earth to swallow us too.’ Alas indeed! Those who deny the truth will never prosper.
te.28:83: We grant the Home in the Hereafter to those who do not seek superiority on earth or spread corruption: the happy ending is awarded to those who are mindful of God.
te.28:84: Whoever comes before God with a good deed will receive a better reward; whoever comes with an evil deed will be punished only for what he has done.
te.28:85: He who has made the Quran binding on you [Prophet] will bring you back home. So say, ‘My Lord knows best who has brought true guidance and who is blatantly astray.’
te.28:86: You yourself could not have expected the Scripture to be sent to you; it came only as a mercy from your Lord. So give no help to the disbelievers.
te.28:87: Do not let them turn you away from God’s revelations after they have been revealed to you. Call people to your Lord. Never become one of those who ascribe partners to God.
te.28:88: Do not call out to any other god beside God, for there is no god but Him. Everything will perish except His Face. His is the Judgement and to Him you shall all be brought back.
te.29:2: Do people think they will be left alone after saying ‘We believe’ without being put to the test?
te.29:3: We tested those who went before them: God will certainly mark out which ones are truthful and which are lying.
te.29:4: Do the evildoers think they can escape us? How ill they judge!
te.29:5: But as for those who strive for their meeting with God, God’s appointed time is bound to come; He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
te.29:6: Those who exert themselves do so for their own benefit––God does not need His creatures––
te.29:7: We shall certainly blot out the misdeeds of those who believe and do good deeds, and We shall reward them according to the best of their actions.
te.29:8: We have commanded people to be good to their parents, but do not obey them if they strive to make you serve, beside Me, anything of which you have no knowledge: you will all return to Me, and I shall inform you of what you have done.
te.29:9: We shall be sure to admit those who believe and do good deeds to the ranks of the righteous.
te.29:10: There are some people who say, ‘We believe in God,’ but, when they suffer for His cause, they think that human persecution is as severe as God’s punishment––yet, if any help comes to you [Prophet] from your Lord, they will say, ‘We have always been with you’. Does God not know best what is in everyone’s hearts?
te.29:11: God will be sure to mark out which ones are the believers, and which the hypocrites.
te.29:12: Those who disbelieve say to the believers, ‘Follow our path and we shall bear [the consequences for] your sins,’ yet they will not do so––they are liars.
te.29:13: They will bear their own burdens and others besides: they will be questioned about their false assertions on the Day of Resurrection.
te.29:14: We sent Noah out to his people. He lived among them for fifty years short of a thousand but when the Flood overwhelmed them they were still doing evil.
te.29:15: We saved him and those with him on the Ark. We made this a sign for all people.
te.29:16: We also sent Abraham. He said to his people, ‘Serve God and be mindful of Him: that is better for you, if only you knew.
te.29:17: What you worship instead of God are mere idols; what you invent is nothing but falsehood. Those you serve instead of God have no power to give you provisions, so seek provisions from God, serve Him, and give Him thanks: you will all be returned to Him.
te.29:18: If you say this is a lie, [be warned that] other communities before you said the same. The messenger’s only duty is to give clear warning.’
te.29:19: Do they not see that God brings life into being and reproduces it? Truly this is easy for God.
te.29:20: Say, ‘Travel throughout the earth and see how He brings life into being: and He will bring the next life into being. God has power over all things.
te.29:21: He punishes whoever He will and shows mercy to whoever He will. You will all be returned to Him.
te.29:22: You cannot escape Him on earth or in the heavens; you will have no one to protect or help you besides God.’
te.29:23: Those who deny God’s Revelation and their meeting with Him have no hope of receiving My grace: they will have a grievous torment.
te.29:24: The only answer Abraham’s people gave was, ‘Kill him or burn him!’ but God saved him from the Fire: there truly are signs in this for people who believe.
te.29:25: Abraham said to them, ‘You have chosen idols instead of God but your love for them will only last for the present life: on the Day of Resurrection, you will disown and reject one another. Hell will be your home and no one will help you.’
te.29:26: Lot believed him, and said, ‘I will flee to my Lord: He is the Almighty, the All Wise.’
te.29:27: We gave Isaac and Jacob to Abraham, and placed prophethood and Scripture among his offspring. We gave him his rewards in this world, and in the life to come he will be among the righteous.
te.29:28: And Lot: when He said to his people, ‘You practise outrageous acts that no people before you have ever committed.
te.29:29: How can you lust after men, waylay travellers, and commit evil in your gatherings?’ the only answer his people gave was, ‘Bring God’s punishment down on us, if what you say is true.’
te.29:30: So he prayed, ‘My Lord, help me against these people who spread corruption.’
te.29:31: When Our mes-sengers brought the good news [of the birth of a son] to Abraham,they told him, ‘We are about to destroy the people of that town. They are wrongdoers.’
te.29:32: Abraham said, ‘But Lot lives there.’ They answered, ‘We know who lives there better than you do. We shall save him and his household, except for his wife: she will be one of those who stay behind.’
te.29:33: When Our messengers came to Lot, he was troubled and distressed on their account. They said, ‘Have no fear or grief: we shall certainly save you and your household, except for your wife- she will be one of those who stay behind-
te.29:34: and we shall send a punishment from heaven down on the people of this town because they violate [God’s order].’
te.29:35: We left some [of the town] there as a clear sign for those who use their reason.
te.29:36: To the people of Midian We sent their brother Shuayb. He said, ‘My people, serve God and think ahead to the Last Day. Do not commit evil and spread corruption in the land.’
te.29:37: They rejected him and so the earthquake overtook them. When morning came, they were lying dead in their homes.
te.29:38: [Remember] the tribes of 'Ad and Thamud: their history is made clear to you by [what is left of] their dwelling places. Satan made their foul deeds seem alluring to them and barred them from the right way, though they were capable of seeing.
te.29:39: [Remember] Qarun and Pharaoh and Haman: Moses brought them clear signs, but they behaved arrogantly on earth. They could not escape Us
te.29:40: and We punished each one of them for their sins: some We struck with a violent storm; some were overcome by a sudden blast; some We made the earth swallow; and some We drowned. It was not God who wronged them; they wronged themselves.
te.29:41: Those who take protectors other than God can be compared to spiders building themselves houses- the spider’s is the frailest of all houses- if only they could understand.
te.29:42: God knows what things they call upon beside Him: He is the Mighty, the Wise.
te.29:43: Such are the comparisons We draw for people, though only the wise can grasp them.
te.29:44: God has created the heavens and earth for a true purpose. There truly is a sign in this for those who believe.
te.29:45: [Prophet], recite what has been revealed to you of the Scripture; keep up the prayer: prayer restrains outrageous and unacceptable behaviour. Remembering God is greater: God knows everything you are doing.
te.29:46: [Believers], argue only in the best way with the People of the Book, except with those of them who act unjustly. Say, ‘We believe in what was revealed to us and in what was revealed to you; our God and your God are one [and the same]; we are devoted to Him.’
te.29:47: This is the way We sent the Scripture to you [Muhammad]. Those to whom We had already given Scripture believe in [the Quran] and so do some of these people. No one refuses to acknowledge Our revelations but the defiant.
te.29:48: You never recited any Scripture before We revealed this one to you; you never wrote one down with your hand. If you had done so, those who follow falsehood might have had cause to doubt.
te.29:49: But no, [this Quran] is a revelation that is clear to the hearts of those endowed with knowledge. No one refuses to acknowledge Our revelations but the evildoers.
te.29:50: They say, ‘Why have no miracles been sent to him by his Lord?’ Say, ‘Miracles lie in God’s hands; I am simply here to warn you plainly.’
te.29:51: Do they not think it is enough that We have sent down to you the Scripture that is recited to them? There is a mercy in this and a lesson for believing people.
te.29:52: Say, ‘God is sufficient witness between me and you: He knows what is in the heavens and earth. Those who believe in false deities and deny God will be the losers.’
te.29:53: They challenge you to hasten the punishment: they would already have received a punishment if God had not set a time for it, and indeed it will come to them suddenly and catch them unawares.
te.29:54: They challenge you to hasten the punishment: Hell will encompass all those who deny the truth,
te.29:55: on the Day when punishment overwhelms them from above and from below their very feet, and they will be told, ‘Now taste the punishment for what you used to do.’
te.29:56: My believing servants! My earth is vast, so worship Me and Me alone.
te.29:57: Every soul will taste death, then it is to Us that you will be returned.
te.29:58: We shall lodge those who believed and did good deeds in lofty dwellings, in the Garden graced with flowing streams, there to remain. How excellent is the reward of those who labour,
te.29:59: those who are steadfast, those who put their trust in their Lord!
te.29:60: How many are the creatures who do not store their sustenance! God sustains them and you: He alone is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
te.29:61: If you ask the disbelievers who created the heavens and earth and who harnessed the sun and moon, they are sure to say, ‘God.’ Then why do they turn away from Him?
te.29:62: It is God who gives abundantly to whichever of His servants He will, and sparingly to whichever He will: He has full knowledge of everything.
te.29:63: If you ask them, ‘Who sends water down from the sky and gives life with it to the earth after it has died?’ they are sure to say, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Praise belongs to God!’ Truly, most of them do not use their reason.
te.29:64: The life of this world is merely an amusement and a diversion; the true life is in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
te.29:65: Whenever they go on board a ship they call on God, and dedicate their faith to Him alone, but once He has delivered them safely back to land, see how they ascribe partners to Him!
te.29:66: Let them show their ingratitude for what We have given them; let them take their enjoyment- soon they will know.
te.29:67: Can they not see that We have made [them] a secure sanctuary though all around them people are snatched away? Then how can they believe in what is false and deny God’s blessing?
te.29:68: Who could be more wicked than the person who invents lies about God, or denies the truth when it comes to him? Is Hell not the home for the disbelievers?
te.29:69: But We shall be sure to guide to Our ways those who strive hard for Our cause: God is with those who do good.
te.30:3: in a nearby land. They will reverse their defeat with a victory
te.30:4: in a few years’ time––God is in command, first and last. On that day, the believers will rejoice
te.30:5: at God’s help. He helps whoever He pleases: He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
te.30:6: This is God’s promise: God never breaks His promise, but most people do not know;
te.30:7: they only know the outer surface of this present life and are heedless of the life to come.
te.30:8: Have they not thought about their own selves? God did not create the heavens and earth and everything between them without a serious purpose and an appointed time, yet many people deny that they will meet their Lord.
te.30:9: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how their predecessors met their end? They were mightier than them: they cultivated the earth more and built more upon it. Their own mes-sengers also came to them with clear signs: God did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
te.30:10: Later the evildoers met a terrible end for rejecting and [repeatedly] mocking God’s revelations.
te.30:11: God brings creation into being; in the end He will reproduce it and it is to Him you will be recalled.
te.30:12: On the Day the Hour arrives, the guilty will despair
te.30:13: and they will have no intercessors among those partners they ascribed to God- they will deny these partners.
te.30:14: When the Hour arrives, on that Day people will be separated:
te.30:15: those who believed and did good deeds will delight in a Garden,
te.30:16: while those who disbelieved and denied Our messages and the meeting of the Hereafter will be brought for punishment.
te.30:17: So celebrate God’s glory in the evening, in the morning-
te.30:18: praise is due to Him in the heavens and the earth- in the late afternoon, and at midday.
te.30:19: He brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living. He gives life to the earth after death, and you will be brought out in the same way.
te.30:20: One of His signs is that He created you from dust and- lo and behold!- you became human and scattered far and wide.
te.30:21: Another of His signs is that He created spouses from among yourselves for you to live with in tranquillity: He ordained love and kindness between you. There truly are signs in this for those who reflect.
te.30:22: Another of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth, and the diversity of your languages and colours. There truly are signs in this for those who know.
te.30:23: Among His signs are your sleep, by night and by day, and your seeking His bounty. There truly are signs in this for those who can hear.
te.30:24: Among His signs, too, are that He shows you the lightning that terrifies and inspires hope; that He sends water down from the sky to restore the earth to life after death. There truly are signs in this for those who use their reason.
te.30:25: Among His signs, too, is the fact that the heavens and the earth stand firm by His command. In the end, you will all emerge when He calls you from the earth.
te.30:26: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and all are obedient to Him.
te.30:27: He is the One who originates creation and will do it again- this is even easier for Him. He is above all comparison in the heavens and earth; He is the Almighty, the All Wise.
te.30:28: He gives you this example, drawn from your own lives: do you make your slaves full partners with an equal share in what We have given you? Do you fear them as you fear each other? This is how We make Our messages clear to those who use their reason.
te.30:29: And still the idolaters follow their own desires without any knowledge. Who can guide those God leaves to stray, who have no one to help them?
te.30:30: So [Prophet] as a man of pure faith, stand firm and true in your devotion to the religion. This is the natural disposition God instilled in mankind- there is no altering God’s creation- and this is the right religion, though most people do not realize it.
te.30:31: Turn to Him alone, all of you. Be mindful of Him; keep up the prayer; do not join those who ascribe partners to God,
te.30:32: those who divide their religion into sects, with each party rejoicing in their own.
te.30:33: When something bad happens to people, they cry to their Lord and turn to Him for help, but no sooner does He let them taste His blessing than- lo and behold!- some of them ascribe partners to their Lord,
te.30:34: showing no gratitude for what We have given them. ‘Take your pleasure! You will come to know.’
te.30:35: Did We send them down any authority that sanctions the partners they ascribe to God?
te.30:36: When We give people a taste of Our blessing, they rejoice, but when something bad happens to them- because of their own actions- they fall into utter despair.
te.30:37: Do they not see that God gives abundantly to whoever He will and sparingly [to whoever He will]? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
te.30:38: So give their due to the near relative, the needy, and the wayfarer- that is best for those whose goal is God’s approval: these are the ones who will prosper.
te.30:39: Whatever you lend out in usury to gain value through other people’s wealth will not increase in God’s eyes, but whatever you give in charity, in your desire for God’s approval, will earn multiple rewards.
te.30:40: It is God who created you and provided for you, who will cause you to die and then give you life again. Which of your ‘partners’ can do any one of these things? Glory be to God, and exalted be He above the partners they attribute to Him.
te.30:41: Corruption has flourished on land and sea as a result of people’s actions and He will make them taste the consequences of some of their own actions so that they may turn back.
te.30:42: Say, ‘Travel through the land, and see how those before you met their end- most of them were idolaters.’
te.30:43: [Prophet], stand firm in your devotion to the upright religion, before an irresistible Day comes from God. On that Day, mankind will be divided:
te.30:44: those who rejected the truth will bear the burden of that rejection, and those who did good deeds will have made good provision for themselves.
te.30:45: From His bounty God will reward those who believe and do good deeds; He does not like those who reject the truth.
te.30:46: Another of His signs is that He sends out the winds bearing good news, giving you a taste of His grace, making the ships sail at His command, enabling you to [journey in] search of His bounty so that you may be grateful.
te.30:47: Before you [Muhammad], We sent mes-sengers, each to their own people: they brought them clear proofs and then We punished the evildoers. We make it Our duty to help the believers.
te.30:48: It is God who sends out the winds; they stir up the clouds; He spreads them over the skies as He pleases; He makes them break up and you see the rain falling from them. See how they rejoice when He makes it fall upon whichever of His servants He wishes,
te.30:49: though before it is sent they may have lost all hope.
te.30:50: Look, then, at the imprints of God’s mercy, how He restores the earth to life after death: this same God is the one who will return people to life after death- He has power over all things.
te.30:51: Yet they will continue in their disbelief, even if We send a [scorching] wind and they see their crops turn yellow.
te.30:52: You [Prophet] cannot make the dead hear and you cannot make the deaf hear your call when they turn their backs and leave;
te.30:53: you cannot lead the blind out of their error: the only ones you can make hear you are those who believe in Our revelations and devote themselves [to Us].
te.30:54: It is God who creates you weak, then gives you strength, then weakness after strength, together with your grey hair: He creates what He will; He is the All Knowing, the All Powerful.
te.30:55: On the Day the Hour comes, the guilty will swear they lingered no more than an hour- they have always been deluded-
te.30:56: but those endowed with knowledge and faith will say, ‘In accordance with God’s decree, you actually lingered till the Day of Resurrection: this is the Day of Resurrection, yet you did not know.’
te.30:57: On that Day the evildoers’ excuses will be of no use to them: they will not be allowed to make amends.
te.30:58: In this Quran We have set every kind of illustration before people, yet if you [Prophet] brought them a miracle, the disbelievers would still say, ‘You [prophets] deal only in falsehood.’
te.30:59: In this way God seals the hearts of those who do not know,
te.30:60: so be patient, for God’s promise is true: do not let those with no firm beliefs discourage you.
te.31:2: These are the verses of the wise Scripture,
te.31:3: [with] guidance and mercy for those who do good,
te.31:4: who keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and are certain of the Hereafter:
te.31:5: these are rightly guided by their Lord, and it is they who will prosper.
te.31:6: But there is the sort of person who pays for distracting tales, intending, without any knowledge, to lead others from God’s way, and to hold it up to ridicule. There will be humiliating torment for him!
te.31:7: When Our verses are recited to him, he turns away disdainfully as if he had not heard them, as if there were heaviness in his ears. Tell him that there will be a painful torment!
te.31:8: But for those who believe and do righteous deeds, there will be Gardens of bliss
te.31:9: where they will stay: that is God’s true promise, and He is the Almighty, the All Wise.
te.31:10: He created the heavens without any visible support, and He placed firm mountains on the earth––in case it should shake under you––and He spread all kinds of animals around it. We sent down water from the sky, with which We made every kind of good plant grow on earth:
te.31:11: all this is God’s creation. Now, show Me what your other gods have created. No, the disbelievers are clearly astray.
te.31:12: We endowed Luqman with wisdom: ‘Be thankful to God: whoever gives thanks benefits his own soul, and as for those who are thankless––God is self-sufficient, worthy of all praise.’
te.31:13: Luqman counselled his son, ‘My son, do not attribute any partners to God: attributing partners to Him is a terrible wrong.’
te.31:14: We have commanded people to be good to their parents: their mothers carried them, with strain upon strain, and it takes two years to wean them. Give thanks to Me and to your parents- all will return to Me.
te.31:15: If they strive to make you associate with Me anything about which you have no knowledge, then do not obey them. Yet keep their company in this life according to what is right, and follow the path of those who turn to Me. You will all return to Me in the end, and I will tell you everything that you have done.
te.31:16: [And Luqman continued], ‘My son, if even the weight of a mustard seed were hidden in a rock or anywhere in the heavens or earth, God would bring it [to light], for He is all subtle and all aware.
te.31:17: Keep up the prayer, my son; command what is right; forbid what is wrong; bear anything that happens to you steadfastly: these are things to be aspired to.
te.31:18: Do not turn your nose up at people, nor walk about the place arrogantly, for God does not love arrogant or boastful people.
te.31:19: Go at a moderate pace and lower your voice, for the ugliest of all voices is the braying of asses.’
te.31:20: [People], do you not see how God has made what is in the heavens and on the earth useful to you, and has lavished His bless-ings on you both outwardly and inwardly? Yet some people argue about God, without knowledge or guidance or an illuminating scripture.
te.31:21: When they are told, ‘Follow what God has sent down,’ they say: ‘We shall follow what we saw our forefathers following.’ What! Even if Satan is calling them to the suffering of the Blazing Flame?
te.31:22: Whoever directs himself wholly to God and does good work has grasped the surest handhold, for the outcome of everything is with God.
te.31:23: As for those who refuse to do this, do not let their refusal sadden you [Prophet]- they will return to Us and We shall tell them what they have done: God knows all that hearts contain-
te.31:24: We let them enjoy themselves for a little while, but We shall drive them to a harsh torment.
te.31:25: If you ask them who created the heavens and earth, they are sure to say, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Praise belongs to God,’ but most of them do not understand.
te.31:26: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. God is self-sufficient and worthy of all praise.
te.31:27: If all the trees on earth were pens and all the seas, with seven more seas besides, [were ink,] still God’s words would not run out: God is almighty and all wise.
te.31:28: Creating and resurrecting all of you is only like creating or resurrecting a single soul: God is all hearing and all seeing.
te.31:29: [Prophet], do you not see that God causes the night to merge into day and the day to merge into night; that He has subjected the sun and the moon, each to run its course for a stated term; that He is aware of everything you [people] do?
te.31:30: This is because God is the Truth, and what they invoke beside Him is false. He is the Most High, Most Great.
te.31:31: [Prophet], do you not see that ships sail through the sea, by the grace of God, to show you [people] some of His wonders? Truly there are signs in this for every steadfast, thankful person.
te.31:32: When the waves loom over those on board like giant shadows they call out to God, devoting their religion entirely to Him. But, when He has delivered them safely to land, some of them waver- only a treacherous, thankless person refuses to acknowledge Our signs.
te.31:33: People, be mindful of your Lord and fear a day when no parent will take the place of their child, nor a child take the place of their parent, in any way. God’s promise is true, so do not let the present life delude you, nor let the Deceiver delude you about God.
te.31:34: Knowledge of the Hour [of Resurrection] belongs to God; it is He who sends down the relieving rain and He who knows what is hidden in the womb. No soul knows what it will reap tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die; it is God who is all knowing and all aware.
te.32:2: This scripture, free from all doubt, has been sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
te.32:3: Yet they say, ‘Muhammad has made it up.’ No indeed! It is the Truth from your Lord for you [Prophet], to warn a people who have had no one to warn them before, so that they may be guided.
te.32:4: It is God who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six Days. Then He established Himself on the Throne. You [people] have no one but Him to protect you and no one to intercede for you, so why do you not take heed?
te.32:5: He runs everything, from the heavens to the earth, and everything will ascend to Him in the end, on a Day that will measure a thousand years in your reckoning.
te.32:6: Such is He who knows all that is unseen as well as what is seen, the Almighty, the Merciful,
te.32:7: who gave everything its perfect form. He first created man from clay,
te.32:8: then made his descendants from an extract of underrated fluid.
te.32:9: Then He moulded him; He breathed from His Spirit into him; He gave you hearing, sight, and minds. How seldom you are grateful!
te.32:10: They say, ‘What? When we have disappeared into the earth, shall we really be created anew?’ In fact, they deny the meeting with their Lord.
te.32:11: Say, ‘The Angel of Death put in charge of you will reclaim you, and then you will be brought back to your Lord.’
te.32:12: [Prophet], if only you could see the wrongdoers hang their heads before their Lord: ‘Our Lord, now that we have seen and heard, send us back and we shall do good. [Now] we are convinced.’
te.32:13: ‘If it had been Our will, We could certainly have given every soul its true guidance, but My words have come true. “I shall be sure to fill Hell with jinn and men together.”
te.32:14: So since you ignored the meeting on this Day of yours, now We shall ignore you: taste the lasting suffering for all you have done.’
te.32:15: The only people who truly believe in Our messages are those who, when they are reminded of them, bow down in worship, cele-brate their Lord’s praises, and do not think themselves above this.
te.32:16: Their sides shun their beds in order to pray to their Lord in fear and hope; they give to others some of what We have given them.
te.32:17: No soul knows what joy is kept hidden in store for them as a reward for what they have done.
te.32:18: So, is someone who believes equal to someone who defies God? No, they are not equal.
te.32:19: Those who believe and do good deeds will have Gardens awaiting them as their home and as a reward for what they have done.
te.32:20: As for those who defy God, their home will be the Fire. Whenever they try to escape it, they will be driven back into it, and they will be told, ‘Taste the torment of the Fire, which you persistently denied.’
te.32:21: We shall certainly make them taste a nearer torment [in this life] prior to the greater torment, so that perhaps they may return [to the right path].
te.32:22: Who does more wrong than someone who, when messages from his Lord are recited to him, turns away from them? We shall inflict retribution on the guilty.
te.32:23: We gave Moses the Scripture- so [Muhammad] do not doubt that you are receiving it- and We made it a guide for the Children of Israel.
te.32:24: When they became steadfast and believed firmly in Our messages, We raised leaders among them, guiding them according to Our command.
te.32:25: [Prophet], it is your Lord who will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their differences.
te.32:26: Is it not a lesson for them [to see] how many generations We destroyed before them, in whose homes they now walk? There truly are signs in this- do they not hear?
te.32:27: Do they not consider how We drive rain to the barren land, and with it produce vegetation from which their cattle and they themselves eat? Do they not see?
te.32:28: And they say, ‘When will this Decision be, if you are telling the truth?’
te.32:29: Say, ‘On the Day of Decision it will be no use for the disbelievers to believe; they will be granted no respite.’
te.32:30: So [Prophet], turn away from them and wait: they too are waiting.
te.33:1: Prophet, be mindful of God and do not give in to the disbelievers and the hypocrites: God is all knowing, all wise.
te.33:2: Follow what your Lord reveals to you: God is well aware of all your actions.
te.33:3: Put your trust in God: God is enough to trust.
te.33:4: God does not put two hearts within a man’s breast. He does not turn the wives you reject and liken to your mothers’ backs into your real mothers; nor does He make your adopted sons into real sons. These are only words from your mouths, while God speaks the truth and guides people to the right path.
te.33:5: Name your adopted sons after their real fathers: this is more equitable in God’s eyes––if you do not know who their fathers are [they are your] ‘brothers-in-religion’ and proteges. You will not be blamed if you make a mistake, only for what your hearts deliberately intend; God is most forgiving and merciful.
te.33:6: The Prophet is more protective towards the believers than they are themselves, while his wives are their mothers. In God’s Scripture, blood-relatives have a stronger claim than other believers and emigrants, though you may still bestow gifts on your proteges. All this is written in the Scripture.
te.33:7: We took a solemn pledge from the prophets- from you [Muhammad], from Noah, from Abraham, from Moses, from Jesus, son of Mary- We took a solemn pledge from all of them:
te.33:8: God will question [even] the truthful about their sincerity, and for those who reject the truth He has prepared a painful torment.
te.33:9: You who believe, remember God’s goodness to you when mighty armies massed against you: We sent a violent wind and invisible forces against them. God sees all that you do.
te.33:10: They massed against you from above and below; your eyes rolled [with fear], your hearts rose into your throats, and you thought [ill] thoughts of God.
te.33:11: There the believers were sorely tested and deeply shaken:
te.33:12: the hypocrites and the sick at heart said, ‘God and His Messenger promised us nothing but delusions!’
te.33:13: Some of them said, ‘People of Yathrib, you will not be able to withstand [the attack], so go back!’ Some of them asked the Prophet’s permission to leave, saying, ‘Our houses are exposed,’ even though they were not- they just wanted to run away:
te.33:14: had the city been invaded from all sides, and the enemy invited them to rebel, they would have done so almost without hesitation.
te.33:15: Yet they had already promised God that they would not turn tail and flee, and a promise to God will be answered for.
te.33:16: [Prophet], say, ‘Running away will not benefit you. If you manage to escape death or slaughter, you will only be permitted to enjoy [life] for a short while.’
te.33:17: Say, ‘If God wishes to harm you, who can protect you? If God wishes to show you mercy, who can prevent Him?’ They will find no one but God to protect or help them.
te.33:18: God knows exactly who among you hinder others, who [secretly] say to their brothers, ‘Come and join us,’ who hardly ever come out to fight,
te.33:19: who begrudge you [believers] any help. When fear comes, you [Prophet] see them looking at you with eyes rolling like someone in their death throes; when fear has passed, they attack you with sharp tongues and begrudge you any good. Such men do not believe, and God brings their deeds to nothing- that is all too easy for God.
te.33:20: They think the joint forces have not gone, and if the joint forces did come again they would wish they were in the desert, wandering among the Bedouin and seeking news about you [from a safe distance]. Even if they were with you [believers], they would hardly fight at all.
te.33:21: The Messenger of God is an excellent model for those of you who put your hope in God and the Last Day and remember Him often.
te.33:22: When the believers saw the joint forces, they said, ‘This is what God and His Messenger promised us: the promise of God and His Messenger is true,’ and this only served to increase their faith and submission to God.
te.33:23: There are men among the believers who honoured their pledge to God: some of them have fulfilled it by death, and some are still waiting. They have not changed in the least.
te.33:24: [Such trials are ordained] so that God may reward the truthful for their honesty and punish the hypocrites, if He so wills, or He may relent towards them, for God is forgiving and merciful.
te.33:25: God sent back the disbelievers along with their rage- they gained no benefit–– and spared the believers from fighting. He is strong and mighty.
te.33:26: He brought those People of the Book who supported them down from their strongholds and put panic into their hearts. Some of them you [believers] killed and some you took captive.
te.33:27: He passed on to you their land, their houses, their possessions, and a land where you had not set foot: God has power over everything.
te.33:28: Prophet, say to your wives,‘If your desire is for the present life and its finery, then come, I will make provision for you and release you with kindness,
te.33:29: but if you desire God, His Messenger, and the Final Home, then remember that God has prepared great rewards for those of you who do good.’
te.33:30: Wives of the Prophet, if any of you does something clearly outrageous, she will be doubly punished- that is easy for God-
te.33:31: but if any of you is obedient to God and His Messenger and does good deeds, know that We shall give her a double reward and have prepared a generous provision for her.
te.33:32: Wives of the Prophet, you are not like any other woman. If you are truly mindful of God, do not speak too softly in case the sick at heart should lust after you, but speak in an appropriate manner;
te.33:33: stay at home, and do not flaunt your finery as they used to in the pagan past; keep up the prayer, give the prescribed alms, and obey God and His Messenger. God wishes to keep uncleanness away from you, people of the [Prophet’s] House, and to purify you thoroughly.
te.33:34: Remember what is recited in your houses of God’s revelations and wisdom, for God is all subtle, all aware.
te.33:35: For men and women who are devoted to God- believing men and women, obedient men and women, truthful men and women, steadfast men and women, humble men and women, charitable men and women, fasting men and women, chaste men and women, men and women who remember God often- God has prepared forgiveness and a rich reward.
te.33:36: When God and His Messenger have decided on a matter that concerns them, it is not fitting for any believing man or woman to claim freedom of choice in that matter: whoever disobeys God and His Messenger is far astray.
te.33:37: When you [Prophet] said to the man who had been favoured by God and by you, ‘Keep your wife and be mindful of God,’ you hid in your heart what God would later reveal: you were afraid of people, but it is more fitting that you fear God. When Zayd no longer wanted her, We gave her to you in marriage so that there might be no fault in believers marrying the wives of their adopted sons after they no longer wanted them. God’s command must be carried out:
te.33:38: the Prophet is not at fault for what God has ordained for him. This was God’s practice with those who went before- God’s command must be fulfilled-
te.33:39: [and with all] those who deliver God’s messages and fear only Him and no other: God’s reckoning is enough.
te.33:40: Muhammad is not the father of any one of you men; he is God’s Messenger and the seal of the prophets: God knows everything.
te.33:42: and glorify Him morning and evening:
te.33:43: it is He who blesses you, as do His angels, in order to lead you out of the depths of darkness into the light. He is ever merciful towards the believers-
te.33:44: when they meet Him they will be greeted with ‘Peace’- and He has prepared a generous reward for them.
te.33:45: Prophet, We have sent you as a witness, as a bearer of good news and warning,
te.33:46: as one who calls people to God by His leave, as a light-giving lamp.
te.33:47: Give the believers the good news that great bounty awaits them from God.
te.33:48: Do not give in to the disbelievers and the hypocrites: ignore the harm they cause you and put your trust in God. God is enough to trust.
te.33:49: Believers, you have no right to expect a waiting period when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them: make provision for them and release them in an honourable way.
te.33:50: Prophet, We have made lawful for you the wives whose bride gift you have paid, and any slaves God has assigned to you through war, and the daughters of your uncles and aunts on your father’s and mother’s sides, who migrated with you. Also any believing woman who has offered herself to the Prophet and whom the Prophet wishes to wed- this is only for you [Prophet] and not the rest of the believers: We know exactly what We have made obligatory for them concerning their wives and slave-girls- so you should not be blamed: God is most forgiving, most merciful.
te.33:51: You may make any of [your women] wait and receive any of them as you wish, but you will not be at fault if you invite one whose turn you have previously set aside: this way it is more likely that they will be satisfied and will not be distressed and will all be content with what you have given them. God knows what is in your hearts: God is all knowing, forbearing.
te.33:52: You [Prophet] are not permitted to take any further wives, nor to exchange the wives you have for others, even if these attract you with their beauty. But this does not apply to your slave-girls: God is watchful over all.
te.33:53: Believers, do not enter the Prophet’s apartments for a meal unless you are given permission to do so; do not linger until [a meal] is ready. When you are invited, go in; then, when you have taken your meal, leave. Do not stay on and talk, for that would offend the Prophet, though he would shrink from asking you to leave. God does not shrink from the truth. When you ask his wives for something, do so from behind a screen: this is purer both for your hearts and for theirs. It is not right for you to offend God’s Messenger, just as you should never marry his wives after him: that would be grievous in God’s eyes.
te.33:54: God has full knowledge of all things, whether you reveal them or not.
te.33:55: The Prophet’s wives are not to blame [if they are seen by] their fathers, their sons, their brothers, their brothers’ sons, their sisters’ sons, their women, or their slaves. [Wives of the Prophet], be mindful of God. God observes everything.
te.33:56: God and His angels bless the Prophet- so, you who believe, bless him too and give him greetings of peace.
te.33:57: Those who insult God and His Messenger will be rejected by God in this world and the next- He has prepared a humiliating torment for them-
te.33:58: and those who undeservedly insult believing men and women will bear the guilt of slander and flagrant sin.
te.33:59: Prophet, tell your wives, your daughters, and women believers to make their outer garments hang low over them so as to be recog-nized and not insulted: God is most forgiving, most merciful.
te.33:60: If the hypocrites, the sick at heart, and those who spread lies in the city do not desist, We shall rouse you [Prophet] against them, and then they will only be your neighbours in this city for a short while.
te.33:61: They will be rejected. Wherever they are found, they will be arrested and put to death.
te.33:62: This has been God’s practice with those who went before. You will find no change in God’s practices.
