te.33:63: People ask you about the Hour. Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of it.’ How could you [Prophet] know? The Hour may well be near.
te.33:64: God has rejected the disbelievers and prepared a blazing fire for them.
te.33:65: There they will stay permanently, with no one to befriend or support them.
te.33:66: On the Day when their faces are being turned about in the Fire, they will say, ‘If only we had obeyed God and the Messenger,’
te.33:67: and ‘Lord! We obeyed our masters and our chiefs, and they led us astray.
te.33:68: Lord! Give them a double punishment and reject them completely.’
te.33:69: Believers, do not be like those who insulted Moses- God cleared him of their allegations and he was highly honoured in God’s eyes.
te.33:70: Believers, be mindful of God, speak in a direct fashion and to good purpose,
te.33:71: and He will put your deeds right for you and forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys God and His Messenger will truly achieve a great triumph.
te.33:72: We offered the Trust to the heavens, the earth, and the mountains, yet they refused to undertake it and were afraid of it; mankind undertook it- they have always been inept and foolish.
te.33:73: God will punish the hypocrites and the idolaters, both men and women, and turn with mercy to the believers, both men and women: God is most forgiving, most merciful.
te.34:1: Praise be to God, to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and earth, and praise be to Him in the life to come. He is the All Wise, the All Aware.
te.34:2: He knows all that goes into the earth and all that comes out of it; He knows all that comes down from the heavens and all that goes up to them. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
te.34:3: Still, the disbelievers say, ‘The Last Hour will never come upon us.’ Say, ‘Yes, by my Lord, [it will], by Him who knows the unseen! Not even the weight of a speck of dust in the heavens or earth escapes His knowledge, nor anything smaller or greater. It is all recorded in a clear Record
te.34:4: so that He can reward those who believe and do good deeds: they will have forgiveness and generous provision.’
te.34:5: But as for those who work against Our Revelations, seeking to undermine them, there will be a torment of painful suffering.
te.34:6: [Prophet], those who have been given knowledge can see that what has been sent to you from your Lord is the truth, and that it leads to the path of the Almighty, worthy of all praise.
te.34:7: But the disbelievers say, ‘Shall we show you a man who claims that, when you have been utterly torn to pieces, you will be raised in a new creation?
te.34:8: Has he invented a lie about God? Is he mad?’ No! It is those who do not believe in the life to come who will suffer torment, for they are in gross error.
te.34:9: Do they not think about what is in front of them and behind them in the heavens and earth? If We wished, We could make the earth swallow them, or make fragments from the heavens fall down upon them. There truly is a sign in this for every servant who turns back to God in repentance.
te.34:10: We graced David with Our favour. We said, ‘You mountains, echo God’s praises together with him, and you birds, too.’ We softened iron for him,
te.34:11: saying, ‘Make coats of chain mail and measure the links well.’ ‘Do good, all of you, for I see everything you do.’
te.34:12: And [We subjected] the wind for Solomon. Its outward journey took a month, and its return journey likewise. We made a fountain of molten brass flow for him, and some of the jinn worked under his control with his Lord’s permission. If one of them deviated from Our command, We let him taste the suffering of the blazing flame.
te.34:13: They made him whatever he wanted- palaces, statues, basins as large as water troughs, fixed cauldrons. We said, ‘Work thankfully, family of David, for few of my servants are truly thankful.’
te.34:14: Then, when We decreed Solomon’s death, nothing showed the jinn he was dead, but a creature of the earth eating at his stick: when he fell down they realized- if they had known what was hidden they would not have continued their demeaning labour.
te.34:15: There was a sign for the people of Sheba, too, in their dwelling place: two gardens, one on the right, one on the left: ‘Eat from what your Lord has provided for you and give Him thanks, for your land is good, and your Lord most forgiving.’
te.34:16: But they paid no heed, so We let loose on them a flood from the dam and replaced their two gardens with others that yielded bitter fruit, tamarisk bushes, and a few lote trees.
te.34:17: In this way We punished them for their ingratitude- would We punish anyone but the ungrateful?
te.34:18: Also, We had placed, between them and the towns We had blessed, other towns within sight of one another to which they could travel easily- ‘ Travel safely in this land by night and by day’-
te.34:19: but [still] they complained, ‘Our Lord has made the distance between our staging posts so long!’They wronged themselves and, in the end, We made their fate a byword, and scattered them in countless fragments. There truly are signs in this for every patient, thankful person.
te.34:20: Satan was proved right in his opinion of them, for they all followed him- except for a group of believers-
te.34:21: even though he had no authority over them. But [We aim] to distinguish those who believe in the life to come from those who doubt it: [Prophet], your Lord observes everything.
te.34:22: Say, ‘Pray to your so-called gods besides God: they do not control even the weight of a speck of dust in heaven or earth, nor do they have any share in them, nor are any of them any help to God.
te.34:23: Intercession will not work with Him, except by those to whom He gives permission.’ They will be asked, after the terror is lifted from their hearts [on the Day of Judgement], ‘What did your Lord speak?’ and they will answer, ‘The Truth. He is the Most High, the Most Great.’
te.34:24: Say [Prophet], ‘Who gives you sustenance from the heavens and earth?’ Say, ‘God does,’ and ‘[One party of us] must be rightly guided and the other clearly astray.’
te.34:25: Say, ‘You will not be ques-tioned about our sins, nor will we be questioned about what you do.’
te.34:26: Say, ‘Our Lord will gather us together, then He will judge justly between us; He alone is the All Knowing Judge.’
te.34:27: Say, ‘Show me those you joined to Him as partners. No indeed! He alone is God, the Almighty, the All Wise.’
te.34:28: We have sent you [Prophet] only to bring good news and warning to all people, but most of them do not understand.
te.34:29: And they say, ‘If what you say is true, when will this promise be fulfilled?’
te.34:30: Say, ‘You have an appointment for a Day which you cannot put off nor bring forward, even by a single moment.’
te.34:31: The disbelievers say, ‘We will believe neither this Qur an nor the Scriptures that came before it.’ If only you could see [Prophet] how the wrongdoers will be made to stand before their Lord, hurling reproaches at one another. Those who were oppressed will say to the oppressors, ‘If it were not for you, we would have been believers.’
te.34:32: The oppressors will say to them, ‘Was it we who prevented you from following right guidance after it had reached you? No! You yourselves were sinners.’
te.34:33: The oppressed will say to them, ‘No, it was your scheming, night and day, ordering us to disbelieve in God and set up rivals to Him.’ When they see the punishment, they will fall silent with regret, and We shall put iron collars on the disbelievers’ necks. Why should they be rewarded for anything other than what they have done?
te.34:34: Never have We sent a warner to a community without those among them who were corrupted by wealth saying, ‘We do not believe in the message you have been sent with.’
te.34:35: They would say, ‘We have greater wealth and more children than you, and we shall not be punished.’
te.34:36: Say [Prophet], ‘My Lord gives in abundance to whoever He will and sparingly to whoever He will, though most people do not understand.
te.34:37: Neither wealth nor children will bring you nearer to Us, but those who believe and do good deeds will have multiple rewards for what they have done, and will live safely in the lofty dwellings of Paradise,
te.34:38: whereas those who work against Our messages, seeking to undermine them, will be summoned to punishment.’
te.34:39: Say, ‘My Lord gives in abundance to whichever of His servants He will, and sparingly to whichever He will; He will replace whatever you give in alms; He is the best of providers.’
te.34:40: On the Day He gathers them all together, He will say to the angels, ‘Was it you these people worshipped?’
te.34:41: They will reply, ‘May You be exalted! You are our supporter against them! Really, they worshipped the jinn- most of them believed in them.’
te.34:42: ‘So today neither of you has any power to benefit or harm the other,’ We shall tell the evildoers, ‘Taste the torment of the fire which you called a lie.’
te.34:43: When Our messages are recited to them, clear as they are, they say, ‘This is only a man who wants to turn you away from what your forefathers worshipped,’ and, ‘This [Quran] is nothing but lies he has made up.’ When the Truth comes to the disbelievers, they say, ‘This is just plain sorcery,’
te.34:44: though We have not given them any books to study nor sent any warner before you.
te.34:45: Those who lived before them also denied the truth- these people have not attained even a tenth of what We gave their predecessors- they, too, rejected My messengers, and how terrible My condemnation was!
te.34:46: Say [Prophet], ‘I advise you to do one thing only: stand before God, in pairs or singly, and think: there is no sign of madness in your companion [the Prophet]- he is only warning you before severe suffering arrives.’
te.34:47: Say, ‘If I have asked you for any reward, you can keep it. It is God alone who will reward me: He is witness to everything.’
te.34:48: Say, ‘My Lord hurls the Truth down [before you]. He has full knowledge of all that is unseen.’
te.34:49: Say, ‘The Truth has come; falsehood is powerless.’
te.34:50: Say, ‘If I go astray, that is my loss, and if I am rightly guided, it is through what my Lord has revealed to me. He is all hearing, and ever near.’
te.34:51: [Prophet], if you could only see their terror! There will be no escape when they are seized from a nearby place;
te.34:52: they will say, ‘Now we believe in it,’ but how can they reach it from such a distant place-
te.34:53: they denied it all in the past, and threw conjecture from a faroff place-
te.34:54: when a barrier has been placed between them and what they desire, just as was done with their kind before? They were deep in doubt and suspicion.
te.35:1: Praise be to God, Creator of the heavens and earth, who made angels messengers with two, three, four [pairs of] wings. He adds to creation as He will: God has power over everything.
te.35:2: No one can withhold the blessing God opens up for people, nor can anyone but Him release whatever He withholds: He is the Almighty, the All Wise.
te.35:3: People, remember God’s grace towards you. Is there any creator other than God to give you sustenance from the heavens and earth? There is no god but Him. How can you be so deluded?
te.35:4: If they call you a liar [Prophet], many messengers before you were also called liars: it is to God that all things will be returned.
te.35:5: People! God’s promise is true, so do not let the present life deceive you. Do not let the Deceiver deceive you about God:
te.35:6: Satan is your enemy––so treat him as an enemy––and invites his followers only to enter the blazing fire.
te.35:7: Those who disbelieve will be punished severely; those who believe and do good deeds will be forgiven, and richly rewarded.
te.35:8: What about those whose evil deeds are made alluring to them so that they think they are good? God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will. [Prophet], do not waste your soul away with regret for them: God knows exactly what they do.
te.35:9: It is God who sends forth the winds; they raise up the clouds; We drive them to a dead land and with them revive the earth after its death: such will be the Resurrection.
te.35:10: If anyone desires power, all power belongs to God; good words rise up to Him and He lifts up the righteous deed, but a severe torment awaits those who plot evil and their plotting will come to nothing.
te.35:11: It is God who created you from dust and later from a drop of fluid; then He made you into two sexes; no female conceives or gives birth without His knowledge; no person grows old or has his life cut short, except in accordance with a Record: all this is easy for God.
te.35:12: The two bodies of water are not alike- one is palatable, sweet, and pleasant to drink, the other salty and bitter- yet from each you eat fresh fish and extract ornaments to wear, and in each you see the ships ploughing their course so that you may seek God’s bounty and be grateful.
te.35:13: He makes the night merge into the day and the day into the night; He has subjected the sun and the moon- each runs for an appointed term. Such is God your Lord: all control belongs to Him. Those you invoke beside Him do not even control the skin of a date stone;
te.35:14: if you call them they cannot hear you; if they could hear, they could not answer you; on the Day of Resurrection they will disown your idolatry. None can inform you [Prophet] like the One who is all aware.
te.35:15: People, it is you who stand in need of God- God needs nothing and is worthy of all praise-
te.35:16: if He wills, He can do away with you and bring in a new creation,
te.35:17: that is not difficult for God.
te.35:18: No burdened soul will bear the burden of another: even if a heavily laden soul should cry for help, none of its load will be carried, not even by a close relative. But you [Prophet] can only warn those who fear their Lord, though they cannot see Him, and keep up the prayer- whoever purifies himself does so for his own benefit–– everything returns to God.
te.35:19: The blind and the seeing are not alike,
te.35:21: shade and heat are not alike,
te.35:22: nor are the living and the dead. God makes anyone He wills hear [His message]: you cannot make those in their graves hear.
te.35:23: You are only here to warn them-
te.35:24: We have sent you with the Truth as a bearer of good news and warning- every community has been sent a warner.
te.35:25: If they call you a liar, their predecessors did the same: messengers came to them with clear signs, scriptures, and enlightening revelation
te.35:26: and afterwards I seized the disbelievers- how terrible My punishment was!
te.35:27: Have you [Prophet] not considered how God sends water down from the sky and that We produce with it fruits of varied colours; that there are in the mountains layers of white and red of various hues, and jet black;
te.35:28: that there are various colours among human beings, wild animals, and livestock too? It is those of His servants who have knowledge who stand in true awe of God. God is almighty, most forgiving.
te.35:29: Those who recite God’s scripture, keep up the prayer, give secretly and openly from what We have provided for them, may hope for a trade that will never decline:
te.35:30: He will repay them in full, and give them extra from His bounty. He is most forgiving, most appreciative.
te.35:31: The Scripture We have revealed to you [Prophet] is the Truth and confirms the scriptures that preceded it. God is well informed about His servants, He sees everything.
te.35:32: We gave the Scripture as a heritage to Our chosen servants: some of them wronged their own souls, some stayed between [right and wrong], and some, by God’s leave, were foremost in good deeds. That is the greatest favour:
te.35:33: they will enter lasting Gardens where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, where they will wear silk garments.
te.35:34: They will say, ‘Praise be to God, who has separated us from all sorrow! Our Lord is truly most forgiving, most appreciative:
te.35:35: He has, in His bounty, settled us in the everlasting Home where no toil or fatigue will touch us.’
te.35:36: But those who reject the truth will stay in Hellfire, where they will neither be finished off by death, nor be relieved from Hell’s torment: this is how We reward hardened disbelievers.
te.35:37: They will cry out loud in Hell, ‘Lord, let us out, and we will do righteous deeds, not what we did before!’- ‘ Did We not give you a life long enough to take warning if you were going to? The warner came to you, now taste the punishment.’ The evildoers will have nobody to help them.
te.35:38: God knows all that is hidden in the heavens and earth; He knows the thoughts contained in the heart;
te.35:39: it is He who made you [people] successors to the land. Those who deny the truth will bear the consequences: their denial will only make them more odious to their Lord, and add only to their loss.
te.35:40: Say, ‘Consider those “partners” of yours that you call upon beside God. Show me! What part of the earth did they create? What share of the heavens do they possess?’ Have We given them a book that contains clear evidence? No indeed! The idolaters promise each other only delusion.
te.35:41: God keeps the heavens and earth from vanishing; if they did vanish, no one else could stop them. God is most forbearing, most forgiving.
te.35:42: [The idolaters] swore their most solemn oath that, if someone came to warn them, they would be more rightly guided than any [other] community, but when someone did come they turned yet further away,
te.35:43: became more arrogant in the land, and intensified their plotting of evil- the plotting of evil only rebounds on those who plot. Do they expect anything but what happened to earlier people? You will never find any change in God’s practice; you will never find any deviation there.
te.35:44: Have they not travelled in the land and seen how those before them met their end, although they were superior to them in strength? God is not to be frustrated by anything in the heavens or on the earth: He is all knowing, all powerful.
te.35:45: If God were to punish people [at once] for the wrong they have done, there would not be a single creature left on the surface of the earth. He gives them respite for a stated time and, whenever their time comes, God has been watching His servants.
te.36:3: you [Muhammad] are truly one of the mes-sengers sent
te.36:5: with a revelation from the Almighty, the Lord of Mercy,
te.36:6: to warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so they are unaware.
te.36:7: The verdict has been passed against most of them, for they refuse to believe.
te.36:8: [It is as if] We had placed [iron] collars around their necks, right up to their chins so that their heads are forced up
te.36:9: and set barriers before and behind them, blocking their vision: they cannot see.
te.36:10: It is all the same to them whether you warn them or not: they will not believe.
te.36:11: You can warn only those who will follow the Quran and hold the Merciful One in awe, though they cannot see Him: give such people the glad news of forgiveness and a noble reward.
te.36:12: We shall certainly bring the dead back to life, and We record what they send ahead of them as well as what they leave behind: We keep an account of everything in a clear Record.
te.36:13: Give them the example of the people to whose town messengers came.
te.36:14: We sent two messengers but they rejected both. Then We reinforced them with a third. They said, ‘Truly, we are messengers to you,’
te.36:15: but they answered, ‘You are only men like ourselves. The Lord of Mercy has sent nothing; you are just lying.'
te.36:16: They said, ‘Our Lord knows that we have been sent to you.
te.36:17: Our duty is only to deliver the message to you,’
te.36:18: but they answered, ‘We think you are an evil omen. If you do not stop, we shall stone you, and inflict a painful torment on you.’
te.36:19: The messengers said, ‘The evil omen is within yourselves. Why do you take it as an evil omen when you are reminded of the Truth? You are going too far!’
te.36:20: Then, from the furthest part of the city, a man came running. He said, ‘My people, follow the messengers.
te.36:21: Follow them: they are not asking you to reward them and they are rightly guided.
te.36:22: Why should I not worship the One who created me? It is to Him that you will be returned.
te.36:23: How could I take besides Him any other gods, whose intercession will not help me and who would not be able to save me if the Lord of Mercy wished to harm me?
te.36:24: Then I would clearly be in the wrong.
te.36:25: I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.’
te.36:26: He was told, ‘Enter the Garden,’ so he said, ‘If only my people knew
te.36:27: how my Lord has forgiven me and set me among the highly honoured.’
te.36:28: After him We did not send any army from heaven against his people, nor were We about to:
te.36:29: there was just one blast, and they fell down lifeless.
te.36:30: Alas for human beings! Whenever a messenger comes to them they ridicule him.
te.36:31: Do they not see how many generations We have destroyed before them, none of whom will ever come back to them?
te.36:32: [Yet] all of them will be brought before Us.
te.36:33: There is a sign for them in the lifeless earth: We give it life and We produce grain from it for them to eat;
te.36:34: We have put gardens of date palms and grapes in the earth, and We have made springs of water gush out of it
te.36:35: so that they could eat its fruit. It was not their own hands that made all this. How can they not give thanks?
te.36:36: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs of things that the earth produces, as well as themselves and other things they do not know about.
te.36:37: The night is also a sign for them: We strip the daylight from it, and- lo and behold!- they are in darkness.
te.36:38: The sun, too, runs its determined course laid down for it by the Almighty, the All Knowing.
te.36:39: We have determined phases for the moon until finally it becomes like an old date-stalk.
te.36:40: The sun cannot overtake the moon, nor can the night outrun the day: each floats in [its own] orbit.
te.36:41: Another sign for them is that We carried their seed in the laden Ark,
te.36:42: and We have made similar things for them to ride in.
te.36:43: If We wished, We could drown them, and there would be no one to help them: they could not be saved.
te.36:44: Only by Our mercy could they be reprieved to enjoy life for a while.
te.36:45: Yet when they are told, ‘Beware of what lies before and behind you, so that you may be given mercy,’
te.36:46: they ignore every single sign that comes to them from their Lord,
te.36:47: and when they are told, ‘Give to others out of what God has provided for you,’ the disbelievers say to the believers, ‘Why should we feed those that God could feed if He wanted? You must be deeply misguided.’
te.36:48: And they say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
te.36:49: But all they are waiting for is a single blast that will overtake them while they are still arguing with each other.
te.36:50: They will have no time to make bequests, nor will they have the chance to return to their own people.
te.36:51: The Trumpet will be sounded and- lo and behold!- they will rush out to their Lord from their graves.
te.36:52: They will say, ‘Alas for us! Who has resurrected us from our resting places?’ [They will be told], ‘This is what the Lord of Mercy promised, and the messengers told the truth.’
te.36:53: It was just one single blast and then- lo and behold!- they were all brought before Us.
te.36:54: ‘Today, no soul will be wronged in the least: you will only be repaid for your deeds.
te.36:55: The people of Paradise today are happily occupied-
te.36:56: they and their spouses- seated on couches in the shade.
te.36:57: There they have fruit and whatever they ask for.
te.36:58: “Peace,” a word from the Lord of Mercy.
te.36:59: But step aside today, you guilty ones.
te.36:60: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan, for he was your sworn enemy,
te.36:61: but to serve Me? This is the straight path.
te.36:62: He has led great numbers of you astray. Did you not use your reason?
te.36:63: So this is the Fire that you were warned against.
te.36:64: Enter it today, because you went on ignoring [my commands].’
te.36:65: On that Day We shall seal up their mouths, but their hands will speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to everything they have done.
te.36:66: If it had been Our will, We could have taken away their sight. They would have struggled to find the way, but how could they have seen it?
te.36:67: If it had been Our will, We could have paralysed them where they stood, so that they could not move forward or backward.
te.36:68: If We extend anyone’s life, We reverse his development. Do they not use their reason?
te.36:69: We have not taught the Prophet poetry, nor could he everhave been a poet.
te.36:70: This is a revelation, an illuminating Quran to warn anyone who is truly alive, so that God’s verdict may be passed against the disbelievers.
te.36:71: Can they not see how, among the things made by Our hands, We have created livestock they control,
te.36:72: and made them obedient, so that some can be used for riding, some for food,
te.36:73: some for other benefits, and some for drink? Will they not give thanks?
te.36:74: Yet they have taken other gods besides God to help them,
te.36:75: though these could not do so even if they called a whole army of them together!
te.36:76: So [Prophet] do not be distressed at what they say: We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
te.36:77: Can man not see that We created him from a drop of fluid? Yet- lo and behold!- he disputes openly,
te.36:78: producing arguments against Us, forgetting his own creation. He says, ‘Who can give life back to bones after they have decayed?’
te.36:79: Say, ‘He who created them in the first place will give them life again: He has full knowledge of every act of creation.
te.36:80: It is He who produces fire for you out of the green tree- lo and behold!- and from this you kindle fire.
te.36:81: Is He who created the heavens and earth not able to create the likes of these people? Of course He is! He is the All Knowing Creator:
te.36:82: when He wills something to be, His way is to say, “Be”- and it is!
te.36:83: So glory be to Him in whose Hand lies control over all things. It is to Him that you will all be brought back.’
te.37:5: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them, Lord of every sunrise.
te.37:6: We have adorned the lowest heaven with stars,
te.37:7: and made them a safeguard against every rebellious devil:
te.37:8: they cannot eavesdrop on the Higher Assembly––pelted from every side,
te.37:9: driven away, they will have perpetual torment––
te.37:10: if any [of them] stealthily snatches away a fragment, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.
te.37:11: So [Prophet], ask the disbelievers: is it harder to create them than other beings We have created? We created them from sticky clay.
te.37:13: take no heed when they are warned,
te.37:14: and resort to ridicule when they see a sign,
te.37:15: saying, ‘This is no more than blatant sorcery.’
te.37:16: ‘What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we really be raised up again,
te.37:18: Say, ‘Yes indeed, and you will be humiliated.’
te.37:19: Just one blast and––lo and behold!––they will look
te.37:20: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgement.’
te.37:21: [It will be said], ‘This is the Day of Decision, which you used to deny.
te.37:22: [Angels], gather together those who did wrong, and others like them, as well as whatever they worshipped
te.37:23: beside God, lead them all to the path of Hell,
te.37:25: “Why do you not support each other now?” ’––
te.37:26: no indeed! They will be in complete submission on that Day––
te.37:27: and they will turn on one another accusingly.
te.37:28: They will say, ‘You came to us from a position of power.’
te.37:29: They will say, ‘No! It was you who would not believe-
te.37:30: we had no power over you- and you were already exceeding all limits.
te.37:31: Our Lord’s sentence on us is just and we must all taste the punishment.
te.37:32: We led you astray as we ourselves were astray.’
te.37:33: On that Day they will all share the torment:
te.37:34: this is how We deal with the guilty.
te.37:35: Whenever it was said to them, ‘There is no deity but God,’ they became arrogant,
te.37:36: and said, ‘Are we to forsake our gods for a mad poet?’
te.37:37: ‘No: he brought the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers;
te.37:38: you will taste the painful torment,
te.37:39: and be repaid only according to your deeds.’
te.37:44: seated on couches, facing one another.
te.37:45: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring:
te.37:46: white, delicious to those who taste it,
te.37:48: With them will be spouses- modest of gaze and beautiful of eye-
te.37:50: They will turn to one another with questions:
te.37:51: one will say, ‘I had a close companion on earth
te.37:52: who used to ask me, “Do you really believe that
te.37:53: after we die and become dust and bone, we shall be brought for judgement?”’
te.37:54: Then he will say, ‘Shall we look for him?’
te.37:55: He will look down and see him in the midst of the Fire,
te.37:56: and say to him, ‘By God, you almost brought me to ruin!
te.37:57: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I too would have been taken to Hell.’
te.37:58: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], ‘Are we never to die again after our earlier death?
te.37:60: This truly is the supreme triumph!’
te.37:61: Everyone should strive to attain this.
te.37:62: Is this the better welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum,
te.37:63: which we have made a test for the evildoers?
te.37:64: This tree grows in the heart of the blazing Fire,
te.37:65: and its fruits are like devils’ heads.
te.37:66: They will fill their bellies eating from it;
te.37:67: then drink scalding water on top of it;
te.37:68: then return to the blazing Fire.
te.37:70: and rushed to follow in their footsteps- before the disbelievers [of Mecca],
te.37:71: most men in the past went astray,
te.37:72: even though We sent messengers to warn them.
te.37:73: See how those who were warned met their end!
te.37:74: Not so the true servants of God.
te.37:75: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response!
te.37:76: We saved him and his people from great distress,
te.37:77: We let his offspring remain on the earth,
te.37:78: We let him be praised by later generations:
te.37:79: ‘Peace be upon Noah among all the nations!’
te.37:80: This is how We reward those who do good:
te.37:81: he was truly one of Our faithful servants.
te.37:83: Abraham was of the same faith:
te.37:84: he came to his Lord with a devoted heart.
te.37:85: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are you worshipping?
te.37:86: How can you choose false gods instead of the true God?
te.37:87: So what is your opinion about the Lord of all the Worlds?’
te.37:88: then he looked up to the stars.
te.37:90: so [his people] turned away from him and left.
te.37:91: He turned to their gods and said, ‘Do you not eat?
te.37:93: then he turned and struck them with his right arm.
te.37:95: but he said, ‘How can you worship things you carve with your own hands,
te.37:96: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?’
te.37:97: They said, ‘Build a pyre and throw him into the blazing fire.’
te.37:98: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them.
te.37:99: He said, ‘I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me.
te.37:100: Lord, grant me a righteous son,’
te.37:101: so We gave him the good news that he would have a patient son.
te.37:102: When the boy was old enough to work with his father, Abraham said, ‘My son, I have seen myself sacrificing you in a dream. What do you think?’ He said, ‘Father, do as you are commanded and, God willing, you will find me steadfast.’
te.37:103: When they had both submitted to God, and he had laid his son down on the side of his face,
te.37:105: you have fulfilled the dream.’ This is how We reward those who do good-
te.37:106: it was a test to prove [their true characters]-
te.37:107: We ransomed his son with a momentous sacrifice,
te.37:108: and We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
te.37:110: This is how We reward those who do good:
te.37:111: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
te.37:112: We gave Abraham the good news of Isaac- a prophet and a righteous man-
te.37:113: and blessed him and Isaac too: some of their offspring were good, but some clearly wronged themselves.
te.37:114: We also bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron:
te.37:115: We saved them and their people from great distress;
te.37:116: We helped them, so they were the ones to succeed;
te.37:117: We gave them the Scripture that makes things clear;
te.37:118: We guided them to the right path;
te.37:119: We let them be praised by succeeding generations:
te.37:121: This is how We reward those who do good:
te.37:122: truly they were among Our faithful servants.
te.37:123: Elijah too was one of the messengers.
te.37:124: He said to his people, ‘Have you no fear of God?
te.37:125: How can you invoke Baal and forsake the Most Gracious Creator,
te.37:126: God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’
te.37:127: but they rejected him. They will be brought to punishment as a consequence;
te.37:128: not so the true servants of God.
te.37:129: We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
te.37:131: This is how We reward those who do good:
te.37:132: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
te.37:133: Lot was also one of the messengers.
te.37:134: We saved him and all his family-
te.37:135: except for an old woman who stayed behind-
te.37:137: You [people] pass by their ruins morning
te.37:138: and night: will you not take heed?
te.37:139: Jonah too was one of the messengers.
te.37:140: He fled to the overloaded ship.
te.37:141: They cast lots, he suffered defeat,
te.37:142: and a great fish swallowed him, for he had committed blameworthy acts.
te.37:143: If he had not been one of those who glorified God,
te.37:144: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day when all are raised up,
te.37:145: but We cast him out, sick, on to a barren shore,
te.37:146: and made a gourd tree grow above him.
te.37:147: We sent him to a hundred thousand people or more.
te.37:148: They believed, so We let them live out their lives.
te.37:149: Now [Muhammad], ask the disbelievers: is it true that your Lord has daughters, while they choose sons for themselves?
te.37:150: Did We create the angels as females while they were watching?
te.37:151: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say,
te.37:153: Did He truly choose daughters in preference to sons?
te.37:154: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgements?
te.37:156: Do you perhaps have clear authority?
te.37:157: Bring your scriptures, if you are telling the truth.
te.37:158: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be brought before Him.
te.37:159: God is far above what they attribute to Him-
te.37:160: the true servants of God do not do such things-
te.37:161: and neither you nor what you worship
te.37:162: can lure away from God any
te.37:163: except those who will burn in Hell.
te.37:164: [The angels say], ‘Every single one of us has his appointed place:
te.37:168: ‘If only we had a scripture like previous people,
te.37:169: we would be true servants of God,’
te.37:170: yet now they reject [the Quran]. They will soon realize.
te.37:171: Our word has already been given to Our servants the messengers:
te.37:172: it is they who will be helped,
te.37:173: and the ones who support Our cause will be the winners.
te.37:174: So [Prophet] turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
te.37:175: Watch them: they will soon see.
te.37:176: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment?
te.37:177: When it descends on their courtyards, how ter-rible that morning will be for those who were warned!
te.37:178: [Prophet], turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
te.37:179: Watch them: they will soon see.
te.37:180: Your Lord, the Lord of Glory, is far above what they attribute to Him.
te.37:182: and praise be to God the Lord of all the Worlds.
te.38:1: Sad By the Quran with its reminding . . .!
te.38:2: Yet the disbelievers are steeped in arrogance and hostility.
te.38:3: How many generations We have destroyed before them! They all cried out, once it was too late, for escape.
te.38:4: The disbelievers think it strange that a prophet of their own people has come to warn them: they say, ‘He is just a lying sorcerer.
te.38:5: How can he claim that all the gods are but one God? What an astonishing thing [to claim]!’
te.38:6: Their leaders depart, saying, ‘Walk away! Stay faithful to your gods! That is what you must do.
te.38:7: We did not hear any such claim in the last religion: it is all an invention.
te.38:8: Was the message sent only to him out of all of us?’ In fact they doubt My warning; in fact they have not tasted My punishment yet.
te.38:9: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord’s bounty, the Mighty, the All Giving?
te.38:10: Do they control the heavens and earth and everything between? Let them climb their ropes:
te.38:11: their armed alliance is weak and will be crushed.
te.38:12: The people of Noah, Ad, and firmly-supported Pharaoh rejected their prophets before them.
te.38:13: Thamud, the people of Lot, and the Forest-Dwellers each formed opposition [against theirs].
te.38:14: They all rejected the mes-sengers and they were deservedly struck by My punishment:
te.38:15: all the disbelievers here are waiting for is a single blast that cannot be postponed.
te.38:16: They say, ‘Our Lord! Advance us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning!’
te.38:17: Bear their words patiently [Prophet]. Remember Our servant David, a man of strength who always turned to Us:
te.38:18: We made the mountains join him in glorifying Us at sunset and sunrise;
te.38:19: and the birds, too, in flocks, all echoed his praise.
te.38:20: We strengthened his kingdom; We gave him wisdom and a decisive way of speaking.
te.38:21: Have you heard the story of the two litigants who climbed into his private quarters?
te.38:22: When they reached David, he took fright, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid. We are two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other: judge between us fairly- do not be unjust- and guide us to the right path.
te.38:23: This is my brother. He had ninety-nine ewes and I just the one, and he said, “Let me take charge of her,” and overpowered me with his words.’
te.38:24: David said, ‘He has done you wrong by demanding to add your ewe to his flock. Many partners treat each other unfairly. Those who sincerely believe and do good deeds do not do this, but these are very few.’ [Then] David realized that We had been testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness, fell down on his knees, and repented:
te.38:25: We forgave him [his misdeed]. His reward will be nearness to Us, a good place to return to.
te.38:26: ‘David, We have given you mastery over the land. Judge fairly between people. Do not follow your desires, lest they divert you from God’s path: those who wander from His path will have a painful torment because they ignore the Day of Reckoning.’
te.38:27: It was not without purpose that We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between. That may be what the disbelievers assume- how they will suffer from the Fire!-
te.38:28: but would We treat those who believe and do good deeds and those who spread corruption on earth as equal? Would We treat those who are aware of God and those who recklessly break all bounds in the same way?
te.38:29: This is a blessed Scripture which We sent down to you [Muhammad], for people to think about its messages, and for those with understanding to take heed.
te.38:30: We gave David Solomon. He was an excellent servant who always turned to God.
te.38:31: When well-bred light-footed horses were paraded before him near the close of day,
te.38:32: he kept saying, ‘My love of fine things is part of my remembering my Lord!’ until [the horses] disappeared from sight-
te.38:33: ‘Bring them back!’ [he said] and started to stroke their legs and necks.
te.38:34: We certainly tested Solomon, reducing him to a mere skeleton on his throne.
te.38:35: He turned to Us and prayed: ‘Lord forgive me! Grant me such power as no one after me will have- You are the Most Generous Provider.’
te.38:36: So We gave him power over the wind, which at his request ran gently wherever he willed,
te.38:37: and the jinn––every kind of builder and diver
te.38:39: ‘This is Our gift, so give or withhold as you wish without account.’
te.38:40: His reward will be nearness to Us, and a good place to return to.
te.38:41: Bring to mind Our servant Job who cried to his Lord, ‘Satan has afflicted me with weariness and suffering.’
te.38:42: ‘Stamp your foot! Here is cool water for you to wash in and drink,’
te.38:43: and We restored his family to him, with many more like them: a sign of Our mercy and a lesson to all who understand.
te.38:44: ‘Take a small bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [her] with that so as not to break your oath.’ We found him patient in adversity; an excellent servant! He, too, always turned to God.
te.38:45: Remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, all men of strength and vision.
te.38:46: We caused them to be devoted to Us through their sincere remembrance of the Final Home:
te.38:47: with Us they will be among the elect, the truly good.
te.38:48: And remember Our servants Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu ’l-Kifl, each of them truly good.
te.38:49: This is a lesson. The devout will have a good place to return to:
te.38:50: Gardens of lasting bliss with gates wide open.
te.38:51: They will be comfortably seated; they will call for abundant fruit and drink;
te.38:52: they will have well-matched [wives] with modest gaze.
te.38:53: ‘This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning:
te.38:54: Our provision for you will never end.’
te.38:55: But the evildoers will have the worst place to return to:
te.38:56: Hell to burn in, an evil place to stay-
te.38:57: all this will be theirs: let them taste it- a scalding, dark, foul fluid,
te.38:59: [It will be said], ‘Here is another crowd of people rushing headlong to join you.’ [The response will be], ‘They are not welcome! They will burn in the Fire.’
te.38:60: They will say to them, ‘You are not welcome! It was you who brought this on us, an evil place to stay,’
te.38:61: adding, ‘Our Lord, give double punishment to those who brought this upon us.’
te.38:62: They will say, ‘Why do we not see those we thought were bad
te.38:63: and took as a laughing-stock? Have our eyes missed them?’
te.38:64: This is how it will really be: the inhabitants of the Fire will blame one another in this way.
te.38:65: [Prophet] say, ‘I am only here to give warning. There is no god but God the One, the All Powerful,
te.38:66: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Almighty, the Most Forgiving.’
te.38:67: Say, ‘This message is a mighty one,
te.38:69: I have no knowledge of what those on high discuss:
te.38:70: it is only revealed to me that I am here to give clear warning.’
te.38:71: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a man from clay.
te.38:72: When I have shaped him and breathed from My Spirit into him, bow down before him.’
te.38:73: The angels all bowed down together,
te.38:74: but not Iblis, who was too proud. He became a rebel.
te.38:75: God said, ‘Iblis, what prevents you from bowing down to the man I have made with My own hands? Are you too high and mighty?’
te.38:76: Iblis said, ‘I am better than him: You made me from fire, and him from clay.’
te.38:77: ‘Get out of here! You are rejected:
te.38:78: My rejection will follow you till the Day of Judgement!’
te.38:79: but Iblis said, ‘My Lord, grant me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead,’
te.38:82: Iblis said, ‘I swear by Your might! I will tempt all
te.38:84: God said, ‘This is the truth- I speak only the truth-
te.38:85: I will fill Hell with you and all those that follow you.’
te.38:86: [Prophet], say, ‘I ask no reward from you for this, nor do I claim to be what I am not:
te.38:87: this is only a warning for all people.
te.38:88: In time you will certainly come to know its truth.’
te.39:1: This Scripture is sent down from God the Mighty, the Wise.
te.39:2: It is We who sent down the Scripture to you [Prophet] with the Truth, so worship God with your total devotion:
te.39:3: true devotion is due to God alone. [As for] those who choose other protectors beside Him, saying, ‘We only worship them because they bring us nearer to God,’ God Himself will judge between them regarding their differences. God does not guide any ungrateful liar.
te.39:4: God could have chosen any of His creation He willed for offspring, but He is far above this! He is the One, the Almighty.
te.39:5: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose; He wraps the night around the day and the day around the night; He has subjected the sun and moon to run their courses for an appointed time; He is truly the Mighty, the Forgiving.
te.39:6: He created you all from a single being, from which He made its mate; He gave you four kinds of livestock in pairs; He creates you in your mothers’ wombs, in one stage after another, in threefold depths of darkness. Such is God, your Lord; He holds control, there is no god but Him. How can you turn away?
te.39:7: If you are ungrateful, remember God has no need of you, yet He is not pleased by ingrati-tude in His servants; if you are grateful, He is pleased [to see] it in you. No soul will bear another’s burden. You will return to your Lord in the end and He will inform you of what you have done: He knows well what is in the depths of [your] hearts.
te.39:8: When man suffers some affliction, he prays to his Lord and turns to Him, but once he has been granted a favour from God, he forgets the One he had been praying to and sets up rivals to God, to make others stray from His path. Say, ‘Enjoy your ingratitude for a little while: you will be one of the inhabitants of the Fire.’
te.39:9: What about someone who worships devoutly during the night, bowing down, standing in prayer, ever mindful of the life to come, hoping for his Lord’s mercy? Say, ‘How can those who know be equal to those who do not know?’ Only those who have understanding will take heed.
te.39:10: Say, ‘[God says], believing servants, be mindful of your Lord! Those who do good in this world will have a good reward- God’s earth is wide––and those who persevere patiently will be given a full and unstinting reward.’
te.39:11: Say, ‘I have been commanded to serve God, dedicating my worship entirely to Him.
te.39:12: I have been commanded to be the first to submit.’
te.39:13: Say, ‘I fear the torment of a terrible Day if I disobey my Lord.’
te.39:14: Say, ‘It is God I serve, dedicating my worship entirely to Him-
te.39:15: you may serve whatever you please beside Him.’ Say, ‘The true losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their people on the Day of Resurrection: that is the most obvious loss.
te.39:16: They will have layers of Fire above them and below.’ This is how God puts fear into His servants: My servants, beware of Me.
te.39:17: There is good news for those who shun the worship of false gods and turn to God, so [Prophet] give good news to My servants
te.39:18: who listen to what is said and follow what is best. These are the ones God has guided; these are the people of understanding.
te.39:19: What about the one who has been sentenced to punishment? Can you [Prophet] rescue those already in the Fire?
te.39:20: But those who are mindful of their Lord will have lofty dwellings built for them, one above the other, graced with flowing streams. This is a promise from God: God does not break His promise.
te.39:21: Have you not considered that God sends water down from the sky, guides it along to form springs in the earth, and then, with it, brings forth vegetation of various colours, which later withers, turns yellow before your eyes, and is crumbled to dust at His command? There is truly a reminder in this for those who have understanding.
te.39:22: What about the one whose heart God has opened in devotion to Him, so that he walks in light from his Lord? Alas for those whose hearts harden at the mention of God! They have clearly lost their way.
te.39:23: God has sent down the most beautiful of all teachings: a Scripture that is consistent and draws comparisons; that causes the skins of those in awe of their Lord to shiver. Then their skins and their hearts soften at the mention of God: such is God’s guidance. He guides with it whoever He will; no one can guide those God leaves to stray.
te.39:24: What about the one who will only have his bare face to protect him from his terrible suffering on the Day of Resurrection? It will be said to the evildoers, ‘Taste what you have earned.’
te.39:25: Others before them also disbelieved, and the punishment fell on them unawares:
te.39:26: God gave them the punishment of disgrace in this world to taste; the punishment will be even harder in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
te.39:27: In this Quran, We have put forward all kinds of illustration for people, so that they may take heed-
te.39:28: an Arabic Quran, free from any distortion- so that people may be mindful.
te.39:29: God puts forward this illustration: can a man who has for his masters several partners at odds with each other be considered equal to a man devoted wholly to one master? All praise belongs to God, though most of them do not know.
te.39:30: You [Prophet] will certainly die, and so will they,
te.39:31: and, on the Day of Resurrection, you will dispute with one another in the presence of your Lord.
te.39:32: So who could be more wrong than the person who invents a lie about God and rejects the truth when it comes to him? Is there not ample punishment for the disbelievers in Hell?
te.39:33: It is the one who brings the truth and the one who accepts it as true who are mindful of God:
te.39:34: they will have everything they wish for with their Lord. Such is the reward of those who do good:
te.39:35: God will absolve them even of their worst deeds and will reward them according to their best.
te.39:36: Is God not enough for His servant? Yet they threaten you [Prophet] with those they worship other than Him. If God allows someone to stray he has no one to guide him;
te.39:37: if God guides someone no one can lead him astray. Is God not mighty and capable of retribution?
te.39:38: If you [Prophet] ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and earth?’ they are sure to answer, ‘God,’ so say, ‘Consider those you invoke beside Him: if God wished to harm me, could they undo that harm? If God wished to show me mercy, could they withhold that mercy?’ Say, ‘God is enough for me: all those who trust should put their trust in Him.’
te.39:39: Say, ‘My people, do whatever is in your power- and so will I. You will find out
te.39:40: who will suffer humiliation, and on whom a lasting torment will descend.’
te.39:41: We have sent the Scripture down to you [Prophet] with the Truth for people. Whoever follows the guidance does so for his own benefit, whoever strays away from it does so at his own peril: you are not in charge of them.
te.39:42: God takes the souls of the dead and the souls of the living while they sleep- He keeps hold of those whose death He has ordained and sends the others back until their appointed time- there truly are signs in this for those who reflect.
te.39:43: Yet they take intercessors besides God! Say, ‘Even though these have no power or understanding?’
te.39:44: Say, ‘All intercession belongs to God alone; He holds control of the heavens and the earth; in the end you will all return to Him.’
te.39:45: Whenever God is mentioned on His own, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but they rejoice when gods other than Him are mentioned.
te.39:46: Say, ‘God! Creator of the heavens and earth! Knower of all that is hidden and all that is open, You will judge between Your servants regarding their differences.’
te.39:47: If the evildoers possessed the earth’s assets twice over they would offer them to ransom themselves from the terrible suffering on the Day of Resurrection: God will show them something they had not reckoned with,
te.39:48: the evil of their deeds will become plain to them, and they will be overwhelmed by that at which they used to laugh.
te.39:49: When man suffers some affliction, he cries out to Us, but when We favour him with Our blessing, he says, ‘All this has been given to me because of my knowledge’- it is only a test, though most of them do not know it.
te.39:50: Those who lived before them said the same. What they did was of no use to them;
te.39:51: they suffered its evil effects. Today’s wrongdoers will also suffer the evil effects of their deeds: they will not escape.
te.39:52: Do they not know that God provides abun-dantly for anyone He will and gives sparingly to anyone He will? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
te.39:53: Say, ‘[God says], My servants who have harmed yourselves by your own excess, do not despair of God’s mercy. God forgives all sins: He is truly the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
te.39:54: Turn to your Lord. Submit to Him before the punishment overtakes you and you can no longer be helped.
te.39:55: Follow the best teaching sent down to you from your Lord, before the punishment suddenly takes you, unawares,
te.39:56: and your soul says, “Woe is me for having neglected what is due to God, and having been one of those who scoffed!”
te.39:57: Or it says, “If God had guided me, I would have joined the righteous!”
te.39:58: Or, faced by punishment, it says, “If only I could have another chance, I would join those who do good!”
te.39:59: No indeed! My messages came to you and you rejected them: you were arrogant and rejected the truth.’
te.39:60: On the Day of Resurrection, you [Prophet] will see those who told lies against God, their faces darkened. Is there not ample punishment for the arrogant in Hell?
te.39:61: But God will deliver those who took heed of Him to their place of safety: no harm will touch them, nor will they grieve.
te.39:62: God is the Creator of all things; He has charge of everything;
te.39:63: the keys of the heavens and earth are His. Those who have rejected the revelations of God will be the losers.
te.39:64: Say, ‘Do you order me to worship someone other than God, you foolish people?’
te.39:65: It has already been revealed to you [Prophet] and to those before you: ‘If you ascribe any partner to God, all your work will come to nothing: you will be one if the losers.
te.39:66: No! Worship God alone and be one of those who are grateful to Him.’
te.39:67: These people have no grasp of God’s true measure. On the Day of Resurrection, the whole earth will be in His grip. The heavens will be rolled up in His right hand- Glory be to Him! He is far above the partners they ascribe to Him!-
te.39:68: the Trumpet will be sounded, and everyone in the heavens and earth will fall down senseless except those God spares. It will be sounded once again and they will be on their feet, looking on.
te.39:69: The earth will shine with the light of its Lord; the Record of Deeds will be laid open; the prophets and witnesses will be brought in. Fair judgement will be given between them: they will not be wronged
te.39:70: and every soul will be repaid in full for what it has done. He knows best what they do.
te.39:71: Those who rejected the Truth will be led to Hell in their throngs. When they arrive, its gates will open and its keepers will say to them, ‘Were you not sent your own messengers to recite the revelations of your Lord to you and warn you that you would meet this Day?’ and they will say, ‘Yes indeed we were.’ But the sentence of punishment will have been passed against those who rejected the truth.
te.39:72: It will be said, ‘Enter the gates of Hell: there you will remain. How evil is the abode of the arrogant!’
te.39:73: Those who were mindful of their Lord will be led in throngs to the Garden. When they arrive, they will find its gates wide open, and its keepers will say to them, ‘Peace be upon you. You have been good. Come in: you are here to stay,’
te.39:74: and they will say, ‘Praise be to God who has kept His promise to us and given us this land as our own. Now we may live wherever we please in the Garden.’ How excellent is the reward of those who labour!
te.39:75: You [Prophet] will see the angels surrounding the Throne, glorifying their Lord with praise. True judgement will have been passed between them, and it will be said, ‘Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.’
te.40:2: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Almighty, the All Knowing,
te.40:3: Forgiver of sins and Accepter of repentance, severe in punishment, infinite in bounty. There is no god but Him; to Him is the ultimate return.
te.40:4: It is only the disbelievers who dispute God’s revelations. [Prophet], do not be dazzled by their movements back and forth across the land.
te.40:5: Before them the people of Noah rejected the truth and so did those who formed opposition after them: every community schemed to destroy its messenger and strove to refute truth with falsehood; but it was I who destroyed them. How terrible My punishment was!
te.40:6: In this way your Lord’s sentence was passed against the disbelievers that they would be the inhabitants of the Fire.
te.40:7: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those who surround it celebrate the praise of their Lord and have faith in Him. They beg forgiveness for the believers: ‘Our Lord, You embrace all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who turn to You and follow Your path. Save them from the pains of Hell
te.40:8: and admit them, Lord, to the lasting Gardens You have promised to them, together with their righteous ancestors, spouses, and offspring: You alone are the Almighty, the All Wise.
te.40:9: Protect them from all evil deeds: those You protect on that Day from [the punishment for] evil deeds will receive Your mercy- that is the supreme triumph.’
te.40:10: But those who disbelieved will be told, ‘When you were called to the faith and rejected it, God’s disgust with you was even greater then than the self-disgust you feel [today].’
te.40:11: They will say, ‘Our Lord, twice You have caused us to be lifeless and twice You have brought us to life. Now we recognize our sins. Is there any way out?’
te.40:12: [They will be told], ‘This is all because when God alone was invoked you rejected this, yet when others were associated with Him you believed [in them].’ Judgement belongs to God the Most High, the Most Great.
te.40:13: It is He who shows you [people] His signs and sends water down from the sky to sustain you, though only those who turn to God will take heed.
te.40:14: So call upon God and dedicate your religion to Him alone, however hateful this may be to the disbelievers:
te.40:15: He is exalted in rank, the Lord of the Throne. He sends revelations with His teachings to whichever of His servants He will, in order to warn of the Day of Meeting,
te.40:16: the Day when they will come out and nothing about them will be concealed from God. ‘Who has control today?’ ‘God, the One, the All Powerful.
te.40:17: Today each soul will be rewarded for whatever it has done; today no injustice will be done. God is swift in reckoning.’
te.40:18: Warn them [Prophet] of the ever-approaching Day, when hearts are at throats, choking them. The evildoer will have no friends, nor any intercessor to be heeded.
te.40:19: God is aware of the most furtive of glances, and of all that hearts conceal:
te.40:20: God will judge with truth, while those they invoke besides Him will not judge at all. God is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
te.40:21: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how those who lived before them met their end? They were stronger than them and made a more impressive mark on the land, yet God destroyed them for their sins- they had no one to defend them against Him-
te.40:22: because messengers repeatedly came to them with clear signs and still they rejected them. God destroyed them: He is truly full of strength, severe in punishment.
te.40:23: We sent Moses with Our signs and clear authority
te.40:24: to Pharaoh, Haman, and Korah and they said, ‘Sorcerer! Liar!’
te.40:25: When he brought the truth to them from Us, they said, ‘Kill the sons of those who believe with him; spare only their women’- the scheming of those who reject the truth can only go wrong-
te.40:26: and Pharaoh said, ‘Leave me to kill Moses- let him call upon his Lord!- for I fear he may cause you to change your religion, or spread disorder in the land.’
te.40:27: Moses said, ‘I seek refuge with my Lord and yours from every tyrant who refuses to believe in the Day of Reckoning.’
te.40:28: A secret believer from Pharaoh’s family said, ‘How can you kill a man just for saying, “My Lord is God”? He has brought you clear signs from your Lord- if he is a liar, on his own head be it- and if he is truthful, then at least some of what he has threatened will happen to you. God does not guide any rebellious, outrageous liar.
te.40:29: My people, as masters in the land you have the power today, but who will help us against God’s might if it comes upon us?’ But Pharaoh said, ‘I have told you what I think; I am guiding you along the right path.’
te.40:30: The believer said, ‘My people, I fear your fate will be the fate of those others who opposed [their prophets]:
te.40:31: the fate of the people of Noah, Ad, Thamud, and those who came after them- God never wills injustice on His creatures.
te.40:32: My people, I fear for you on the Day you will cry out to one another,
te.40:33: the Day you will turn tail and flee with no one to defend you from God! Whoever God leaves to stray will have no one to guide him.
te.40:34: Joseph came to you before with clear signs, but you never ceased to doubt the message he brought you. When he died, you said, “God will not send another messenger.”’ In this way God leaves the doubting rebels to stray-
te.40:35: those who dispute God’s messages, with no authority given to them, are doing something that is loathed by God and by those who believe. In this way God seals up the heart of every arrogant tyrant.
te.40:36: Pharaoh said, ‘Haman, build me a tall tower so that I may reach the ropes that lead
te.40:37: to the heavens to look for this God of Moses. I am convinced that he is lying.’ In this way the evil of Pharaoh’s deed was made alluring to him and he was barred from the right path- his scheming led only to ruin.
te.40:38: The believer said, ‘My people, follow me! I will guide you to the right path.
te.40:39: My people, the life of this world is only a brief enjoyment; it is the Hereafter that is the lasting home.
te.40:40: Whoever does evil will be repaid with its like; whoever does good and believes, be it a man or a woman, will enter Paradise and be provided for without measure.
te.40:41: My people, why do I call you to salvation when you call me to the Fire?
te.40:42: You call me to disbelieve in God and to associate with Him things of which I have no knowledge; I call you to the Mighty, the Forgiving One.
te.40:43: There is no doubt that what you call me to serve is not fit to be invoked either in this world or the Hereafter: our return is to God alone, and it will be the rebels who will inhabit the Fire.
te.40:44: [One Day] you will remember what I am saying to you now, so I commit my case to God: God is well aware of His servants.’
te.40:45: So God saved him from the harm they planned. A terrible punishment engulfed Pharaoh’s people;
te.40:46: they will be brought before the Fire morning and evening. On the Day the Hour comes, it will be said, ‘Throw Pharaoh’s people into the worst torment.’
te.40:47: In the Fire they will quarrel with one another: the weak will say to the haughty, ‘We were your followers, so can you now relieve us from some share of the Fire?’
te.40:48: but they will say, ‘We are all in this together. God has judged between His creatures.’
te.40:49: Those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, ‘Ask your Lord to lessen our suffering for one day,’
te.40:50: but they will say, ‘Did your messengers not come to you with clear evidence of the truth?’ They will say, ‘Yes they did,’ and the keeper will say, ‘You can plead, then, but the pleas of disbelievers will always be in vain.’
te.40:51: We support Our messengers and the believers, in the present life and on the Day when witnesses arise.
te.40:52: On the Day when excuses will not profit the evildoers, their fate will be rejection and they will have the worst of homes.
te.40:53: We gave Moses guidance and passed down the Scripture to the Children of Israel,
te.40:54: as a guide and a reminder to people of understanding.
te.40:55: So be patient, Prophet, for what God has promised is sure to come. Ask forgiveness for your sins; praise your Lord morning and evening.
te.40:56: As for those who, with no authority to do so, dispute God’s messages, there is nothing in their hearts but a thirst for a greatness they will never attain. Seek refuge in God, for He is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
te.40:57: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater by far than the creation of mankind, though most people do not know it.
te.40:58: The blind and the sighted are not equal, just as those who believe and do good works and those who do evil are not equal: how seldom you reflect!
te.40:59: The Final Hour is sure to come, without doubt, but most people do not believe.
te.40:60: Your Lord says, ‘Call on Me and I will answer you; those who are too proud to serve Me will enter Hell humiliated.’
te.40:61: It is God who has given you the night in which to rest and the day in which to see. God is truly bountiful to people, but most people do not give thanks.
te.40:62: Such is God your Lord, the Creator of all things: there is no god but Him. How can you be so deluded?
te.40:63: This is how deluded those who deny God’s messages are.
te.40:64: It is God who has given you the earth for a dwelling place and the heavens for a canopy. He shaped you, formed you well, and provided you with good things. Such is God your Lord, so glory be to Him, the Lord of the Worlds.
te.40:65: He is the Living One and there is no god but Him, so call on Him, and dedicate your religion entirely to Him. Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.
te.40:66: Say [Prophet], ‘Since clear evidence has come to me from my Lord I am forbidden to serve those you call upon besides God: I am commanded to submit to the Lord of the Worlds.’
te.40:67: It is He who created you from dust, then from a drop of fluid, then from a tiny, clinging form, then He brought you forth as infants, then He allowed you to reach maturity, then He let you grow old- though some of you die sooner- and reach your appointed term so that you may reflect.
te.40:68: It is He who gives life and death, and when He ordains a thing, He says only ‘Be’ and it is.
te.40:69: [Prophet], do you see how deluded those who dispute God’s messages are-
te.40:70: those who reject the Scripture and the messages We have sent through Our messengers? They will find out
te.40:71: when, with iron collars and chains around their necks, they are dragged
te.40:72: into scalding water, and then burned in the Fire,
te.40:73: and asked, ‘Where now are those you called upon
te.40:74: besides God?’ They will say, ‘They have abandoned us: those we called upon before were really nothing at all.’ ‘This is how God lets disbelievers go astray,
te.40:75: all because on earth you revelled in untruth and ran wild.
te.40:76: Enter the gates of Hell, there to remain- an evil home for the arrogant.’
te.40:77: So be patient [Prophet], for God’s promise is sure: whether We show you part of what We have promised them in this life or whether We take your soul back to Us first, it is to Us that they will be returned.
te.40:78: We have sent other messengers before you- some We have mentioned to you and some We have not- and no messenger could bring about a sign except with God’s permission. When [the Day] God ordained comes, just judgement will be passed between them: there and then, those who followed falsehood will be lost.
te.40:79: It is God who provides livestock for you, some for riding and some for your food;
te.40:80: you have other benefits in them too. You can reach any destination you wish on them: they carry you, as ships carry you [on the sea].
te.40:81: He shows you His signs: which of God’s signs do you still ignore?
te.40:82: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how those who lived before them met their end? They were more numerous than them, stronger than them, and made a more impressive mark on the land, yet what they achieved was of no use to them at all.
te.40:83: When messengers came to them with clear signs, they revelled in the knowledge they had, and so they were engulfed by the very punishment they mocked:
te.40:84: when they saw Our punishment, they said, ‘We believe in God alone; we reject any partner we ascribed to Him,’
te.40:85: but believing after seeing Our punishment did not benefit them at all- this has always been God’s way of dealing with His creatures- there and then the disbelievers were lost.
te.41:2: A revelation from the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy;
te.41:3: a Scripture whose verses are made distinct as a Quran in Arabic for people who understand,
te.41:4: giving good news and warning. Yet most of them turn away and so do not hear.
te.41:5: They say, ‘Our hearts are encased against [the faith] you call us to; our ears are heavy; there is a barrier between us and you. So you do whatever you want, and so shall we.’
te.41:6: Say [Prophet], ‘I am only a mortal like you, [but] it has been revealed to me that your God is One. Take the straight path to Him and seek His forgiveness. Woe to the idolaters,
te.41:7: who do not pay the prescribed alms and refuse to believe in the world to come!
te.41:8: Those who believe and do good deeds will have a reward that never fails.’
te.41:9: Say, ‘How can you disregard the One who created the earth in two Days? How can you set up other gods as His equals? He is the Lord of all the worlds!’
te.41:10: He placed solid mountains on it, blessed it, measured out its varied provisions for all who seek them––all in four Days.
te.41:11: Then He turned to the sky, which was smoke––He said to it and the earth, ‘Come into being, willingly or not,’ and they said, ‘We come willingly’––
te.41:12: and in two Days He formed seven heavens, and assigned an order to each. We have made the nearest one beautifully illuminated and secure. Such is the design of the Almighty, the All Knowing.
te.41:13: If they turn away, say, ‘I have warned you about a blast like the one which struck 'Ad and Thamud:
te.41:14: when their messengers came to them, from all angles, saying, “Serve no one but God,” they said, “If our Lord had wished, He would have sent down angels. We do not believe in the message with which you have been sent.”
te.41:15: The people of 'Ad behaved arrogantly throughout the land without any right, saying, “Who could be stronger than us?” Did they not realize that God, who created them, was stronger than them?’ They continued to reject Our message,
te.41:16: so We let a roaring wind loose on them for a few disastrous days to make them taste the punishment of shame in this world; more shameful still will be the punishment of the life to come, and they will not be helped.
te.41:17: As for Thamud, We gave them guidance but they preferred blindness, so they were struck by a blast of humiliating punishment for their misdeeds.
te.41:18: We saved those who believed and were mindful of God.
te.41:19: On the Day when God’s enemies are gathered up for the Fire and driven onward,
te.41:20: their ears, eyes, and skins will, when they reach it, testify against them for their misdeeds.
te.41:21: They will say to their skins, ‘Why did you testify against us?’ and their skins will reply, ‘God, who gave speech to everything, has given us speech- it was He who created you the first time and to Him you have been returned-
te.41:22: yet you did not try to hide yourselves from your ears, eyes, and skin to prevent them from testifying against you. You thought that God did not know about much of what you were doing,
te.41:23: so it was the thoughts you entertained about your Lord that led to your ruin, and you became losers.’
te.41:24: The Fire will still be their home, even if they resign themselves to patience, and if they pray to be allowed to make amends, they will not be given permission to do so.
te.41:25: We have appointed, for the disbelievers, companions who make their past and present seem fair and right to them, but the sentence has already been passed on them, along with generations of jinn and men before them: they were losers.
te.41:26: The disbelievers say, ‘Do not listen to this Quran; drown it in frivolous talk: you may gain the upper hand.’
te.41:27: We shall certainly give the disbelievers a taste of severe punishment. We shall repay them according to their worst deeds-
te.41:28: that is the reward of the enemies of God- the Fire will be their lasting home, a payment for their rejection of Our revelations.
te.41:29: The disbelievers will say, ‘Our Lord, show us those jinn and men who misled us and we shall trample them underfoot, so that they may be among the lowest of the low.’
te.41:30: As for those who say, ‘Our Lord is God,’ and take the straight path towards Him, the angels come down to them and say, ‘Have no fear or grief, but rejoice in the good news of Paradise, which you have been promised.
te.41:31: We are your allies in this world and in the world to come, where you will have everything you desire and ask for
te.41:32: as a welcoming gift from the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful One.’
te.41:33: Who speaks better than someone who calls people to God, does what is right, and says, ‘I am one of those devoted to God’?
te.41:34: Good and evil cannot be equal. [Prophet], repel evil with what is better and your enemy will become as close as an old and valued friend,
te.41:35: but only those who are steadfast in patience, only those who are blessed with great righteousness, will attain to such goodness.
te.41:36: If a prompting from Satan should stir you, seek refuge with God: He is the All Hearing and the All Knowing.
te.41:37: The night, the day, the sun, the moon, are only a few of His signs. Do not bow down in worship to the sun or the moon, but bow down to God who created them, if it is truly Him that you worship.
te.41:38: If the disbelievers are too arrogant, [remember, Prophet, that] those who are with your Lord glorify Him tirelessly night and day.
te.41:39: Another of His signs is this: you see the earth lying desolate, but when We send water down on to it, it stirs and grows. He who gives it life will certainly give life to the dead. He has power over everything.
te.41:40: Those who distort the meaning of Our message are not hidden from Us. Is he who is hurled into the Fire better, or he who comes through safely on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you want, God certainly sees everything you do.
te.41:41: Those who reject the Quran when it comes to them- though it is an unassailable Scripture
te.41:42: which falsehood cannot touch from any angle, a Revelation sent down from the Wise One, Worthy of All Praise-
te.41:43: [should remember that] you [Prophet] are not told anything that the previous messengers were not told: your Lord is a Lord of forgiveness, but also of painful punishment.
te.41:44: If We had made it a foreign Quran, they would have said, ‘If only its verses were clear! What? Foreign speech to an Arab?’ Say, ‘It is guidance and healing for those who have faith, but the ears of the disbelievers are heavy, they are blind to it, it is as if they are being called from a distant place.’
te.41:45: We gave the Scripture to Moses but disputes arose about it- if it were not for a decree that had already been issued from your Lord, they would already have been judged- and still they are doubtful and suspicious of it.
te.41:46: Whoever does good does it for his own soul and whoever does evil does it against his own soul: your Lord is never unjust to His creatures.
te.41:47: Knowledge of the Hour belongs solely to Him and no crop comes out of its sheath, nor does any female conceive or give birth, without His knowledge. On the Day He asks them, ‘Where are My partners?’ they will answer, ‘We admit to You that none of us can see [them]’:
te.41:48: the gods they invoked before will have vanished away; they will know that there is no escape.
te.41:49: Man never tires of asking for good, but if evil touches him he loses all hope and becomes despondent.
te.41:50: Whenever We let him taste some of Our mercy after he has been afflicted, he is sure to say, ‘This is all my own doing: I do not think the Hour will ever come, but even if I were to be taken back to my Lord, the best reward would await me with Him.’ We shall most certainly inform the disbelievers of what they have done and give them a taste of severe torment.
te.41:51: Whenever We are gracious to man, he goes away haughtily, but, as soon as evil touches him, he turns to prolonged prayer.
te.41:52: Say [Prophet], ‘Have you ever thought, what if this revelation really is from God and you still reject it? Who could be more astray than someone who cuts himself off so far [from God]?’
te.41:53: We shall show them Our signs in every region of the earth and in themselves, until it becomes clear to them that this is the Truth. Is it not enough that your Lord witnesses everything?
te.41:54: Truly, they doubt that they will meet their Lord; truly He encompasses everything.
te.42:3: This is how God, the Mighty, the Wise, sends revelation to you [Prophet] as He did to those before you.
te.42:4: All that is in the heavens and earth belongs to Him: He is the Exalted, the Almighty.
te.42:5: The heavens are almost broken apart from above as the angels proclaim the praises of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. God is indeed the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
te.42:6: As for those who take protectors other than Him, God is watching them; you are not responsible for them.
te.42:7: So We have revealed an Arabic Quran to you, in order that you may warn the capital city and all who live nearby. And warn [especially] about the Day of Gathering, of which there is no doubt, when some shall be in the Garden and some in the blazing Flame.
te.42:8: If God had so pleased, He could have made them a single community, but He admits to His mercy whoever He will; the evildoers will have no one to protect or help them.
te.42:9: How can they take protectors other than Him? God alone is the Protector; He gives life to the dead; He has power over all things.
te.42:10: Whatever you may differ about is for God to judge. [Say], ‘Such is God, my Lord. In Him I trust and to Him I turn,
te.42:11: the Creator of the heavens and earth.’ He made mates for you from among yourselves––and for the animals too––so that you may multiply. There is nothing like Him: He is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
