te.42:12: The keys of the heavens and the earth are His; He provides abundantly or sparingly for whoever He will; He has full knowledge of all things.
te.42:13: In matters of faith, He has laid down for you [people] the same commandment that He gave Noah, which We have revealed to you [Muhammad] and which We enjoined on Abraham and Moses and Jesus: ‘Uphold the faith and do not divide into factions within it’- what you [Prophet] call upon the idolaters to do is hard for them; God chooses whoever He pleases for Himself and guides towards Himself those who turn to Him.
te.42:14: They divided, out of rivalry, only after knowledge had come to them, and, if it had not been for a decree already passed by your Lord to reprieve them until an appointed time, they would already have been judged. Those after them, who inherited the Scripture, are in disquieting doubt about it.
te.42:15: So [Prophet] call people to that faith and follow the straight path as you have been commanded. Do not go by what they desire, but say, ‘I believe in whatever Scripture God has sent down. I am commanded to bring justice between you. God is our Lord and your Lord- to us our deeds and to you yours, so let there be no argument between us and you- God will gather us together, and to Him we shall return.’
te.42:16: As for those who argue about God after He has been acknowledged, their argument has no weight with their Lord: anger will fall upon them and agonizing torment awaits them.
te.42:17: It is God who has sent down the Scripture with Truth and the Balance. How can you tell? The Last Hour may well be near:
te.42:18: those who do not believe in it seek to hasten it, but the believers stand in awe of it. They know it to be the Truth; those who argue about the Hour are far, far astray.
te.42:19: God is most subtle towards His creatures; He provides [bounti-fully] for whoever He will; He is the Powerful, the Almighty.
te.42:20: If anyone desires a harvest in the life to come, We shall increase it for him; if anyone desires a harvest in this world, We shall give him a share of it, but in the Hereafter he will have no share.
te.42:21: How can they believe in others who ordain for them things which God has not sanctioned in the practice of their faith? If it were not for God’s decree concerning the final Decision, judgement would already have been made between them. The evildoers will have a grievous punishment-
te.42:22: you will see them fearful because of what they have done: punishment is bound to fall on them- but those who believe and do good deeds will be in the flowering meadows of the Gardens. They will have whatever they wish from their Lord: this is the great bounty;
te.42:23: it is of this that God gives good news to His servants who believe and do good deeds. Say [Prophet], ‘I ask no reward from you for this, only the affection due to kin.’ If anyone does good, We shall increase it for him; God is most forgiving and most appreciative.
te.42:24: How can they say, ‘He has invented a lie about God’? If God so willed, He could seal your heart and blot out lies: God confirms the Truth with His words. He has full knowledge of what is in the heart-
te.42:25: it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons bad deeds- He knows everything you do.
te.42:26: He responds to those who believe and do good deeds, and gives them more of His bounty; agonizing torment awaits the disbelievers.
te.42:27: If God were to grant His plentiful provision to [all] His creatures, they would act insolently on earth, but He sends down in due measure whatever He will, for He is well aware of His servants and watchful over them:
te.42:28: it is He who sends relief through rain after they have lost hope, and spreads His mercy far and wide. He is the Protector, Worthy of All Praise.
te.42:29: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and all the living creatures He has scattered throughout them: He has the power to gather them all together whenever He will.
te.42:30: Whatever misfortune befalls you [people], it is because of what your own hands have done- God forgives much-
te.42:31: you cannot escape Him anywhere on earth: you have no protector or helper other than God.
te.42:32: Among His signs are the ships, sailing like floating mountains:
te.42:33: if He willed, He could bring the wind to a standstill and they would lie motionless on the surface of the sea- there truly are signs in this for anyone who is steadfast and thankful-
te.42:34: or He could cause them to be wrecked on account of what their passengers have done- God pardons much-
te.42:35: to let those who argue about Our messages know that there is no escape for them.
te.42:36: What you have been given is only the fleeting enjoyment of this world. Far better and more lasting is what God will give to those who believe and trust in their Lord;
te.42:37: who shun great sins and gross indecencies; who forgive when they are angry;
te.42:38: respond to their Lord; keep up the prayer; conduct their affairs by mutual consultation; give to others out of what We have provided for them;
te.42:39: and defend themselves when they are oppressed.
te.42:40: Let harm be requited by an equal harm, though anyone who forgives and puts things right will have his reward from God Himself––He does not like those who do wrong.
te.42:41: There is no cause to act against anyone who defends himself after being wronged,
te.42:42: but there is cause to act against those who oppress people and transgress in the land against all justice- they will have an agonizing torment-
te.42:43: though if a person is patient and forgives, this is one of the greatest things.
te.42:44: Anyone God allows to stray will have no one else to protect him: you [Prophet] will see the wrongdoers, when they face the punishment, exclaiming, ‘Is there any way of going back?’
te.42:45: You will see them exposed to the Fire, abject in humiliation, glancing furtively, while those who believed exclaim, ‘The losers are the ones who have lost themselves and their people on the Day of Resurrection.’ Truly the evildoers will remain in lasting torment;
te.42:46: they will have no allies to help them against God. There is no way [forward] for those God allows to stray.
te.42:47: So [people] respond to your Lord before there comes a Day that cannot, against God’s will, be averted- you will have no refuge on that Day, and no possibility of denying [your sins].
te.42:48: If they still turn away [remember that], We have not sent you [Prophet] to be their guardian: your only duty is to deliver the message. When We give man a taste of Our mercy, he rejoices in it, but if some harm befalls him on account of what he has done with his own hands, then he is ungrateful.
te.42:49: God has control of the heavens and the earth; He creates whatever He will- He grants female offspring to whoever He will, male to whoever He will,
te.42:50: Or both male and female, and He makes whoever He will barren: He is all knowing and all powerful.
te.42:51: It is not granted to any mortal that God should speak to him except through revelation or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger to reveal by His command what He will: He is exalted and wise.
te.42:52: So We have revealed a spirit to you [Prophet] by Our command: you knew neither the Scripture nor the faith, but We made it a light, guiding with it whoever We will of Our servants. You give guidance to the straight path,
te.42:53: the path of God, to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and earth: truly everything will return to God.
te.43:2: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
te.43:3: We have made it a Quran in Arabic so that you [people] may understand.
te.43:4: It is truly exalted in the Source of Scripture kept with Us, and full of wisdom.
te.43:5: Should We ignore you and turn this revelation away from you because you are insolent people?
te.43:6: We have sent many a prophet to earlier people
te.43:7: and they mocked every one of them,
te.43:8: so We have destroyed mightier people than [the disbelievers of Mecca] and their example has gone down in history.
te.43:9: If you [Prophet] ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and earth?’ they are sure to say, ‘They were created by the Almighty, the All Knowing.’
te.43:10: It is He who smoothed out the earth for you and traced out routes on it for you to find your way,
te.43:11: who sends water down from the sky in due measure––We resurrect dead land with it, and likewise you will be resurrected from the grave––
te.43:12: who created every kind of thing, who gave you ships and animals to ride on
te.43:13: so that you may remember your Lord’s grace when you are seated on them and say, ‘Glory be to Him who has given us control over this; we could not have done it by ourselves.
te.43:14: Truly it is to our Lord that we are returning.’
te.43:15: Yet they assign some of His own servants to Him as offspring!Man is clearly ungrateful!
te.43:16: Has He taken daughters for Himself and favoured you with sons?
te.43:17: When one of them is given news of the birth of a daughter, such as he so readily ascribes to the Lord of Mercy, his face grows dark and he is filled with gloom-
te.43:18: ‘Someone who is brought up amongst trinkets, who cannot put together a clear argument?’
te.43:19: They consider the angels- God’s servants- to be female. Did they witness their creation? Their claim will be put on record and they will be questioned about it.
te.43:20: They say, ‘If the Lord of Mercy had willed it, we would not have worshipped them,’ but they do not know that- they are only guessing-
te.43:21: or have We perhaps given them a book before this one, to which they hold fast?
te.43:22: No indeed! They say, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are guided by their footsteps.’
te.43:23: When-ever We sent a messenger before you to warn a township, those corrupted by wealth said, in the same way, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are only following in their footsteps.’
te.43:24: The messenger said, ‘Even though I bring you a truer religion than what you saw your fathers following?’ and they replied, ‘But we do not believe the message you bring.’
te.43:25: We punished them: think about how those who rejected the Truth met their end.
te.43:26: Abraham said to his father and his people, ‘I renounce what you worship.
te.43:27: I worship only Him who created me, and it is He who will guide me,’
te.43:28: and he bequeathed these words to his descendants so that they might return [to God].
te.43:29: I have let these people and their fathers enjoy long lives, and now I have given them the Truth and a messenger to make things clear-
te.43:30: yet when the Truth came to them, they said, ‘This is sorcery. We do not believe in it,’
te.43:31: and they said, ‘Why was this Quran not sent down to a distinguished man, from either of the two cities?’
te.43:32: Are they the ones who share out your Lord’s grace? We are the ones who give them their share of livelihood in this world and We have raised some of them above others in rank, so that some may take others into service: your Lord’s grace is better than anything they accumulate.
te.43:33: If it were not that all mankind might have become a single nation [of disbelievers], We could have given all those who disbelieve in the Lord of Mercy houses with roofs of silver, sweeping staircases to ascend,
te.43:34: massive gates, couches to sit on,
te.43:35: and golden ornaments. All of these are mere enjoyments of this life; your Lord reserves the next life for those who take heed of Him.
te.43:36: We assign an evil one as a comrade for whoever turns away from the revelations of the Lord of Mercy:
te.43:37: evil ones bar people from the right path, even though they may think they are well guided.
te.43:38: When such a person comes to Us, he will say [to his comrade], ‘If only you had been as far away from me as east is from west. What an evil comrade!’
te.43:39: [It will be said to them], ‘You have done wrong. Having partners in punishment will not console you today.’
te.43:40: Can you [Prophet] make the deaf hear? Or guide either the blind or those who are in gross error?
te.43:41: Either We shall take you away and punish them- indeed We will-
te.43:42: or We shall let you witness the punishment We threatened them with; We have full power over them.
te.43:43: Hold fast to what has been revealed to you- you truly are on the right path-
te.43:44: for it is a reminder for you and your people: you will all be questioned.
te.43:45: Ask the prophets We sent before you: ‘Did We ever appoint any gods to be worshipped besides the Lord of Mercy?’
te.43:46: We sent Moses to Pharaoh and his courtiers and he said, ‘I am truly a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds,’
te.43:47: but when he presented Our signs to them, they laughed,
te.43:48: even though each sign We showed them was greater than the previous one. We inflicted torment on them so that they might return to the right path.
te.43:49: They said, ‘Sorcerer, call on your Lord for us, by virtue of His pledge to you: we shall certainly accept guidance,’
te.43:50: but as soon as We relieved their torment they broke their word.
te.43:51: Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, ‘My people, is the Kingdom of Egypt not mine? And these rivers that flow at my feet, are they not mine? Do you not see?
te.43:52: Am I not better than this contemptible wretch who can scarcely express himself?
te.43:53: Why has he not been given any gold bracelets? Why have no angels come to accompany him?’
te.43:54: In this way he moved his people to accept and they obeyed him- they were perverse people.
te.43:55: When they provoked Us, We punished and drowned them all:
te.43:56: We made them a lesson and an example for later people.
te.43:57: When the son of Mary is cited as an example, your people [Prophet] laugh and jeer,
te.43:58: saying, ‘Are our gods better or him?’- they cite him only to challenge you: they are a contentious people-
te.43:59: but he is only a servant We favoured and made an example for the Children of Israel:
te.43:60: if it had been Our will, We could have made you angels, succeeding one another on earth.
te.43:61: This [Quran] gives knowledge of the Hour: do not doubt it. Follow Me for this is the right path;
te.43:62: do not let Satan hinder you, for he is your sworn enemy.
te.43:63: When Jesus came with clear signs he said, ‘I have brought you wisdom; I have come to clear up some of your differences for you. Be mindful of God and obey me:
te.43:64: God is my Lord and your Lord. Serve Him: this is the straight path.’
te.43:65: Yet still the different factions among them disagreed- woe to the evildoers: they will suffer the torment of a grievous day!-
te.43:66: what are they waiting for but the Hour, which will come upon them suddenly and take them unawares?
te.43:67: On that Day, friends will become each other’s enemies. Not so the righteous-
te.43:68: ‘My servants, there is no fear for you today, nor shall you grieve’––
te.43:69: those who believed in Our revelations and devoted themselves to Us.
te.43:70: ‘Enter Paradise, you and your spouses: you will be filled with joy.’
te.43:71: Dishes and goblets of gold will be passed around them with all that their souls desire and their eyes delight in. ‘There you will remain:
te.43:72: this is the Garden you are given as your own, because of what you used to do,
te.43:73: and there is abundant fruit in it for you to eat.’
te.43:74: But the evildoers will remain in Hell’s punishment,
te.43:75: from which there is no relief: they will remain in utter despair.
te.43:76: We never wronged them; they were the ones who did wrong.
te.43:77: They will cry, ‘Malik, if only your Lord would finish us off,’ but he will answer, ‘No! You are here to stay.’
te.43:78: We have brought you the Truth but most of you despise it.
te.43:79: Have these disbelievers thought up some scheme? We too have been scheming.
te.43:80: Do they think We cannot hear their secret talk and their private counsel? Yes we can: Our messengers are at their sides, recording everything.
te.43:81: Say [Prophet], ‘If the Lord of Mercy [truly] had offspring I would be the first to worship [them], but-
te.43:82: exalted be the Lord of the heavens and earth, the Lord of the Throne- He is far above their false descriptions.’
te.43:83: Leave them to wade in deeper and play about, until they face the Day they have been promised.
te.43:84: It is He who is God in heaven and God on earth; He is the All Wise, the All Knowing;
te.43:85: Exalted is He who has control of the heavens and earth and everything between them; He has knowledge of the Hour; you will all be returned to Him.
te.43:86: Those gods they invoke besides Him have no power of intercession, unlike those who bore witness to the truth and recognized it.
te.43:87: If you [Prophet] ask them who created them they are sure to say, ‘God,’ so why are they so deluded?
te.43:88: The Prophet has said, ‘My Lord, truly these are people who do not believe,’
te.43:89: but turn away from them and say, ‘Peace’: they will come to know.
te.44:2: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
te.44:3: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––
te.44:4: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct
te.44:5: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––
te.44:6: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,
te.44:7: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––
te.44:8: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––
te.44:9: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.
te.44:10: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.
te.44:11: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!
te.44:12: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’
te.44:13: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,
te.44:14: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’
te.44:15: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––
te.44:16: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.
te.44:17: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,
te.44:18: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.
te.44:19: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.
te.44:20: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!
te.44:21: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’
te.44:22: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’
te.44:23: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.
te.44:24: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’
te.44:25: Many a garden and spring they left behind,
te.44:26: many a cornfield and noble building,
te.44:27: many a thing in which they had delighted:
te.44:28: We gave these to another people to inherit.
te.44:29: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.
te.44:30: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering
te.44:31: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.
te.44:32: We chose them knowingly above others:
te.44:33: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.
te.44:35: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.
te.44:36: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’
te.44:37: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.
te.44:38: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;
te.44:39: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.
te.44:40: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;
te.44:41: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.
te.44:42: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.
te.44:44: will be food for the sinners:
te.44:45: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies
te.44:47: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!
te.44:48: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’
te.44:51: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place
te.44:53: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:
te.44:54: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.
te.44:55: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.
te.44:56: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,
te.44:57: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
te.44:58: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.
te.44:59: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.
te.45:2: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Mighty, the Wise.
te.45:3: There are signs in the heavens and the earth for those who believe:
te.45:4: in the creation of you, in the creatures God scattered on earth, there are signs for people of sure faith;
te.45:5: in the alternation of night and day, in the rain God provides, sending it down from the sky and reviving the dead earth with it, and in His shifting of the winds there are signs for those who use their reason.
te.45:6: These are God’s signs that We recount to you [Prophet, to show] the Truth. If they deny God and His revelations, what message will they believe in?
te.45:7: Woe to every lying sinful person
te.45:8: who hears God’s revelations being recited to him, yet persists in his arrogance as if he had never heard them––[Prophet] bring him news of a painful torment!––
te.45:9: who, if he knows anything about Our revelations, ridicules it! Such people will have a humiliating torment:
te.45:10: Hell lurks behind them and their gains will not benefit them, nor will those beings they took as protectors beside God––a tremendous torment awaits them.
te.45:11: This is true guidance; those who reject their Lord’s revelations will have a woeful torment.
te.45:12: It is God who subjected the sea for you––ships sail on it by His command so that you can seek His bounty and give Him thanks––
te.45:13: He has subjected all that is in the heavens and the earth for your benefit, as a gift from Him. There truly are signs in this for those who reflect.
te.45:14: Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear God’s days [of punishment]––He will requite people for what they have done.
te.45:15: Whoever does good benefits himself, and whoever does evil harms himself: you will all be returned to your Lord.
te.45:16: We gave scripture, wisdom, and prophethood to the Children of Israel; We provided them with good things and favoured them above others;
te.45:17: We gave them clear proof in matters [of religion]. They differed among themselves out of mutual rivalry, only after knowledge came to them: on the Day of Resurrection your Lord will judge between them regarding their differences.
te.45:18: Now We have set you [Muhammad] on a clear religious path, so follow it. Do not follow the desires of those who lack [true] knowledge-
te.45:19: they cannot help you against God in any way. Wrongdoers only have each other to protect them; the righteous have God Himself as their protector.
te.45:20: This [revelation] is a means of insight for people, a source of guidance and mercy for those of sure faith.
te.45:21: Do those who commit evil deeds really think that We will deal with them in the same way as those who believe and do righteous deeds, that they will be alike in their living and their dying? How badly they judge!
te.45:22: God created the heavens and earth for a true purpose: to reward each soul according to its deeds. They will not be wronged.
te.45:23: [Prophet], consider the one who has taken his own desire as a god, whom God allows to stray in the face of knowledge, sealing his ears and heart and covering his eyes- who can guide such a person after God [has done this]? Will you [people] not take heed?
te.45:24: They say, ‘There is only our life in this world: we die, we live, nothing but time destroys us.’ They have no knowledge of this; they only follow guesswork. Their only argument,
te.45:25: when Our clear revelations are recited to them, is to say, ‘Bring back our forefathers if what you say is true.’
te.45:26: [Prophet], say, ‘It is God who gives you life, then causes you to die, and then He gathers you all to the Day of Resurrection of which there is no doubt, though most people do not comprehend.’
te.45:27: Control of everything in the heavens and the earth belongs to God. When the Hour comes, those who follow falsehood will be the losers on that Day.
te.45:28: You will see every community kneeling. Every community will be summoned to its record: ‘Today you will be repaid for what you did.
te.45:29: Here is Our record that tells the truth about you: We have been recording everything you do.’
te.45:30: Those who believed and did good deeds will be admitted by their Lord into His mercy- that is the clearest triumph-
te.45:31: but those who disbelieved [will be asked]: ‘When My revelations were recited to you, were you not arrogant and persistent in wicked deeds?
te.45:32: When it was said to you, “God’s promise is true: there is no doubt about the Hour,” did you not reply, “We know nothing of the Hour. This is only conjecture in our opinion. We are not convinced”?’
te.45:33: The evil of their actions will [then] become clear to them. The punishment they mocked will engulf them.
te.45:34: It will be said, ‘Today We shall ignore you just as you ignored your appointment with this Day. The Fire will be your home and no one will help you,
te.45:35: because you received God’s revelations with ridicule and were deceived by worldly life.’ They will not be brought out of the Fire on that Day, nor will they be given the chance to make amends.
te.45:36: So praise be to God, Lord of the heavens and earth, Lord of the worlds.
te.45:37: True greatness in the heavens and the earth is rightfully His: He is the Mighty, the Wise.
te.46:2: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Almighty, the Wise.
te.46:3: It was for a true purpose and a specific term that We created heaven and earth and everything in between, yet those who deny the truth ignore the warning they have been given.
te.46:4: Say [Prophet], ‘Consider those you pray to other than God: show me which part of the earth they created or which share of the heavens they own; bring me a previous scripture or some vestige of divine knowledge––if what you say is true.’
te.46:5: Who could be more wrong than a person who calls on those other than God, those who will not answer him till the Day of Resurrection, those who are unaware of his prayers,
te.46:6: those who, when all mankind is gathered, will become his enemies and disown his worship?
te.46:7: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say of the Truth that has reached them, ‘This is clearly sorcery,’
te.46:8: or they say, ‘He has invented it himself.’ Say [Prophet], ‘If I have really invented it, there is nothing you can do to save me from God. He knows best what you say amongst yourselves about it; He is sufficient as a witness between me and you; He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.’
te.46:9: Say, ‘I am nothing new among God’s messengers. I do not know what will be done with me or you; I only follow what is revealed to me; I only warn plainly.’
te.46:10: Say, ‘Have you thought: what if this Quran really is from God and you reject it? What if one of the Children of Israel testifies to its similarity [to earlier scripture] and believes in it, and yet you are too proud to [do the same]? God certainly does not guide evildoers.’
te.46:11: Those who disbelieve say of the believers, ‘If there were any good in this Quran, they would not have believed in it before we did,’and, since they refuse to be guided by it, they say, ‘This is an ancient fabrication.’
te.46:12: Yet the scripture of Moses was revealed before it as a guide and a mercy, and this is a scripture confirming it in the Arabic language to warn those who do evil and bring good news for those who do good.
te.46:13: For those who say, ‘Our lord is God,’ and then follow the straight path there is no fear, nor shall they grieve:
te.46:14: they are the people of Paradise, there to remain as a reward for what they were doing.
te.46:15: We have commanded man to be good to his parents: his mother struggled to carry him and struggled to give birth to him- his bearing and weaning took a full thirty months. When he has grown to manhood and reached the age of forty he [may] say, ‘Lord, help me to be truly grateful for Your favours to me and to my parents; help me to do good work that pleases You; make my offspring good. I turn to You; I am one of those who devote themselves to You.’
te.46:16: We accept from such people the best of what they do and We overlook their bad deeds. They will be among the people of Paradise- the true promise that has been given to them.
te.46:17: But some say to their parents, ‘What? Are you really warning me that I shall be raised alive from my grave, when so many generations have already passed and gone before me?’ His parents implore God for help; they say, ‘Alas for you! Believe! God’s promise is true,’ but still he replies, ‘These are nothing but ancient fables.’
te.46:18: The verdict has been passed on such people, along with all the communities that went before them, jinn and human: they are lost.
te.46:19: Everyone will be ranked according to their deeds and God will repay them in full for what they have done: they will not be wronged.
te.46:20: On the Day when those who deny the truth are brought before the Fire, it will be said to them, ‘You squandered the good things you were given in your earthly life, you took your fill of pleasure there, so on this Day a punishment of shame is yours: you were arrogant on earth without any right, and exceeded all limits.’
te.46:21: Mention [Hud] of the tribe of Ad: he warned his people among the sand dunes- other warners have come and gone both before and after him- ‘ Worship no one but God: I fear for you, that you will be punished on a terrible Day,’
te.46:22: but they said, ‘Have you come to turn us away from our gods? If what you say is true, bring down that punishment you threaten us with!’
te.46:23: He said, ‘Only God knows when it will come: I simply convey to you the message I am sent with but I can see you are an insolent people.’
te.46:24: When they saw a cloud approaching their valley, they said, ‘This cloud will give us rain!’ ‘No indeed! It is what you wanted to hasten: a storm-wind bearing a painful punishment
te.46:25: which will destroy everything by its Lord’s command.’ In the morning there was nothing to see except their [ruined] dwellings: this is how We repay the guilty.
te.46:26: We had established them in a way we have not established you [people of Mecca]; We gave them hearing, sight, and hearts, yet their hearing, sight, and hearts were of no use to them, since they denied God’s revelations. They were overwhelmed by the punishment they had mocked.
te.46:27: We have also destroyed other communities that once flourished around you- We had given them various signs so that they might return to the right way-
te.46:28: so why did their gods not help them, those they set up as gods besides God to bring them nearer to Him? No indeed! They failed them utterly: it was all a lie of their own making.
te.46:29: We sent a group of jinn to you [Prophet] to listen to the Quran. When they heard it, they said to one another, ‘Be quiet!’ Then when it was finished they turned to their community and gave them warning.
te.46:30: They said, ‘Our people, we have been listening to a Scripture that came after Moses, confirming previous scriptures, giving guidance to the truth and the straight path.
te.46:31: Our people, respond to the one who calls you to God. Believe in Him: He will forgive you your sins and protect you from a painful torment.’
te.46:32: Those who fail to respond to God’s call cannot escape God’s power anywhere on earth, nor will they have any protector against Him: such people have clearly gone far astray.
te.46:33: Do the disbelievers not understand that God, who created the heavens and earth and did not tire in doing so, has the power to bring the dead back to life? Yes indeed! He has power over everything.
te.46:34: On the Day the disbelievers are brought before Hell [it will be said to them], ‘Is this not real?’ ‘Yes, by our Lord,’ they will reply and He will say, ‘Then taste the punishment for having denied the truth.’
te.46:35: Be steadfast [Muhammad], like those messengers of firm resolve. Do not seek to hasten the punishment for the disbelievers: on the Day they see what they had been warned about, it will seem to them that they lingered no more than a single hour of a single day [in this life]. This is a warning. Shall any be destroyed except the defiant?
te.47:1: God will bring to nothing the deeds of those who disbelieve and bar others from the way of God,
te.47:2: but He will overlook the bad deeds of those who have faith, do good deeds, and believe in what has been sent down to Muhammad––the truth from their Lord––and He will put them into a good state.
te.47:3: This is because the disbelievers follow falsehood, while the believers follow the truth from their Lord. In this way God shows people their true type.
te.47:4: When you meet the disbelievers in battle, strike them in the neck, and once they are defeated, bind any captives firmly––later you can release them by grace or by ransom––until the toils of war have ended. That [is the way]. God could have defeated them Himself if He had willed, but His purpose is to test some of you by means of others. He will not let the deeds of those who are killed for His cause come to nothing;
te.47:5: He will guide them and put them into a good state;
te.47:6: He will admit them into the Garden He has already made known to them.
te.47:7: You who believe! If you help God, He will help you and make you stand firm.
te.47:8: As for the disbelievers, how wretched will be their state! God has brought their deeds to nothing.
te.47:9: It is because they hate what God has sent down that He has caused their deeds to go to waste.
te.47:10: Have they not travelled the earth and seen how those before them met their end? God destroyed them utterly: a similar fate awaits the disbelievers.
te.47:11: That is because God protects the believers while the disbelievers have no one to protect them:
te.47:12: God will admit those who believe and do good deeds to Gardens graced with flowing streams; the disbelievers may take their fill of pleasure in this world, and eat as cattle do, but the Fire will be their home.
te.47:13: We have destroyed many a town stronger than your own [Prophet]- the town which [chose to] expel you- and they had no one to help them.
te.47:14: Can those who follow clear proof from their Lord be compared to those whose foul deeds are made to seem alluring to them, those who follow their own desires?
te.47:15: Here is a picture of the Garden promised to the pious: rivers of water forever pure, rivers of milk forever fresh, rivers of wine, a delight for those who drink, rivers of honey clarified and pure, [all] flow in it; there they will find fruit of every kind; and they will find forgiveness from their Lord. How can this be compared to the fate of those stuck in the Fire, given boiling water to drink that tears their bowels?
te.47:16: Some of these people listen to you [Prophet], but, once they leave your presence, they sneer at those who have been given knowledge, saying, ‘What was that he just said?’ These are the ones whose hearts God has sealed, those who follow their own desires.
te.47:17: God has increased the guidance of those who follow the right path, and given them their awareness [of Him].
te.47:18: What are the disbelievers waiting for, other than the Hour which will come upon them unawares? Its signs are already here, but once the Hour has actually arrived, what use will it be then to take heed?
te.47:19: So [Prophet], bear in mind that there is no god but God, and ask forgiveness for your sins and for the sins of believing men and women. God knows whenever any of you move, and whenever any of you stay still.
te.47:20: Those who believe ask why no sura [about fighting] has been sent down. Yet when a decisive sura [that mentions fighting] is sent down, you can see the sick at heart looking at you [Prophet] and visibly fainting at the prospect of death- better for them
te.47:21: would be obedience and fitting words; it would also be better for them to be true to God when the decision to fight has been made.
te.47:22: ‘If you turn away now, could it be that you will go on to spread corruption all over the land and break your ties of kinship?’
te.47:23: These are the ones God has rejected, making their ears deaf and their eyes blind.
te.47:24: Will they not contemplate the Quran? Do they have locks on their hearts?
te.47:25: Those who turn on their heels after being shown guidance are duped and tempted by Satan;
te.47:26: they say to those who hate what God has sent down, ‘We will obey you in some matters’––God knows their secret schemes.
te.47:27: How will they feel when the angels take them in death and beat their faces and their backs
te.47:28: because they practised things that incurred God’s wrath, and disdained to please Him? He makes their deeds go to waste.
te.47:29: Do the corrupt at heart assume that God will not expose their malice?
te.47:30: We could even point them out to you [Prophet] if We wished, and then you could identify them by their marks, but you will know them anyway by the tone of their speech. God knows everything you [people] do.
te.47:31: We shall test you to see which of you strive your hardest and are steadfast; We shall test the sincerity of your assertions.
te.47:32: Those who disbelieve, bar others from God’s path, and oppose the Messenger when they have been shown guidance, do not harm God in any way. He will make their deeds go to waste-
te.47:33: believers, obey God and the Messenger: do not let your deeds go to waste-
te.47:34: God will not forgive those who disbelieve, bar others from God’s path, and die as disbelievers.
te.47:35: So [believers] do not lose heart and cry out for peace. It is you who have the upper hand: God is with you. He will not begrudge you the reward for your [good] deeds:
te.47:36: the life of this world is only a game, a pastime, but if you believe and are mindful of God, He will recompense you. He does not ask you to give up [all] your posses-sions-
te.47:37: you would be grudging if He were to ask you and press you for them, and He would bring your ill-will to light-
te.47:38: though now you are called upon to give [a little] for the sake of God, some of you are grudging. Whoever is grudging is so only towards himself: God is the source of wealth and you are the needy ones. He will substitute other people for you if you turn away, and they will not be like you.
te.48:1: Truly We have opened up a path to clear triumph for you [Prophet],
te.48:2: so that God may forgive you your past and future sins, complete His grace upon you, guide you to a straight path,
te.48:4: It was He who made His tranquillity descend into the hearts of the believers, to add faith to their faith––the forces of the heavens and earth belong to God; He is all knowing and all wise––
te.48:5: so as to admit believing men and women into Gardens graced with flowing streams, there to remain, absolving their bad deeds––a great triumph in God’s eyes––
te.48:6: and to torment the hypocritical and idolatrous men and women who harbour evil thoughts about God––it is they who will be encircled by evil!––who carry the burden of God’s anger, whom God has rejected and for whom He has prepared Hell, an evil destination!
te.48:7: The forces of heaven and earth belong to God; He is almighty and all wise.
te.48:8: We have sent you [Prophet] to bring good news and to give warning,
te.48:9: so that you[people] may believe in God and His Messenger, support Him, honour Him, and praise Him morning and evening.
te.48:10: Those who pledge loyalty to you [Prophet] are actually pledging loyalty to God Himself- God’s hand is placed on theirs––and anyone who breaks his pledge does so to his own detriment: God will give a great reward to the one who fulfils his pledge to Him.
te.48:11: The desert Arabs who stayed behind will say to you, ‘We were busy with our property and our families: ask forgiveness for us,’ but they say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, ‘Whether it is God’s will to do you harm or good, who can intervene for you?’ No! God is fully aware of everything you [people] do.
te.48:12: No! You thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families and this thought warmed your hearts. Your thoughts are evil, for you are corrupt people:
te.48:13: We have prepared a blazing Fire for those who do not believe in God and His Messenger.
te.48:14: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to God and He forgives whoever He will and punishes whoever He will: God is most forgiving and merciful.
te.48:15: When you [believers] set off for somewhere that promises war gains, those who [previously] stayed behind will say, ‘Let us come with you.’ They want to change God’s words, but tell them [Prophet], ‘You may not come with us: God has said this before.’ They will reply, ‘You begrudge us out of jealousy.’ How little they understand!
te.48:16: Tell the desert Arabs who stayed behind, ‘You will be called to face a people of great might in war and to fight them, unless they surrender: if you obey, God will reward you well, but if you turn away, as you have done before, He will punish you heavily-
te.48:17: the blind, the lame, and the sick will not be blamed.’ God will admit anyone who obeys Him and His Messenger to Gardens graced with flowing streams; He will painfully punish anyone who turns away.
te.48:18: God was pleased with the believers when they swore allegiance to you [Prophet] under the tree: He knew what was in their hearts and so He sent tranquillity down to them and rewarded them with a speedy triumph
te.48:19: and with many future gains. God is mighty and wise.
te.48:20: He has promised you [people] many future gains: He has hastened this gain for you. He has held back the hands of hostile people from you as a sign for the faithful and He will guide you to a straight path.
te.48:21: There are many other gains [to come], over which you have no power. God has full control over them: God has power over all things.
te.48:22: If the disbelievers had fought against you, they would have taken flight and found no one to protect or support them:
te.48:23: such was God’s practice in the past and you will find no change in God’s practices.
te.48:24: In the valley of Mecca it was He who held their hands back from you and your hands back from them after He gave you the advantage over them––God sees all that you do.
te.48:25: They were the ones who disbelieved, who barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and who prevented the offering from reaching its place of sacrifice. If there had not been among them, unknown to you, believing men and women whom you would have trampled underfoot, inadvertently incurring guilt on their account- God brings whoever He will into His mercy- if the [believers] had been clearly separated, We would have inflicted a painful punishment on the disbelievers.
te.48:26: While the disbelievers had fury in their hearts- the fury of ignorance- God sent His tranquillity down on to His Messenger and the believers and made binding on them [their] promise to obey God, for that was more appropriate and fitting for them. God has full knowledge of all things.
te.48:27: God has truly fulfilled His Messenger’s vision: ‘God willing, you will most certainly enter the Sacred Mosque in safety, shavenheaded or with cropped hair, without fear!’- God knew what you did not- and He has granted you a speedy triumph.
te.48:28: It was He who sent His Messenger, with guidance and the religion of Truth, for him to show that it is above all [false] religion. God suffices as a witness:
te.48:29: Muhammad is the Messenger of God. Those who follow him are harsh towards the disbelievers and compassionate towards each other. You see them kneeling and prostrating, seeking God’s bounty and His good pleasure: on their faces they bear the marks of their prostrations. This is how they are pictured in the Torah and the Gospel: like a seed that puts forth its shoot, becomes strong, grows thick, and rises on its stem to the delight of its sowers. So God infuriates the disbelievers through them; God promises forgiveness and a great reward to those who believe and do righteous deeds.
te.49:1: Believers, do not push yourselves forward in the presence of God and His Messenger––be mindful of God: He hears and knows all––
te.49:2: believers, do not raise your voices above the Prophet’s, do not raise your voice when speaking to him as you do to one another, or your [good] deeds may be cancelled out without you knowing.
te.49:3: It is those who lower their voices in the presence of God’s Messenger whose hearts God has proved to be aware––they will have forgiveness, and a great reward––
te.49:4: but most of those who shout to you [Prophet] from outside your private rooms lack understanding.
te.49:5: It would have been better for them if they had waited patiently for you to come out to them but God is all forgiving and merciful.
te.49:6: Believers, if a troublemaker brings you news, check it first, in case you wrong others unwittingly and later regret what you have done,
te.49:7: and be aware that it is God’s Messenger who is among you: in many matters you would certainly suffer if he were to follow your wishes. God has endeared faith to you and made it beautiful to your hearts; He has made disbelief, mischief, and disobedience hateful to you. It is people like this who are rightly guided
te.49:8: through God’s favour and blessing: God is all knowing and all wise.
te.49:9: If two groups of the believers fight, you [believers] should try to reconcile them; if one of them is [clearly] oppressing the other, fight the oppressors until they submit to God’s command, then make a just and even-handed reconciliation between the two of them: God loves those who are even-handed.
te.49:10: The believers are brothers, so make peace between your two brothers and be mindful of God, so that you may be given mercy.
te.49:11: Believers, no one group of men should jeer at another, who may after all be better than them; no one group of women should jeer at another, who may after all be better than them; do not speak ill of one another; do not use offensive nicknames for one another. How bad it is to be called a mischief-maker after accepting faith! Those who do not repent of this behaviour are evildoers.
te.49:12: Believers, avoid making too many assumptions- some assumptions are sinful- and do not spy on one another or speak ill of people behind their backs: would any of you like to eat the flesh of your dead brother? No, you would hate it. So be mindful of God: God is ever relenting, most merciful.
te.49:13: People, We created you all from a single man and a single woman, and made you into races and tribes so that you should recognize one another. In God’s eyes, the most honoured of you are the ones most mindful of Him: God is all knowing, all aware.
te.49:14: The desert Arabs say, ‘We have faith.’ [Prophet], tell them, ‘You do not have faith. What you should say instead is, “We have submitted,” for faith has not yet entered your hearts.’ If you obey God and His Messenger, He will not diminish any of your deeds: He is most forgiving and most merciful.
te.49:15: The true believers are the ones who have faith in God and His Messenger and leave all doubt behind, the ones who have struggled with their possessions and their persons in God’s way: they are the ones who are true.
te.49:16: Say, ‘Do you presume to teach God about your religion, when God knows everything in the heavens and earth, and He has full knowledge of all things?’
te.49:17: They think they have done you [Prophet] a favour by submitting. Say, ‘Do not consider your submission a favour to me; it is God who has done you a favour, by guiding you to faith, if you are truly sincere.’
te.49:18: God knows the secrets of the heavens and earth: He sees everything you do.
te.50:2: But the disbelievers are amazed that a warner has come from among them and they say, ‘How strange!
te.50:3: To come back [to life] after we have died and become dust? That is too farfetched.’
te.50:4: We know very well what the earth takes away from them: We keep a comprehensive record.
te.50:5: But the disbelievers deny the truth when it comes to them; they are in a state of confusion.
te.50:6: Do they not see the sky above them––how We have built and adorned it, with no rifts in it;
te.50:7: how We spread out the earth and put solid mountains on it, and caused every kind of joyous plant to grow in it,
te.50:8: as a lesson and reminder for every servant who turns to God;
te.50:9: and how We send blessed water down from the sky and grow with it gardens, the harvest grain,
te.50:10: and tall palm trees laden with clusters of dates,
te.50:11: as a provision for everyone; how with water We give [new] life to a land that is dead? This is how the dead will emerge [from their graves].
te.50:12: The people of Noah disbelieved long before these disbelievers, as did the people of Rass, Thamud,
te.50:14: the Forest-Dwellers, Tubba: all of these people disbelieved their messengers, and so My warning was realized.
te.50:15: So were We incapable of the first creation? No indeed! Yet they doubt a second creation.
te.50:16: We created man––We know what his soul whispers to him: We are closer to him than his jugular vein––
te.50:17: with two receptors set to record, one on his right side and one on his left:
te.50:18: he does not utter a single word without an ever-present watcher.
te.50:19: The trance of death will bring the Truth with it: ‘This is what you tried to escape.’
te.50:20: The Trumpet will be sounded: ‘This is the Day [you were] warned of.’
te.50:21: Each person will arrive attended by an [angel] to drive him on and another to bear witness:
te.50:22: ‘You paid no attention to this [Day]; but today We have removed your veil and your sight is sharp.’
te.50:23: The person’s attendant will say, ‘Here is what I have prepared’-
te.50:25: everyone who hindered good, was aggressive, caused others to doubt,
te.50:26: and set up other gods alongside God. Hurl him into severe punishment!’-
te.50:27: and his [evil] companion will say, ‘Lord, I did not make him transgress; he had already gone far astray himself.’
te.50:28: God will say, ‘Do not argue in My presence. I sent you a warning
te.50:29: and My word cannot be changed: I am not unjust to any creature.’
te.50:30: We shall say to Hell on that day, ‘Are you full?’ and it will reply, ‘Are there no more?’
te.50:31: But Paradise will be brought close to the righteous and will no longer be distant:
te.50:32: ‘This is what you were promised––this is for everyone who turned often to God and kept Him in mind,
te.50:33: who held the Most Gracious in awe, though He is unseen, who comes before Him with a heart turned to Him in devotion-
te.50:34: so enter it in peace. This is the Day of everlasting Life.’
te.50:35: They will have all that they wish for there, and We have more for them.
te.50:36: We have destroyed even mightier generations before these disbelievers, who travelled through [many] lands- was there any escape?
te.50:37: There truly is a reminder in this for whoever has a heart, whoever listens attentively.
te.50:38: We created the heavens, the earth, and everything between, in six Days without tiring.
te.50:39: So [Prophet], bear everything they say with patience; celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising and setting of the sun;
te.50:40: proclaim His praise in the night and at the end of every prayer;
te.50:41: listen out for the Day when the caller will call from a nearby place.
te.50:42: They will come out [from their graves] on that Day, the Day when they hear the mighty blast in reality.
te.50:43: It is We who give life and death; the final return will be to Us
te.50:44: on the Day when the earth will be torn apart, letting them rush out- that gathering will be easy for Us.
te.50:45: We know best what the disbelievers say. You [Prophet] are not there to force them, so remind, with this Quran, those who fear My warning.
te.51:1: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,
te.51:2: and those that are heavily laden,
te.51:5: What you [people] are promised is true:
te.51:7: by the sky with its pathways,
te.51:8: you differ in what you say––
te.51:9: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.
te.51:11: those steeped in error and unaware!
te.51:12: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’
te.51:13: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,
te.51:14: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’
te.51:15: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.
te.51:16: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:
te.51:18: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,
te.51:19: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.
te.51:20: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––
te.51:21: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––
te.51:22: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.
te.51:23: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.
te.51:24: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?
te.51:25: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’
te.51:26: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,
te.51:27: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,
te.51:28: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.
te.51:29: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’
te.51:30: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’
te.51:31: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’
te.51:32: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,
te.51:33: to bring down rocks of clay,
te.51:34: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’
te.51:35: We brought out such believers as were there-
te.51:36: We found only one household devoted to God-
te.51:37: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
te.51:38: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
te.51:39: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’
te.51:40: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.
te.51:41: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them
te.51:42: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.
te.51:43: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’
te.51:44: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:
te.51:45: they could not even remain standing, let alone defend themselves.
te.51:46: Before that We destroyed the people of Noah. They were a truly sinful people!
te.51:47: We built the heavens with Our power and made them vast,
te.51:48: We spread out the earth- how well We smoothed it out!-
te.51:49: and We created pairs of all things so that you [people] might take note.
te.51:50: [So, say to them, Prophet], ‘Quickly, turn to God- I am sent by Him to give you clear warning-
te.51:51: and do not set up any other god alongside Him. I am sent by Him to give you clear warning!’
te.51:52: Every previous people to whom a messenger was sent also said, ‘A sor-cerer, or maybe a madman!’
te.51:53: Did they tell one another to do this? No! They are a people who exceed all bounds,
te.51:54: so ignore them [Prophet]- you are not to blame-
te.51:55: and go on reminding [people], it is good for those who believe to be reminded.
te.51:56: I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me:
te.51:57: I want no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me-
te.51:58: God is the Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever Mighty.
te.51:59: The evildoers, like their predecessors, will have a share of punishment- they need not ask Me to hasten it-
te.51:60: and woe betide those who deny the truth on the Day they have been promised.
te.52:9: on the Day when the sky sways back and forth
te.52:11: Woe on that Day to those who deny the Truth,
te.52:12: who amuse themselves with idle chatter:
te.52:13: on that Day they will be thrust into the Fire of Hell.
te.52:14: ‘This is the Fire you used to deny.
te.52:15: So is this sorcery? Do you still not see it?
te.52:16: Burn in it––it makes no difference whether you bear it patiently or not–– you are only being repaid for what you have done.’
te.52:17: Those who were mindful of God are in Gardens and in bliss,
te.52:18: rejoicing in their Lord’s gifts: He has saved them from the torment of the Blaze,
te.52:19: ‘Eat and drink with healthy enjoyment as a reward for what you have done.’
te.52:20: They are comfortably seated on couches arranged in rows; We pair them with beautiful-eyed maidens;
te.52:21: We unite the believers with their offspring who followed them in faith–– We do not deny them any of the rewards for their deeds: each person is in pledge for his own deeds––
te.52:22: We provide them with any fruit or meat they desire.
te.52:23: They pass around a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin.
te.52:24: Devoted youths like hidden pearls wait on them.
te.52:25: They turn to one another and say,
te.52:26: ‘When we were still with our families [on earth] we used to live in fear––
te.52:27: God has been gracious to us and saved us from the torment of intense heat-
te.52:28: We used to pray to Him: He is the Good, the Merciful One.’
te.52:29: So [Prophet] remind [people]. By the grace of your Lord [Prophet], you are neither oracle nor madman.
te.52:30: If they say, ‘He is only a poet: we shall await his fate,’
te.52:31: say, ‘Wait if you wish; I too am waiting’-
te.52:32: does their reason really tell them to do this, or are they simply insolent people?
te.52:33: If they say, ‘He has made it up himself’- they certainly do not believe-
te.52:34: let them produce one like it, if what they say is true.
te.52:35: Were they created without any agent? Were they the creators?
te.52:36: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They do not have faith.
te.52:37: Do they possess your Lord’s treasures or have control over them?
te.52:38: Do they have a ladder to climb, in order to eavesdrop [on Heaven’s secrets]? Let their eavesdropper produce clear proof.
te.52:39: Does God have daughters while you have sons?
te.52:40: Do you [Prophet] demand a payment from them that would burden them with debt?
te.52:41: Do they have [access to] the unseen? Could they write it down?
te.52:42: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared.
te.52:43: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him.
te.52:44: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’
te.52:45: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck,
te.52:46: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help.
te.52:47: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it.
te.52:48: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise.
te.52:49: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars.

te.53:29: So [Prophet] ignore those who turn away from Our revelation, who want only the life of this world.
te.53:30: Their knowledge does not go beyond that. Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who follows guidance.
te.53:31: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and reward, with what is best, those who do good.
te.53:32: As for those who avoid grave sins and foul acts, though they may commit small sins, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. te.53:33: [Prophet], consider that man who turned away:
te.53:34: he only gave a little and then he stopped.
te.53:35: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen? Can he see [the Hereafter]?
te.53:36: Has he not been told what was written in the Scriptures of Moses
te.53:37: and of Abraham, who fulfilled his duty:
te.53:38: that no soul shall bear the burden of another;
te.53:39: that man will only have what he has worked towards;
te.53:40: that his labour will be seen
te.53:41: and that in the end he will be repaid in full for it;
te.53:42: that the final goal is your Lord;
te.53:43: that it is He who makes people laugh and weep;
te.53:44: that it is He who gives death and life;
te.53:45: that He Himself created the two sexes, male and female,
te.53:46: from an ejected drop of sperm;
te.53:47: that He will undertake the second Creation;
te.53:48: that it is He who gives wealth and possessions;
te.53:49: that He is the Lord of Sirius;
te.53:50: that it was He who destroyed, in their entirety, ancient 'Ad

te.53:53: that it was He who brought down the ruined cities

te.53:55: Which then of your Lord’s blessings do you deny?
te.53:56: This is a warning just like the warnings sent in former times.
te.53:58: and only God can disclose it.
te.53:60: Why do you laugh instead of weeping?
te.53:61: Why do you pay no heed?
te.53:62: Bow down before God and worship.
te.54:1: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.
te.54:2: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’
te.54:3: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––
te.54:4: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––
te.54:5: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:
te.54:6: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,
te.54:7: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts
te.54:8: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’
te.54:9: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,
te.54:10: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’
te.54:11: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,
te.54:12: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.
te.54:13: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails
te.54:14: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.
te.54:15: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?
te.54:16: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
te.54:17: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
te.54:18: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
te.54:19: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;
te.54:20: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.
te.54:21: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
te.54:22: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
te.54:23: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:
te.54:24: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!
te.54:25: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’
te.54:26: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,
te.54:27: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.
te.54:28: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’
te.54:29: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.
te.54:30: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
te.54:31: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.
te.54:32: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
te.54:33: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
te.54:34: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn
te.54:35: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.
te.54:36: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-
te.54:37: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-
te.54:38: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-
te.54:39: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’
te.54:40: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
te.54:41: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.
te.54:42: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.
te.54:43: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’
te.54:44: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?
te.54:45: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.
te.54:46: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:
te.54:47: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––
te.54:48: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’
te.54:49: We have created all things in due measure;
te.54:50: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;
te.54:51: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?

te.56:76: a mighty oath, if you only knew-
te.56:77: that this is truly a noble Quran,
te.56:79: that only the purified can touch,

te.56:86: why, if you are not to be judged,

te.56:88: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to God,

te.56:90: if he is one of those on the Right,
