te.56:96: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Supreme.
te.57:1: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God––He is the Almighty, the Wise.
te.57:2: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him; He gives life and death; He has power over all things.
te.57:3: He is the First and the Last; the Outer and the Inner; He has knowledge of all things.
te.57:4: It was He who created the heavens and earth in six Days and then established Himself on the throne. He knows what enters the earth and what comes out of it; what descends from the sky and what ascends to it. He is with you wherever you are; He sees all that you do;
te.57:5: control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him. Everything is brought back to God.
te.57:6: He makes night merge into day and day into night. He knows what is in every heart.
te.57:7: Believe in God and His Messenger, and give out of what He has made pass down to you: those of you who believe and give will have a great reward.
te.57:8: Why should you not believe in God when the Mes-senger calls you to believe in your Lord, and He has already made a pledge with you, if you have faith?
te.57:9: It is He who has sent down clear revelations to His Servant, so that He may bring you from the depths of darkness into light; God is truly kind and merciful to you.
te.57:10: Why should you not give for God’s cause when God alone will inherit what is in the heavens and earth? Those who gave and fought before the triumph are not like others: they are greater in rank than those who gave and fought afterwards. But God has promised a good reward to all of them: God is fully aware of all that you do.
te.57:11: Who will make God a good loan? He will double it for him and reward him generously.
te.57:12: On the Day when you [Prophet] see the believers, both men and women, with their light streaming out ahead of them and to their right, [they will be told], ‘The good news for you today is that there are Gardens graced with flowing streams where you will stay: that is truly the supreme triumph!’
te.57:13: On the same Day, the hypocrites, both men and women, will say to the believers, ‘Wait for us! Let us have some of your light!’ They will be told, ‘Go back and look for a light.’ A wall with a door will be erected between them: inside it lies mercy, outside lies torment.
te.57:14: The hypocrites will call out to the believers, ‘Were we not with you?’ They will reply, ‘Yes. But you allowed yourselves to be tempted, you were hesitant, doubtful, deceived by false hopes until God’s command came- the Deceiver tricked you about God.
te.57:15: Today no ransom will be accepted from you or from the disbelievers: your home is the Fire- that is where you belong––a miserable destination!’
te.57:16: Is it not time for believers to humble their hearts to the remembrance of God and the Truth that has been revealed, and not to be like those who received the Scripture before them, whose time was extended but whose hearts hardened and many of whom were lawbreakers?
te.57:17: Remember that God revives the earth after it dies; We have made Our revelation clear to you so that you may use your reason.
te.57:18: Charitable men and women who make a good loan to God will have it doubled and have a generous reward.
te.57:19: Those who believe in God and His messengers are the truthful ones who will bear witness before their Lord: they will have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations are the inhabitants of Hell.
te.57:20: Bear in mind that the present life is just a game, a diversion, an attraction, a cause of boasting among you, of rivalry in wealth and children. It is like plants that spring up after the rain: their growth at first delights the sowers, but then you see them wither away, turn yellow, and become stubble. There is terrible punishment in the next life as well as forgiveness and approval from God; the life of this world is only an illusory pleasure.
te.57:21: So race for your Lord’s forgiveness and a Garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers: that is God’s bounty, which He bestows on whoever He pleases. God’s bounty is infinite.
te.57:22: No misfortune can happen, either in the earth or in yourselves, that was not set down in writing before We brought it into being- that is easy for God-
te.57:23: so you need not grieve for what you miss or gloat over what you gain. God does not love the conceited, the boastful,
te.57:24: those who are miserly, and who tell other people to be miserly. If anyone turns away, remember that God is self-sufficient and worthy of praise.
te.57:25: We sent Our messengers with clear signs, the Scripture and the Balance, so that people could uphold justice: We also sent iron, with its mighty strength and many uses for mankind, so that God could mark out those who would help Him and His messengers though they cannot see Him. Truly God is powerful, almighty.
te.57:26: We sent Noah and Abraham, and gave prophethood and scripture to their offspring: among them there were some who were rightly guided, but many were lawbreakers.
te.57:27: We sent other messengers to follow in their footsteps. After those We sent Jesus, son of Mary: We gave him the Gospel and put compassion and mercy into the hearts of his followers. But monasticism was something they invented- We did not ordain it for them- only to seek God’s pleasure, and even so, they did not observe it properly. So We gave a reward to those of them who believed, but many of them were lawbreakers.
te.57:28: Believers, be mindful of God and have faith in His Messenger: He will give you a double share of His mercy; He will provide a light to help you walk; He will forgive you- God is most forgiving, most merciful.
te.57:29: The People of the Book should know that they have no power over any of God’s grace and that grace is in the hand of God alone: He gives it to whoever He will. God’s grace is truly immense.
te.58:1: God has heard the words of the woman who disputed with you [Prophet] about her husband and complained to God: God has heard what you both had to say. He is all hearing, all seeing.
te.58:2: Even if any of you say to their wives, ‘You are to me like my mother’s back,’they are not their mothers; their only mothers are those who gave birth to them. What they say is certainly blameworthy and false, but God is pardoning and forgiving.
te.58:3: Those of you who say such a thing to their wives, then go back on what they have said, must free a slave before the couple may touch one another again––this is what you are commanded to do, and God is fully aware of what you do––
te.58:4: but anyone who does not have the means should fast continuously for two months before they touch each other, and anyone unable to do this should feed sixty needy people. This is so that you may [truly] have faith in God and His Messenger. These are the bounds set by God: grievous torment awaits those who ignore them.
te.58:5: Those who oppose God and His Messenger will be brought low, like those before them: We have revealed clear messages, and humiliating torment awaits those who ignore them,
te.58:6: on the Day when God will raise everyone and make them aware of what they have done. God has taken account of it all, though they may have forgotten: He witnesses everything.
te.58:7: Do you not see [Prophet] that God knows everything in the heavens and earth? There is no secret conversation between three people where He is not the fourth, nor between five where He is not the sixth, nor between less or more than that without Him being with them, wherever they may be. On the Day of Resurrection, He will show them what they have done: God truly has full knowledge of everything.
te.58:8: Have you not seen how those who have been forbidden to hold secret conversations go back afterwards and hold them, and conspire with one another in what is sinful, hostile, and disobedient to the Messenger? When they come to you they greet you with words God has never used to greet you, and say inwardly, ‘Why does God not punish us for what we say?’ Hell will be punishment enough for them: they will burn there- an evil destination.
te.58:9: You who believe, when you converse in secret, do not do so in a way that is sinful, hostile, and disobedient to the Messenger, but in a way that is good and mindful [of God]. Be mindful of God, to whom you will all be gathered.
te.58:10: [Any other kind of] secret conversation is the work of Satan, designed to cause trouble to the believers, though it cannot harm them in the least unless God permits it. Let the believers put their trust in God.
te.58:11: You who believe, if you are told to make room for one another in your assemblies, then do so, and God will make room for you, and if you are told to rise up, do so: God will raise up, by many degrees, those of you who believe and those who have been given knowledge: He is fully aware of what you do.
te.58:12: You who believe, when you come to speak privately with the Messenger, offer something in charity before your conversation: that is better for you and purer. If you do not have the means, God is most forgiving and merciful.
te.58:13: Were you afraid to give charity before consulting the Prophet? Since you did not give charity, and God has relented towards you, you should [at least] observe your prayers, pay the prescribed alms, and obey God and His Messenger: God is well aware of your actions.
te.58:14: Have you not seen [Prophet] those who give their loyalty to people with whom God is angry? They are neither with you nor with them, and knowingly swear to lies.
te.58:15: God has prepared a severe torment for them: what they do is truly evil.
te.58:16: They have used their oaths to cover up [their false deeds], and barred others from the path of God. A humiliating torment awaits them-
te.58:17: neither their wealth nor their children will be of any use to them against God- they will be the inhabitants of Hell, where they will remain.
te.58:18: On the Day God raises them all from the dead, they will swear before Him as they swear before you now, thinking that it will help them. What liars they are!
te.58:19: Satan has gained control over them and made them forget God. They are on Satan’s side, and Satan’s side will be the losers:
te.58:20: those who oppose God and His Messenger will be among the most humiliated.
te.58:21: God has written, ‘I shall most certainly win, I and My messengers.’ God is powerful and almighty.
te.58:22: [Prophet], you will not find people who truly believe in God and the Last Day giving their loyalty to those who oppose God and His Messenger, even though they may be their fathers, sons, brothers, or other relations: these are the people in whose hearts God has inscribed faith, and whom He has strengthened with His spirit. He will let them enter Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will stay: God is well pleased with them, and they with Him. They are on God’s side, and God’s side will be the one to prosper.
te.59:1: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God; He is the Almighty, the Wise.
te.59:2: It was He who drove those of the People of the Book who broke faith out from their homes at the first gathering of forces––you [believers] never thought they would go, and they themselves thought their fortifications would protect them against God. God came up on them from where they least expected and put panic into their hearts: their homes were destroyed by their own hands, and the hands of the believers. Learn from this, all of you with insight!
te.59:3: If God had not decreed exile for them, He would have tormented them [even more severely] in this world. In the Hereafter they will have the torment of the Fire
te.59:4: because they set themselves against God and His Messenger: God is stern in punishment towards anyone who sets himself against Him.
te.59:5: Whatever you [believers] may have done to [their] palm trees–– cutting them down or leaving them standing on their roots––was done by God’s leave, so that He might disgrace those who defied Him.
te.59:6: You [believers] did not have to spur on your horses or your camels for whatever gains God turned over to His Messenger from them. God gives authority to His messengers over whoever He will: God has power over all things.
te.59:7: Whatever gains God has turned over to His Messenger from the inhabitants of the villages belong to God, the Messenger, kinsfolk, orphans, the needy, the traveller in need- this is so that they do not just circulate among those of you who are rich––so accept whatever the Messenger gives you, and abstain from whatever he forbids you. Be mindful of God: God is severe in punishment.
te.59:8: The poor emigrants who were driven from their homes and possessions, who seek God’s favour and approval, those who help God and His Messenger- these are the ones who are true- [shall have a share].
te.59:9: Those who were already firmly established in their homes [in Medina], and firmly rooted in faith, show love for those who migrated to them for refuge and harbour no desire in their hearts for what has been given to them. They give them preference over themselves, even if they too are poor: those who are saved from their own souls’ greed are truly successful.
te.59:10: Those who came after them say, ‘Lord, forgive us our sins and the sins of our brothers who believed before us, and leave no malice in our hearts towards those who believe. Lord, You are truly compassionate and merciful.’
te.59:11: Have you [Prophet] considered the hypocrites who say to their fellows, the faithless among the People of the Book, ‘If you are driven out, we shall go with you- we would never listen to anyone who sought to harm you- and if you are attacked, we shall certainly come to your aid’? God bears witness that they are in fact liars:
te.59:12: if they are driven out, they will never leave with them; if they are attacked, they will never help them. Even if they did come to their aid, they would soon turn tail and flee- in the end they would have no help.
te.59:13: Fear of you [believers] is more intense in their hearts than fear of God because they are people devoid of understanding.
te.59:14: Even united they would never fight you, except from within fortified strongholds or behind high walls. There is much hostility between them: you think they are united but their hearts are divided because they are people devoid of reason.
te.59:15: Like those who went just before them, they have tasted the result of their conduct and a painful punishment awaits them.
te.59:16: Like Satan, who says to man, ‘Do not believe!’ but when man disbelieves, says, ‘I disown you; I fear God, the Lord of the Worlds,’
te.59:17: both will end up in the Fire, there to remain. That is the reward of evildoers.
te.59:18: You who believe! Be mindful of God, and let every soul consider carefully what it sends ahead for tomorrow; be mindful of God, for God is well aware of everything you do.
te.59:19: Do not be like those who forget God, so God causes them to forget their own souls: they are the rebellious ones-
te.59:20: there is no comparison between the inhabitants of the Fire and the inhabitants of Paradise- and the inhabitants of Paradise are the successful ones.
te.59:21: If We had sent this Quran down to a mountain, you [Prophet] would have seen it humbled and split apart in its awe of God: We offer people such illustrations so that they may reflect.
te.59:22: He is God: there is no god other than Him. It is He who knows what is hidden as well as what is in the open, He is the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy.
te.59:23: He is God: there is no god other than Him, the Controller, the Holy One, Source of Peace, Granter of Security, Guardian over all, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Truly Great; God is far above anything they consider to be His partner.
te.59:24: He is God: the Creator, the Originator, the Shaper. The best names belong to Him. Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies Him: He is the Almighty, the Wise.
te.60:1: You who believe, do not take My enemies and yours as your allies, showing them friendship when they have rejected the truth you have received, and have driven you and the Messenger out simply because you believe in God, your Lord––not if you truly emigrated in order to strive for My cause and seek My good pleasure. You secretly show them friendship––I know all you conceal and all you reveal–– but any of you who do this are straying from the right path.
te.60:2: If they gain the upper hand over you, they will revert to being your enemies and stretch out their hands and tongues to harm you; it is their dearest wish that you may renounce your faith.
te.60:3: Neither your kinsfolk nor your children will be any use to you on the Day of Resurrection: He will separate you out. God sees everything you do.
te.60:4: You have a good example in Abraham and his companions, when they said to their people, ‘We disown you and what you worship besides God! We renounce you! Until you believe in God alone, the enmity and hatred that has arisen between us will endure!’––except when Abraham said to his father, ‘I will pray for forgiveness for you though I cannot protect you from God’––[they prayed] ‘Lord, we have put our trust in You; we turn to You; You are our final destination.
te.60:5: Lord, do not expose us to mistreatment [at the hands of] the disbelievers. Forgive us, Lord, for You are the Almighty, the All Wise.’
te.60:6: Truly, they are a good example for you [believers] to follow, a good example for those who fear God and the Last Day. If anyone turns away, [remember] God is self-sufficing and worthy of all praise.
te.60:7: God may still bring about affection between you and your present enemies- God is all powerful, God is most forgiving and merciful-
te.60:8: and He does not forbid you to deal kindly and justly with anyone who has not fought you for your faith or driven you out of your homes: God loves the just.
te.60:9: But God forbids you to take as allies those who have fought against you for your faith, driven you out of your homes, and helped others to drive you out: any of you who take them as allies will truly be wrongdoers.
te.60:10: You who believe, test the believing women when they come to you as emigrants- God knows best about their faith- and if you are sure of their belief, do not send them back to the disbelievers: they are not lawful wives for them, nor are the disbelievers their lawful husbands. Give the disbelievers whatever bride-gifts they have paid- if you choose to marry them, there is no blame on you once you have paid their bride-gifts- and do not yourselves hold on to marriage ties with disbelieving women. Ask for repayment of the bride-gifts you have paid, and let the disbelievers do the same. This is God’s judgement: He judges between you, God is all knowing and wise.
te.60:11: If any of you have wives who leave you for the disbelievers, and if your community subsequently acquires [gains] from them, then pay those whose wives have deserted them the equivalent of whatever bride-gift they paid. Be mindful of God, in whom you believe.
te.60:12: Prophet, when believing women come and pledge to you that they will not ascribe any partner to God, nor steal, nor commit adultery, nor kill their children, nor lie about who has fathered their children, nor disobey you in any righteous thing, then you should accept their pledge of allegiance and pray to God to forgive them: God is most forgiving and merciful.
te.60:13: You who believe, do not take as allies those with whom God is angry: they despair of the life to come as the disbelievers despair of those buried in their graves.
te.61:1: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God––He is the Almighty, the Wise.
te.61:2: You who believe, why do you say things and then do not do them?
te.61:3: It is most hateful to God that you say things and then do not do them;
te.61:4: God truly loves those who fight in solid lines for His cause, like a well-compacted wall.
te.61:5: Moses said to his people, ‘My people, why do you hurt me when you know that I am sent to you by God?’ When they went astray, God left their hearts to stray: God does not guide rebellious people.
te.61:6: Jesus, son of Mary, said, ‘Children of Israel, I am sent to you by God, confirming the Torah that came before me and bringing good news of a messenger to follow me whose name will be Ahmad.’ Yet when he came to them with clear signs, they said, ‘This is obviously sorcery.’
te.61:7: Who could be more wrong than someone who invents lies against God when called to submit to Him? God does not guide the wrongdoers:
te.61:8: they wish to put His light out with their mouths. But He will perfect His light, even though the disbelievers hate it;
te.61:9: it is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to show that it is above all [other] religions, even though the idolaters hate it.
te.61:10: You who believe, shall I show you a bargain that will save you from painful torment?
te.61:11: Have faith in God and His Messenger and struggle for His cause with your possessions and your persons––that is better for you, if only you knew-
te.61:12: and He will forgive your sins, admit you into Gardens graced with flowing streams, into pleasant dwellings in the Gardens of Eternity. That is the supreme triumph.
te.61:13: And He will give you something else that will really please you: His help and an imminent breakthrough. [Prophet], give the faithful the good news.
te.61:14: You who believe, be God’s helpers. As Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples, ‘Who will come with me to help God?’ The disciples said, ‘We shall be God’s helpers.’ Some of the Children of Israel believed and some disbelieved: We supported the believers against their enemy and they were the ones who came out on top.
te.62:1: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God, the Controller, the Holy One, the Almighty, the Wise.
te.62:2: It is He who raised a mes-senger, among the people who had no Scripture, to recite His revelations to them, to make them grow spiritually and teach them the Scripture and wisdom––before that they were clearly astray––
te.62:3: to them and others yet to join them. He is the Almighty, the Wise:
te.62:4: such is God’s favour that He grants it to whoever He will; God’s favour is immense.
te.62:5: Those who have been charged to obey the Torah, but do not do so, are like asses carrying books: how base such people are who disobey God’s revelations! God does not guide people who do wrong.
te.62:6: Say [Prophet], ‘You who follow the Jewish faith, if you truly claim that out of all people you alone are friends of God, then you should be hoping for death.’
te.62:7: But because of what they have stored up for themselves with their own hands they would never hope for death––God knows the wrongdoers very well––
te.62:8: so say, ‘The death you run away from will come to meet you and you will be returned to the One who knows the unseen as well as the seen: He will tell you everything you have done.’
te.62:9: Believers! When the call to prayer is made on the day of congregation, hurry towards the reminder of God and leave off your trading––that is better for you, if only you knew––
te.62:10: then when the prayer has ended, disperse in the land and seek out God’s bounty. Remember God often so that you may prosper.
te.62:11: Yet they scatter towards trade or entertainment whenever they observe it, and leave you [Prophet] standing there. Say, ‘God’s gift is better than any entertainment or trade: God is the best provider.’
te.63:1: When the hypocrites come to you [Prophet], they say, ‘We bear witness that you are the Messenger of God.’ God knows that you truly are His Messenger and He bears witness that the hypocrites are liars––
te.63:2: they use their oaths as a cover and so bar others from God’s way: what they have been doing is truly evil––
te.63:3: because they professed faith and then rejected it, so their hearts have been sealed and they do not understand.
te.63:4: When you see them [Prophet], their outward appearance pleases you; when they speak, you listen to what they say. But they are like propped-up tim-bers––they think every cry they hear is against them––and they are the enemy. Beware of them. May God confound them! How devious they are!
te.63:5: They turn their heads away in disdain when they are told, ‘Come, so that the Messenger of God may ask forgiveness for you,’ and you see them walking away arrogantly.
te.63:6: It makes no difference whether you ask forgiveness for them or not, God will not forgive them: God does not guide such treacherous people.
te.63:7: They are the ones who say, ‘Give nothing to those who follow God’s Messenger, until they abandon him’, but to God belong the treasures of the heavens and earth, though the hypocrites do not understand this.
te.63:8: They say, ‘Once we return to Medina the powerful will drive out the weak,’ but power belongs to God, to His Messenger, and to the believers, though the hypocrites do not know this.
te.63:9: Believers, do not let your wealth and your children distract you from remembering God: those who do so will be the ones who lose.
te.63:10: Give out of what We have provided for you, before death comes to one of you and he says, ‘My Lord, if You would only reprieve me for a little while, I would give in charity and become one of the righteous.’
te.63:11: God does not reprieve a soul when its turn comes: God is fully aware of what you do.
te.64:1: Everything that is in the heavens and earth glorifies God; all control and all praise belong to Him; He has power over everything.
te.64:2: It is He who created you, yet some of you disbelieve and some believe: God sees everything you do.
te.64:3: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose; He formed you and made your forms good: you will all return to Him.
te.64:4: He knows what is in the heavens and earth; He knows what you conceal and what you reveal; God knows very well the secrets of every heart.
te.64:5: [Disbelievers], have you not heard about those who disbelieved before you? They tasted the evil consequences of their conduct, and a painful torment awaits them.
te.64:6: That is because their messengers came to them with clear signs, yet they said, ‘Should we take guidance from mere mortals?’, rejected the message, and turned away. But God had no need for them: He is all sufficient, worthy of all praise.
te.64:7: The disbelievers claim they will not be raised from the dead. Say [Prophet], ‘Yes indeed! I swear by my Lord! You will be raised and then you will be informed about everything you have done: an easy matter for God.’
te.64:8: So believe in God, in His Messenger, and in the light We have sent down: God is fully aware of what you do.
te.64:9: When He gathers you for the Day of Gathering, the Day of mutual neglect, He will cancel the sins of those who believed in Him and acted righteously: He will admit them into Gardens graced with flowing streams, there to remain for ever- the supreme triumph.
te.64:10: But those who disbelieved and rejected Our signs will be the inhabitants of the Fire, there to remain- a miserable destination.
te.64:11: Misfortunes can only happen with God’s permission––He will guide the heart of anyone who believes in Him: God knows all things––
te.64:12: so obey God and the Messenger. If you turn away, remember that Our Messenger’s duty is only to make plain his message.
te.64:13: God! There is no god but Him, so let the faithful put their trust in Him.
te.64:14: Believers, even among your spouses and your children you have some enemies- beware of them- but if you overlook their offences, forgive them, pardon them, then God is all forgiving, all merciful.
te.64:15: Your wealth and your children are only a test for you. There is great reward with God:
te.64:16: be mindful of God as much as you can; hear and obey; be charitable- it is for your own good. Those who are saved from their own meanness will be the prosperous ones:
te.64:17: if you make a generous loan to God He will multiply it for you and forgive you. God is ever thankful and forbearing;
te.64:18: He knows the unseen, as well as the seen; He is the Almighty, the Wise.
te.65:1: Prophet, when any of you intend to divorce women, do so at a time when their prescribed waiting period can properly start, and calculate the period carefully: be mindful of God, your Lord. Do not drive them out of their homes––nor should they themselves leave––unless they commit a flagrant indecency. These are the limits set by God–– whoever oversteps God’s limits wrongs his own soul––for you cannot know what new situation God may perhaps bring about.
te.65:2: When they have completed their appointed term, either keep them honourably, or part with them honourably. Call two just witnesses from your people and establish witness for the sake of God. Anyone who believes in God and the Last Day should heed this: God will find a way out for those who are mindful of Him,
te.65:3: and will provide for them from an unexpected source; God will be enough for those who put their trust in Him. God achieves His purpose; God has set a due measure for everything.
te.65:4: If you are in doubt, the period of waiting will be three months for those women who have ceased menstruating and for those who have not [yet] menstruated; the waiting period of those who are pregnant will be until they deliver their burden: God makes things easy for those who are mindful of Him.
te.65:5: This is God’s command, which He has sent down to you. God will wipe out the sinful deeds and increase the rewards of anyone who is mindful of Him.
te.65:6: House the wives you are divorcing according to your means, wherever you house yourselves, and do not harass them so as to make their lives difficult. If they are pregnant, maintain them until they are delivered of their burdens; if they suckle your infants, pay them for it. Consult together in a good way- if you make difficulties for one another, another woman may suckle the child for the father––
te.65:7: and let the wealthy man spend according to his wealth. But let him whose provision is restricted spend according to what God has given him: God does not burden any soul with more than He has given it- after hardship, God will bring ease.
te.65:8: Many a town that insolently opposed the command of its Lord and His messengers We have brought sternly to account: We punished them severely
te.65:9: to make them taste the ill effect of their conduct- the result of their conduct was ruin.
te.65:10: God has prepared a severe torment for them. So, you who have understanding, you who believe, beware of God. He has sent you the Quran
te.65:11: and a messenger- reciting to you God’s revelations that make things clear- to bring those who believe and do righteous deeds from darkness into light. God will admit those who believe in Him and do righteous deeds into Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will remain for ever––He has made good provision for them.
te.65:12: It is God who created seven heavens and a similar [number] of earths. His command descends throughout them. So you should realize that He has power over all things and that His knowledge encompasses everything.
te.66:1: Prophet, why do you prohibit what God has made lawful to you in your desire to please your wives? Yet God is forgiving and merciful:
te.66:2: He has ordained a way for you [believers] to release you from [such] oaths––God is your helper: He is the All Knowing, the Wise.
te.66:3: The Prophet told something in confidence to one of his wives. When she disclosed it [to another wife] and God made this known to him, he confirmed part of it, keeping the rest to himself. When he confronted her with what she had done, she asked, ‘Who told you about this?’ and he replied, ‘The All Knowing, the All Aware told me.’
te.66:4: If both of you [wives] repent to God––for your hearts have deviated––[all will be well]; if you collaborate against him, [be warned that] God will aid him, as will Gabriel and all righteous believers, and the angels too will back him.
te.66:5: His Lord may well replace you with better wives if the Prophet decides to divorce any of you: wives who are devoted to God, true believers, devout, who turn to Him in repentance and worship Him, given to fasting, whether previously married or virgins.
te.66:6: Believers, guard yourselves and your families against a Fire fuelled by people and stones, over which stand angels, stern and strong; angels who never disobey God’s commands to them, but do as they are ordered:
te.66:7: ‘You who disbelieve, make no excuses today: you are only being repaid for what you used to do.’
te.66:8: Believers, turn to God in sincere repentance. Your Lord may well cancel your bad deeds for you and admit you into Gardens graced with flowing streams, on a Day when God will not disgrace the Prophet or those who have believed with him. With their lights streaming out ahead of them and to their right, they will say, ‘Lord, perfect our lights for us and forgive us: You have power over everything.’
te.66:9: Prophet, strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Deal with them sternly. Hell will be their home, an evil destination!
te.66:10: God has given examples of disbelievers: the wives of Noah and Lot who married two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them. Their husbands could not help them against God: it was said, ‘Both of you enter the Fire with the others.’
te.66:11: God has also given examples of believers: Pharaoh’s wife, who said, ‘Lord, build me a house near You in the Garden. Save me from Pharaoh and his actions; save me from the evildoers,’
te.66:12: and Mary, daughter of Imran. She guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her from Our spirit. She accepted the truth of her Lord’s words and Scriptures: she was truly devout.
te.67:1: Exalted is He who holds all control in His hands; who has power over all things;
te.67:2: who created death and life to test you [people] and reveal which of you does best––He is the Mighty, the Forgiving;
te.67:3: who created the seven heavens, one above the other. You will not see any flaw in what the Lord of Mercy creates. Look again! Can you see any flaw?
te.67:4: Look again! And again! Your sight will turn back to you, weak and defeated.
te.67:5: We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and made them [missiles] for stoning devils for whom We have also prepared the torment of a blazing fire.
te.67:6: For those who defy their Lord We have prepared the torment of Hell: an evil destination.
te.67:7: They will hear it drawing in its breath when they are thrown in. It blazes forth,
te.67:8: almost bursting with rage. Its keepers will ask every group that is thrown in, ‘Did no one come to warn you?’
te.67:9: They will reply, ‘Yes, a warner did come to us, but we did not believe him. We said, “God has revealed nothing: you are greatly misguided”.’
te.67:10: They will say, ‘If only we had listened, or reasoned, we would not be with the inhabitants of the blazing fire,’ and
te.67:11: they will confess their sins. Away with the inhabitants of the blazing fire!
te.67:12: But there is forgiveness and a great reward for those who fear their Lord though they cannot see Him.
te.67:13: Whether you keep your words secret or state them openly, He knows the contents of every heart.
te.67:14: How could He who created not know His own creation, when He is the Most Subtle, the All Aware?
te.67:15: It is He who has made the earth manageable for you––travel its regions; eat His provision- and to Him you will be resurrected.
te.67:16: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not make the earth swallow you up with a violent shudder?
te.67:17: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not send a whirlwind to pelt you with stones? You will come to know what My warning means.
te.67:18: Those who went before them also disbelieved- how terrible was My condemnation!
te.67:19: Do they not see the birds above them spreading and closing their wings? It is only the Lord of Mercy who holds them up: He watches over everything.
te.67:20: What force can help you if the Lord of Mercy does not? The disbelievers are truly deluded.
te.67:21: Who can provide for you if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in their insolence and their avoidance of the Truth.
te.67:22: Who is better guided: someone who falls on his face, or someone who walks steadily on a straight path?
te.67:23: Say [Prophet], ‘It is He who brought you into being, He who endowed you with hearing, sight, and understanding- what small thanks you give!’
te.67:24: Say, ‘It is He who scattered you throughout the earth, He to whom you will be gathered.’
te.67:25: They say, ‘If what you say is true, when will this promise be fulfilled?’
te.67:26: Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of this: my only duty is to give clear warning.’
te.67:27: When they see it close at hand, the disbelievers’ faces will be gloomy, and it will be said, ‘This is what you were calling for.’
te.67:28: Say, ‘Just think- regardless of whether God destroys me and my followers or has mercy on us- who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?’
te.67:29: Say, ‘He is the Lord of Mercy; we believe in Him; we put our trust in Him. You will come to know in time who is in obvious error.’
te.67:30: Say, ‘Just think: if all your water were to sink deep into the earth who could give you flowing water in its place?’
te.68:1: Nun By the pen! By all they write!
te.68:2: Your Lord’s grace does not make you [Prophet] a madman:
te.68:3: you will have a never-ending reward––
te.68:4: truly you have a strong character––
te.68:5: and soon you will see, as will they,
te.68:6: which of you is afflicted with madness.
te.68:7: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is rightly guided.
te.68:8: So do not yield to those who deny the truth––
te.68:9: they want you to compromise with them and then they will compromise with you––
te.68:10: do not yield to any contemptible swearer,
te.68:12: or hinderer of good, to anyone who is sinful, aggressive,
te.68:13: coarse, and on top of all that, an imposter.
te.68:14: Just because he has wealth and sons,
te.68:15: when our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘These are just ancient fables.’
te.68:16: We shall brand him on the snout!
te.68:17: We have tried them as We tried the owners of a certain garden, who swore that they would harvest its fruits in the morning
te.68:18: and made no allowance [for the Will of God]:
te.68:19: a disaster from your Lord struck the garden as they slept
te.68:20: and by morning it was stripped bare, a desolate land.
te.68:21: Still they called each other at daybreak,
te.68:22: ‘Go early to your field if you wish to gather all its fruits,’
te.68:24: ‘Make sure no poor person enters the garden today!’––
te.68:25: they left early, bent on their purpose-
te.68:26: but when they saw the garden, they said, ‘We must have lost our way!
te.68:28: The wisest of them said, ‘Did I not say to you, “Will you not glorify God?”’-
te.68:29: they said, ‘Glory be to God, Our Lord! Truly, we were doing wrong!’-
te.68:30: and then they turned to each other in mutual reproach.
te.68:31: They said, ‘Alas for us! We have done terrible wrong,
te.68:32: but maybe our Lord will give us something better in its place: we truly turn to Him in hope.’
te.68:33: Such is the punishment [in this life], but greater still is the punishment in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
te.68:34: There will be Gardens of bliss for those who are mindful of God.
te.68:35: Should We treat those who submit to Us as We treat those who do evil?
te.68:36: What is the matter with you? On what basis do you judge?
te.68:37: Do you have a Scripture that tells you
te.68:38: that you will be granted whatever you choose?
te.68:39: Have you received from Us solemn oaths, binding to the Day of Resurrection, that you will get whatever you yourselves decide?
te.68:40: Ask them [Prophet] which of them will guarantee this.
te.68:41: Do they have ‘partners’ [besides God]? Let them produce their ‘partners’, if what they say is true.
te.68:42: On the Day when matters become dire, they will be invited to prostrate themselves but will be prevented from doing so,
te.68:43: and their eyes will be downcast and they will be overwhelmed with shame: they were invited to prostrate themselves when they were safe [but refused].
te.68:44: So [Prophet] leave those who reject this revelation to Me: We shall lead them on, step by step, in ways beyond their knowledge;
te.68:45: I will allow them more time, for My plan is powerful.
te.68:46: Do you demand some reward from them that would burden them with debt?
te.68:47: Do they have knowledge of the unseen that enables them to write it down?
te.68:48: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: do not be like the man in the whale who called out in distress:
te.68:49: if his Lord’s grace had not reached him, he would have been left, abandoned and blameworthy, on the barren shore,
te.68:50: but his Lord chose him and made him one of the Righteous.
te.68:51: The disbelievers almost strike you down with their looks when they hear the Quran. They say, ‘He must be mad!’
te.68:52: but truly it is nothing other than a Reminder for all peoples.
te.69:3: What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is?
te.69:4: The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blow would come:
te.69:5: Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast;
te.69:6: Ad was destroyed by a furious wind
te.69:7: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks.
te.69:8: Can you see any trace of them now?
te.69:9: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
te.69:10: these people committed grave sins and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip.
te.69:11: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship,
te.69:12: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed.
te.69:13: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time,
te.69:14: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow,
te.69:15: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass.
te.69:16: The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail.
te.69:17: The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them.
te.69:18: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden.
te.69:19: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it.
te.69:20: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’
te.69:21: and so he will have a pleasant life
te.69:23: with clustered fruit within his reach.
te.69:24: It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’
te.69:25: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record
te.69:26: and knew nothing of my Reckoning.
te.69:27: How I wish death had been the end of me.
te.69:28: My wealth has been no use to me,
te.69:30: ‘Take him, put a collar on him,
te.69:31: lead him to burn in the blazing Fire,
te.69:32: and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long:
te.69:33: he would not believe in Almighty God,
te.69:34: he never encouraged feeding the hungry,
te.69:35: so today he has no real friend here,
te.69:36: and the only food he has is the filth
te.69:38: So I swear by what you can see
te.69:39: and by what you cannot see:
te.69:40: this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger,
te.69:41: not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-
te.69:42: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!
te.69:43: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds:
te.69:44: if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us,
te.69:45: We would certainly have seized his right hand
te.69:47: and none of you could have defended him.
te.69:48: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God.
te.69:49: We know that some of you consider it to be lies-
te.69:50: this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers-
te.69:51: but it is in fact the certain Truth.
te.69:52: So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty.
te.70:2: It will fall on the disbelievers––none can deflect it––
te.70:3: from God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent,
te.70:4: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him, on a Day whose length is fifty thousand years.
te.70:5: So be patient, [Prophet], as befits you.
te.70:6: The disbelievers think it is distant,
te.70:7: but We know it to be close.
te.70:8: On a Day when the heavens will be like molten brass
te.70:9: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
te.70:10: when no friend will ask about his friend,
te.70:11: even when they are within sight of one another. The guilty person will wish he could save himself from the suffering of that Day by sacrificing his sons,
te.70:13: the kinsfolk who gave him shelter,
te.70:14: and everyone on earth, if it could save him.
te.70:15: But no! There is a raging flame
te.70:17: and it will claim everyone who rejects the truth, turns away,
te.70:20: he is fretful when misfortune touches him,
te.70:21: but tight-fisted when good fortune comes his way.
te.70:23: and are constant in their prayers;
te.70:24: who give a due share of their wealth
te.70:26: who believe in the Day of Judgement
te.70:27: and fear the punishment of their Lord––
te.70:28: none may feel wholly secure from it––
te.70:30: from all but their spouses or their slave-girls––there is no blame attached to [relations with] these,
te.70:31: but those whose desires exceed this limit are truly transgressors––
te.70:32: who are faithful to their trusts and their pledges;
te.70:34: and are steadfast in their prayers.
te.70:35: They will be honoured in Gardens of bliss.
te.70:36: What is wrong with the disbelievers? Why do they rush to peer at you [Prophet],
te.70:37: from right and left, in crowds?
te.70:38: Does every one of them expect to enter a Garden of bliss?
te.70:39: No! We created them from the substance they know,
te.70:40: and, by the Lord of every sunrise and sunset, We have the power
te.70:41: to substitute for them others better than they are- nothing can prevent Us from doing this.
te.70:42: So leave them to wallow in idle talk, until they come face to face with their promised Day,
te.70:43: the Day they will rush out of their graves as if rallying to a flag,
te.70:44: eyes downcast and covered in shame: that is the Day of which they were warned.
te.71:1: We sent Noah to his people: ‘Warn your people, before a painful punishment comes to them.’
te.71:2: And so he said, ‘My people, I am here to warn you plainly.
te.71:3: Serve God, be mindful of Him and obey me.
te.71:4: He will forgive you your sins and spare you until your appointed time––when God’s appointed time arrives it cannot be postponed. If only you understood!’
te.71:5: He said, ‘My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
te.71:6: but the more I call them, the further they run away:
te.71:7: every time I call them, so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, cover their heads with their garments, persist in their rejection, and grow more insolent and arrogant.
te.71:8: I have tried calling them openly.
te.71:9: I have tried preaching to them in public and speaking to them in private.
te.71:10: I said, “Ask forgiveness of your Lord: He is ever forgiving.
te.71:11: He will send down abundant rain from the sky for you;
te.71:12: He will give you wealth and sons; He will provide you with gardens and rivers.
te.71:13: What is the matter with you? Why will you not fear God’s majesty,
te.71:14: when He has created you stage by stage?
te.71:15: Have you ever wondered how God created seven heavens, one above the other,
te.71:16: placed the moon as a light in them and the sun as a lamp,
te.71:17: how God made you spring forth from the earth like a plant,
te.71:18: how He will return you into it and then bring you out again,
te.71:19: and how He has spread the Earth out for you
te.71:20: to walk along its spacious paths?” ’
te.71:21: Noah said, ‘My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose riches and children only increase their ruin;
te.71:22: who have made a grand plan,
te.71:23: saying, “Do not renounce your gods! Do not renounce Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, or Nasr!”
te.71:24: They have led many astray. Lord, bring nothing but destruction down on the evildoers!’
te.71:25: They were drowned and sent to Hell for their evildoings: they found no one to help them against God.
te.71:26: And Noah said, ‘Lord, do not leave any of the disbelievers on the earth-
te.71:27: if you leave them they will lead Your servants astray and beget only sinners and disbelievers-
te.71:28: Lord, forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer. Forgive believing men and women but bring nothing but ruin down on the evildoers!’
te.72:1: Say [Prophet], ‘It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn once listened in and said, “We have heard a wondrous Quran,
te.72:2: that gives guidance to the right path, and we have come to believe it––We shall never set up partners with our Lord––
te.72:3: and that He––exalted be the glory of our Lord!––has neither spouse nor child.
te.72:4: Outrageous things have been said about God by the foolish among us,
te.72:5: although we had thought that no man or jinn would [dare to] tell a lie about Him.
te.72:6: Men have sought refuge with the jinn in the past, but they only misguided them further.
te.72:7: They thought, as you did, that God would never raise anyone from the dead.
te.72:8: We tried to reach heaven, but discovered it to be full of stern guards and shooting stars––
te.72:9: we used to sit in places there, listening, but anyone trying to listen now will find a shooting star lying in wait for him––
te.72:10: [so now] we do not know whether those who live on earth are due for misfortune, or whether their Lord intends to guide them.
te.72:11: Some of us are righteous and others less so: we follow different paths.
te.72:12: We know we can never frustrate God on earth; we can never escape Him.
te.72:13: When we heard the guidance we came to believe: whoever believes in his Lord need fear no loss nor injustice.
te.72:14: Some of us submit to Him and others go the wrong way: those who submit to God have found wise guidance,
te.72:15: but those who go wrong will be fuel for Hellfire.” ’
te.72:16: If they had taken to the right way, We would have given them abundant water to drink-
te.72:17: a test for them––but anyone who turns away from his Lord’s Revelation will be sent by Him to spiralling torment.
te.72:18: Places of worship are for God alone- so do not pray to anyone other than God-
te.72:19: yet when God’s Servant stood up to pray to Him, they pressed in on him.
te.72:20: Say, ‘I pray to my Lord alone; I set up no partner with Him.’
te.72:21: Say, ‘I have no control over any harm or good that may befall you.’
te.72:22: Say, ‘No one can protect me from God: I have no refuge except in Him.
te.72:23: I only deliver [what I receive] from God- only His messages.’ Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger will have Hell’s Fire as his permanent home:
te.72:24: when they are confronted by what they have been warned about, they will realize who has the weaker protector and the smaller number.
te.72:25: Say, ‘I do not know whether what you have been warned about is near, or whether a distant time has been appointed for it by my Lord.’
te.72:26: He is the One who knows what is hidden.
te.72:27: He does not disclose it except to a messenger of His choosing. He sends watchers to go in front and behind
te.72:28: to ensure that each of His messengers delivers his Lord’s message: He knows all about them, and He takes account of everything.
te.73:2: Stay up throughout the night, all but a small part of it,
te.73:4: or a little more; recite the Quran slowly and distinctly:
te.73:5: We shall send a momentous message down to you.
te.73:6: Night prayer makes a deeper impression and sharpens words––
te.73:7: you are kept busy for long periods of the day––
te.73:8: so celebrate the name of your Lord and devote yourself wholeheart-edly to Him.
te.73:9: He is Lord of the east and west, there is no god but Him, so take Him as your Protector,
te.73:10: patiently endure what they say, ignore them politely,
te.73:11: and leave to Me those who deny the truth and live in luxury. Bear with them for a little while;
te.73:12: We have fetters, a blazing fire,
te.73:13: food that chokes, and agonizing torment in store for them
te.73:14: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will shake. The mountains will become a heap of loose sand.
te.73:15: We have sent a messenger to you [people] to be your witness, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh,
te.73:16: but Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger and so We inflicted a heavy punishment on him.
te.73:17: So if you disbelieve, how can you guard yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair grey,
te.73:18: a Day when the sky will be torn apart? God’s promise will certainly be fulfilled.
te.73:19: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes take the way to his Lord.
te.73:20: [Prophet], your Lord is well aware that you sometimes spend nearly two-thirds of the night at prayer––sometimes half, sometimes a third––as do some of your followers. God determines the division of night and day. He knows that you will not be able to keep a measure of it and He has relented towards all of you, so recite as much of the Quran as is easy for you. He knows that some of you will be sick, some of you travelling through the land seeking God’s bounty, some of you fighting in God’s way: recite as much as is easy for you, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and make God a good loan. Whatever good you store up for yourselves will be improved and increased for you. Ask God for His forgiveness, He is most forgiving, most merciful.
te.74:3: Proclaim the greatness of your Lord;
te.74:6: do not be overwhelmed and weaken;
te.74:7: be steadfast in your Lord’s cause.
te.74:9: that will be a Day of anguish for the disbelievers.
te.74:11: [Prophet], leave Me to deal with the one I created helpless,
te.74:15: yet he still hopes I will give him more.
te.74:16: No! He has been stubbornly hostile to Our revelation:
te.74:17: I will inflict a spiralling torment on him.
te.74:23: and turned away and behaved arrogantly
te.74:24: and said, ‘This is just old sorcery,
te.74:25: just the talk of a mortal!’
te.74:26: I will throw him into the scorching Fire.
te.74:27: What will explain to you what the scorching Fire is?
te.74:28: It spares nothing and leaves nothing;
te.74:29: it scorches the flesh of humans;
te.74:30: there are nineteen in charge of it––
te.74:31: none other than angels appointed by Us to guard Hellfire- and We have made their number a test for the disbelievers. So those who have been given the Scripture will be certain and those who believe will have their faith increased: neither those who have been given the Scripture nor the believers will have any doubts, but the sick at heart and the disbelievers will say, ‘What could God mean by this description?’ God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will- no one knows your Lord’s forces except Him- this [description] is a warning to mortals.
te.74:35: It is one of the mightiest things,
te.74:37: to those of you who choose to go ahead and those who lag behind.
te.74:38: Every soul is held in pledge for its deeds,
te.74:39: but the Companions of the Right will stay
te.74:42: ‘What drove you to the Scorching Fire?’ [they will ask]
te.74:43: and they will answer, ‘We did not pray;
te.74:44: we did not feed the poor;
te.74:45: we indulged with others [in mocking the believers];
te.74:46: we denied the Day of Judgement
te.74:47: until the Certain End came upon us.’
te.74:48: No intercessor’s plea will benefit them now.
te.74:49: What is the matter with them? Why do they turn away from the warning,
te.74:52: Each one of them demands that a scripture be sent down to him and unrolled before his very eyes-
te.74:53: No! Truly they have no fear of the life to come-
te.74:54: but truly this is a reminder.
te.74:55: Let whoever wishes to take heed do so:
te.74:56: they will only take heed if God so wishes. He is the Lord who should be heeded, the Lord of forgiveness.
te.75:3: Does man think We shall not put his bones back together?
te.75:4: In fact, We can reshape his very fingertips.
te.75:5: Yet man wants to deny what is ahead of him:
te.75:6: he says, ‘So, when will this Day of Resurrection be?’
te.75:9: when the sun and the moon are brought together,
te.75:10: on that Day man will say, ‘Where can I escape?’
te.75:12: they will all return to your Lord on that Day.
te.75:13: On that Day, man will be told what he put first and what he put last.
te.75:14: Truly, man is a clear witness against himself,
te.75:15: despite all the excuses he may put forward.
te.75:16: [Prophet], do not rush your tongue in an attempt to hasten [your memorization of] the Revelation:
te.75:17: We shall make sure of its safe collection and recitation.
te.75:18: When We have recited it, repeat the recitation
te.75:19: and We shall make it clear.
te.75:20: Truly you [people] love this fleeting world
te.75:21: and neglect the life to come.
te.75:22: On that Day there will be radiant faces,
te.75:24: and on that Day there will be the sad and despairing faces
te.75:25: of those who realize that a great calamity is about to befall them.
te.75:26: Truly, when the soul reaches the collarbone;
te.75:27: when it is said, ‘Could any charm-healer save him now?’;
te.75:28: when he knows it is the final parting;
te.75:29: when his legs are brought together:
te.75:30: on that day he will be driven towards your Lord.
te.75:32: but denied the truth and turned away,
te.75:33: walking back to his people with a conceited swagger.
te.75:34: Closer and closer it comes to you.
te.75:36: Does man think he will be left alone?
te.75:37: Was he not just a drop of spilt-out sperm,
te.75:38: which became a clinging form, which God shaped in due proportion,
te.75:39: fashioning from it the two sexes, male and female?
te.75:40: Does He who can do this not have the power to bring the dead back to life?
te.76:1: Was there not a period of time when man was nothing to speak of ?
te.76:2: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid to put him to the test; We gave him hearing and sight;
te.76:3: We guided him to the right path, whether he was grateful or not.
te.76:4: We have prepared chains, iron collars, and blazing Fire for the disbelievers, but
te.76:5: the righteous will have a drink mixed with kafur,
te.76:6: a spring for God’s servants, which flows abundantly at their wish.
te.76:7: They fulfil their vows; they fear a day of widespread woes;
te.76:8: they give food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive, though they love it themselves,
te.76:9: saying, ‘We feed you for the sake of God alone: We seek neither recompense nor thanks from you.
te.76:10: We fear the Day of our Lord––a woefully grim Day.’
te.76:11: So God will save them from the woes of that Day, give them radiance and gladness,
te.76:12: and reward them, for their steadfastness, with a Garden and silken robes.
te.76:13: They will sit on couches, feeling neither scorching heat nor biting cold,
te.76:14: with shady [branches] spread above them and clusters of fruit hanging close at hand.
te.76:15: They will be served with silver plates
te.76:16: and gleaming silver goblets according to their fancy,
te.76:17: and they will be given a drink infused with ginger
te.76:19: Everlasting youths will attend them––if you could see them, you would think they were scattered pearls––
te.76:20: and if you were to look around, you would see bliss and great wealth:
te.76:21: they will wear garments of green silk and brocade; they will be adorned with silver bracelets; their Lord will give them a pure drink.
te.76:22: [It will be said], ‘This is your reward. Your endeavours are appreciated.’
te.76:23: We Ourself have sent down this Quran to you [Prophet] in gradual revelation.
te.76:24: Await your Lord’s Judgement with patience; do not yield to any of these sinners or disbelievers;
te.76:25: remember the name of your Lord at dawn and in the evening;
te.76:26: bow down before Him, and glorify Him at length by night.
te.76:27: These people love the fleeting life. They put aside [all thoughts of] a Heavy Day.
te.76:28: Yet We created them; We strengthened their constitution; if We please, We can replace such people completely.
te.76:29: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes, take the way to his Lord.
te.76:30: But you will only wish to do so if God wills- God is all knowing, all wise-
te.76:31: He admits whoever He will into His Mercy and has prepared a painful torment for the disbelievers.
te.77:1: By the [winds] sent forth in swift succession,
te.77:6: as a proof or a warning:
te.77:7: what you are promised will come to pass.
te.77:9: and the sky is torn apart,
te.77:10: when the mountains are turned to dust
te.77:11: and the messengers given their appointed time––
te.77:12: for what Day has all this been set?
te.77:14: What will explain to you what the Day of Decision is?
te.77:15: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
te.77:16: Did We not destroy the first [of them]?
te.77:17: We shall make the last follow them:
te.77:18: this is how We deal with the guilty.
te.77:19: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
te.77:20: Did We not make you from an underrated fluid
te.77:21: which We housed in a safe lodging
te.77:23: We determine [it]: how excellently We determine!
te.77:24: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
te.77:25: Did We not make the earth a home
te.77:26: for the living and the dead?
te.77:27: Did We not place firm, lofty mountains on it and provide you with sweet water?
te.77:28: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
te.77:29: They will be told, ‘Go to that which you used to deny!
te.77:30: Go to a shadow of smoke!’ It rises in three columns;
te.77:31: no shade does it give, nor relief from the flame;
te.77:32: it shoots out sparks as large as treetrunks
te.77:34: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
te.77:35: On that Day they will be speechless,
te.77:36: and they will be given no chance to offer any excuses.
te.77:37: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
te.77:38: [They will be told], ‘This is the Day of Decision: We have gathered you and earlier generations.
te.77:39: If you have any plots against Me, try them now.’
te.77:40: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
te.77:41: But those who took heed of God will enjoy cool shade, springs,
te.77:43: [they will be told], ‘Eat and drink to your hearts’ content as a reward for your deeds:

te.110:3: celebrate the praise of your Lord and ask His forgiveness: He is always ready to accept repentance.
te.111:1: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined! May he be ruined too!
te.111:2: Neither his wealth nor his gains will help him:
te.111:3: he will burn in the Flaming Fire––
te.111:4: and so will his wife, the firewood-carrier,
te.111:5: with a palm-fibre rope around her neck.
te.112:3: He begot no one nor was He begotten.
te.112:4: No one is comparable to Him.’
te.113:1: Say [Prophet], ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak
te.113:2: against the harm in what He has created,
te.113:3: the harm in the night when darkness gathers,
te.113:4: the harm in witches when they blow on knots,
te.113:5: the harm in the envier when he envies.’
te.114:1: Say, ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of people,
te.114:4: against the harm of the slinking whisperer––
te.114:5: who whispers into the hearts of people––
te.114:6: whether they be jinn or people.’
